Pluto冥王星=冥界，plutonium钚） || 文化联想：中文“金钱政治、富豪掌权”最适合帮助记忆 plutocracy，可以说 **a plutocracy — “A society in which a tiny wealthy elite has disproportionate political power may be criticized as a plutocracy.”**

quiz.question: _______ bureaucracy
quiz.explanation: 官僚主义; 官僚机构, 臃肿的官僚机构. The bloated bureaucracy slows decision-making. 臃肿的官僚机构减慢了决策。 | bureau->办公桌（法语），cracy->统治，bureaucracy->办公桌统治=官僚（cf. bureau办事处，bureaucrat官僚，technocracy技术官僚） || 文化联想：中文“层层审批、办个事盖很多章”最适合帮助记忆 bureaucracy，可以说 **a bloated bureaucracy — “A bloated bureaucracy can slow a simple project through repeated forms, approvals, and overlapping offices.”**

quiz.question: ________ confederacy
quiz.explanation: 邦联; 同盟, 南方邦联. The southern confederacy fought in the Civil War. 南方邦联在内战中作战。 | con->共同，feder->联盟（拉丁foedus），confederacy->共同联盟（cf. federal联邦，federation联合会，ally盟友） || 文化联想：confederacy 是“邦联/松散联盟”，可用中国学生学习美国内战史时来记忆，可以说 **a southern confederacy — “In a U.S. history class, students may study the southern Confederacy that fought during the Civil War.”**

quiz.question: ________ conspiracy
quiz.explanation: 阴谋; 共谋, 犯罪阴谋. The court uncovered a criminal conspiracy. 法院揭露了一起犯罪阴谋。 | con->共同，spir->呼吸（拉丁spirare），conspiracy->共同呼吸秘密=阴谋（cf. inspire鼓励，spirit精神，aspire渴望，expire呼气/到期） || 文化联想：中文“几个人暗中串联密谋”最适合帮助记忆 conspiracy，可以说 **a criminal conspiracy — “Several people who secretly plan an illegal scheme together may form a criminal conspiracy.”**

quiz.question: ________ accuracy
quiz.explanation: 准确性; 精确, 精确的准确性. The GPS provides pinpoint accuracy. GPS提供精确的准确性。 | accur->关心（拉丁accurare->精心处理），accuracy->精心处理后的精确（cf. accurate精确，cure治愈，curator馆长，accurate=cured of errors） || 文化联想：北斗定位强调高精度最适合帮助记忆 accuracy，可以说 **pinpoint accuracy — “A modern navigation system can provide near-pinpoint accuracy under favorable conditions.”**

quiz.question: _______ prophecy
quiz.explanation: 预言, 实现预言. Events seemed to fulfill prophecy exactly. 事件似乎完全实现了预言。 | pro->提前，phecy->说（希腊phemi），prophecy->提前说出的=预言（cf. prophet先知，blasphemy亵渎，euphemism委婉说法） || 文化联想：中文“预言成真”最适合帮助记忆 prophecy，可以说 **fulfill a prophecy — “In a legend, later events may appear to fulfill a prophecy made many years earlier.”**

quiz.question: _________ ascendancy
quiz.explanation: 优势; 支配地位, 政治优势. The party gained political ascendancy. 该党获得了政治优势。 | ascend->上升，ancy->状态，ascendancy->持续上升的状态=优势（cf. ascend上升，descend下降，transcend超越） || 文化联想：中文“逐渐取得上风”最适合帮助记忆 ascendancy，可以说 **gain ascendancy — “A new technology may gain ascendancy when it becomes cheaper, faster, and more widely adopted than older alternatives.”**

quiz.question: _____ redundancy
quiz.explanation: 裁员; 冗余, 员工裁员. The company announced staff redundancy. 公司宣布了员工裁员。 | re->再，und->波（拉丁unda），redundancy->波浪一再涌来=多余/裁员（cf. abundant丰富，inundate淹没，undulate波动） || 文化联想：中国企业裁员时的人力冗余最适合帮助记忆 redundancy，可以说 **staff redundancy — “A merger may create staff redundancy when two departments perform almost the same work.”**

quiz.question: ______ dormancy
quiz.explanation: 休眠; 静止, 冬季休眠. Plants enter winter dormancy to survive cold. 植物进入冬季休眠以度过寒冷。 | dorm->睡眠（拉丁dormire），dormancy->沉睡的状态（cf. dormitory宿舍，dormant休眠的，dormouse睡鼠） || 文化联想：中国北方植物冬天进入休眠最适合帮助记忆 dormancy，可以说 **winter dormancy — “Many garden plants enter winter dormancy and resume active growth when spring returns.”**

quiz.question: ____ discrepancy
quiz.explanation: 差异; 不符, 数据差异. Researchers found a data discrepancy in results. 研究人员在结果中发现了数据差异。 | dis->分开，crep->噼啪声（拉丁crepare），discrepancy->发出不同的声音=差异（cf. decrepit破旧，discredit使丢脸，crepuscular黄昏的） || 文化联想：中文“对账对不上”最适合帮助记忆 discrepancy，可以说 **a data discrepancy — “An accountant may investigate a data discrepancy when two reports show different totals for the same period.”**

quiz.question: _____ vibrancy
quiz.explanation: 活力; 生气, 城市活力. The neighborhood is known for its urban vibrancy. 该社区以其城市活力而闻名。 | vibr->振动（拉丁vibrare），vibrancy->充满振动活力的状态（cf. vibrate振动，vibrant充满活力的，vibration震动） || 文化联想：成都夜市和街区的热闹活力最适合帮助记忆 vibrancy，可以说 **urban vibrancy — “Busy food streets, teahouses, music, and late-night crowds can give Chengdu a distinctive urban vibrancy.”**

quiz.question: vagrancy ___
quiz.explanation: 流浪; 游荡, 流浪法. The vagrancy law was challenged in court. 流浪法在法庭上受到质疑。 | vagr->漫游（拉丁vagari），vagrancy->到处漫游的行为=流浪（cf. vagrant流浪者，vague模糊，vagabond流浪者，extravagant奢侈） || 文化联想：中文“流浪游荡”最适合帮助记忆 vagrancy，可以说 **a vagrancy law — “A legal-history class may examine how a vagrancy law regulated or punished people living without a fixed home.”**

quiz.question: _________ inconstancy
quiz.explanation: 不稳定; 易变, 情绪不稳定. His emotional inconstancy made relationships difficult. 他的情绪不稳定使关系变得困难。 | in->否定，constant->恒定的，inconstancy->不恒定的状态=易变（cf. constant恒定，circumstance情况，stance立场） || 文化联想：中文“喜怒无常”最适合帮助记忆 inconstancy，可以说 **emotional inconstancy — “A person whose mood and affection change dramatically from day to day may show emotional inconstancy.”**

quiz.question: truancy _______
quiz.explanation: 逃学, 逃学问题. Schools struggle with the truancy problem. 学校在逃学问题上挣扎。 | truant->流浪者（威尔士语truan->可怜人），truancy->逃学游荡的行为（cf. truant逃学者，vagrant流浪者，delinquent违法者） || 文化联想：中文“逃学去网吧”这个熟悉画面最适合帮助记忆 truancy，可以说 **a truancy problem — “A school may face a truancy problem when students repeatedly skip classes without permission.”**

quiz.question: _________ complacency
quiz.explanation: 自满; 满足, 危险的自满. Success can breed dangerous complacency. 成功会滋生危险的自满。 | com->共同，plac->取悦（拉丁placere），complacency->自我取悦=自满（cf. placate平息，complaisant殷勤，please取悦，placid平静） || 文化联想：中文“骄兵必败”最适合帮助记忆 complacency，可以说 **dangerous complacency — “A successful team that stops preparing seriously may fall into dangerous complacency—正所谓‘骄兵必败.’”**

quiz.question: ______ decency
quiz.explanation: 正派; 体面, 普通礼节. Common decency requires basic courtesy. 普通礼节需要基本礼貌。 | decent->适当（拉丁decere->适合），decency->适当得体的行为（cf. decent体面，decorum礼节，undecided未决定） || 文化联想：中文“做人要有基本体面和礼貌”最适合帮助记忆 decency，可以说 **common decency — “Common decency means treating service workers, neighbors, and strangers with basic respect.”**

quiz.question: emergency ____
quiz.explanation: 紧急情况, 紧急出口. The emergency exit must remain clear. 紧急出口必须保持畅通。 | e->向外，merg->沉（拉丁mergere），emergency->从水中突然冒出=紧急情况（cf. emerge涌现，merge合并，submerge淹没，immerse浸入） || 文化联想：中国商场里绿色的紧急出口标志最适合帮助记忆 emergency，可以说 **an emergency exit — “An emergency exit in a shopping mall must remain unlocked and unobstructed.”**

quiz.question: ____ deficiency
quiz.explanation: 缺乏; 不足, 铁缺乏症. Iron deficiency causes anemia. 铁缺乏症导致贫血。 | de->向下，fic->做（拉丁facere），deficiency->做得不够=不足（cf. deficient不足，proficient熟练，sufficient足够，efficient有效） || 文化联想：中国医院检查缺铁性贫血最适合帮助记忆 deficiency，可以说 **iron deficiency — “A blood test may reveal iron deficiency when the body does not have enough iron for normal red-blood-cell production.”**

quiz.question: _________ expediency
quiz.explanation: 权宜之计, 政治权宜之计. The decision was based on political expediency. 该决定基于政治权宜之计。 | ex->向外，ped->脚，expediency->解放脚去做=权宜（cf. expedient权宜的，expedite加快，impede阻碍=绑住脚） || 文化联想：中文“权宜之计”最适合帮助记忆 expediency，可以说 **political expediency — “A leader may choose a short-term compromise for political expediency even though it is not the best long-term solution.”**

quiz.question: ________ leniency
quiz.explanation: 宽大; 仁慈, 司法宽大. The defendant requested judicial leniency. 被告请求司法宽大。 | leni->柔和（拉丁lenis->温和），leniency->温和对待的行为（cf. lenient宽大，relent软化，relentless不停息） || 文化联想：中文“从轻处理”最适合帮助记忆 leniency，可以说 **judicial leniency — “A first-time offender may ask the court for judicial leniency based on remorse and mitigating circumstances.”**

quiz.question: _____ clemency
quiz.explanation: 宽恕; 仁慈, 给予宽恕. The governor will grant clemency to the prisoner. 州长将给予囚犯宽恕。 | clemens->温和（拉丁），clemency->温和宽容的给予=宽恕（cf. clement温和，inclement恶劣，Clement人名=温和者） || 文化联想：中文“赦免、宽恕”最适合帮助记忆 clemency，可以说 **grant clemency — “A head of government or state may have legal authority in some systems to grant clemency to a prisoner.”**

quiz.question: _______ consistency
quiz.explanation: 一致性; 连贯性, 逻辑一致性. The theory lacks logical consistency. 该理论缺乏逻辑一致性。 | con->共同，sist->站立，consistency->始终站在同一处=一致性（cf. consistent一致，insist坚持，resist抵制，assist协助） || 文化联想：中文“前后一致、自圆其说”最适合帮助记忆 consistency，可以说 **logical consistency — “A theory needs logical consistency so that one part does not contradict another.”**

quiz.question: ________ delinquency
quiz.explanation: 违法; 拖欠, 青少年违法. The program aims to reduce juvenile delinquency. 该项目旨在减少青少年违法。 | de->向下，linqu->放弃，delinquency->放弃责任（cf. delinquent违法者，relinquish放弃，relic遗迹） || 文化联想：中国学校和社区预防青少年违法最适合帮助记忆 delinquency，可以说 **juvenile delinquency — “After-school programs may help reduce juvenile delinquency by giving teenagers structure, support, and supervision.”**

quiz.question: _________ insolvency
quiz.explanation: 无力偿还; 破产, 企业破产. Corporate insolvency rose during the recession. 企业破产在经济衰退期间上升。 | in->否定，solv->解开（拉丁solvere），insolvency->无法解开债务=破产（cf. solve解决，dissolve溶解，resolve决心，solvent溶剂） || 文化联想：中文“资不抵债、无力偿还”最适合帮助记忆 insolvency，可以说 **corporate insolvency — “A company may enter corporate insolvency when it can no longer pay debts as they come due.”**

quiz.question: ready ____
quiz.explanation: 准备好的; 现成的, 现金. The business needs ready cash for operations. 企业需要现金进行运营。 | ready->准备好（古英语ræde->骑马的=随时能出发），ready->准备就绪（cf. ready-made现成的，already已经，readiness准备） || 文化联想：中文“手头现钱”最适合帮助记忆 ready，可以说 **ready cash — “A small business may keep some ready cash available for urgent operating expenses.”**

quiz.question: toady __ _____
quiz.explanation: 谄媚; 拍马屁, 向权力谄媚. He would toady to power to advance his career. 他会向权力谄媚以推进他的职业生涯。 | toady->吞蟾蜍的人（江湖郎中的助手假装吃毒蟾蜍），toady->无原则奉承者=马屁精（cf. toad蟾蜍，sycophant马屁精） || 文化联想：中文“拍马屁、巴结权势”最适合帮助记忆 toady，可以说 **toady to power — “An ambitious employee may toady to power by flattering every senior executive in the room.”**

quiz.question: _____ eddy
quiz.explanation: 漩涡, 水漩涡. The water eddy swirled near the rocks. 水漩涡在岩石附近旋转。 | eddy->漩涡（古挪威iða->漩涡），eddy->水流回旋（cf. whirlpool漩涡，swirl旋转，current水流） || 文化联想：江河岩石旁打转的小漩涡最适合帮助记忆 eddy，可以说 **a water eddy — “A small water eddy may form behind a rock where the current curls back on itself.”**

quiz.question: muddy _____
quiz.explanation: 泥泞的; 混浊的, 混浊的水. The river ran with muddy water after the rain. 雨后河水变得混浊。 | mud->泥（古英语mudde），muddy->充满泥的=混浊的（cf. muddle混乱，mudslide泥石流，muddy the waters混淆视听） || 文化联想：黄河雨后浑浊的河水最适合帮助记忆 muddy，可以说 **muddy water — “After heavy rain upstream, a river may carry muddy water filled with suspended soil.”**

quiz.question: needy ______
quiz.explanation: 贫困的; 需要帮助的, 贫困家庭. The charity helps needy family in the community. 慈善机构帮助社区中的贫困家庭。 | need->需要（古英语nied），needy->充满需要的=贫困的（cf. need需要，neediness贫困，heed注意，indeed确实） || 文化联想：中国慈善机构帮助困难家庭最适合帮助记忆 needy，可以说 **a needy family — “A local charity may provide food, school supplies, and temporary assistance to a needy family.”**

quiz.question: reedy _____
quiz.explanation: 芦苇般的; 尖细的, 尖细的声音. The old man spoke in a reedy voice. 老人用尖细的声音说话。 | reed->芦苇（古英语hreod），reedy->像芦苇一样细的（cf. reed芦苇，reed instrument簧管乐器，reedy sound细长声） || 文化联想：中文“像芦苇一样细尖的嗓音”最适合帮助记忆 reedy，可以说 **a reedy voice — “An elderly storyteller may speak in a thin, reedy voice that still carries clearly across a quiet room.”**

quiz.question: _____ tragedy
quiz.explanation: 悲剧, 希腊悲剧. Greek tragedy explored human fate and suffering. 希腊悲剧探讨人类命运和苦难。 | tragos->山羊（希腊），ody->歌曲，tragedy->山羊歌=悲剧（戏剧奖品是山羊，或演员穿山羊皮，cf. tragic悲剧的，comedy喜剧） || 文化联想：tragedy 是西方戏剧传统的重要概念，可用中国学生学习古希腊戏剧时来记忆，可以说 **Greek tragedy — “In a world-literature class, students may study how Greek tragedy explores fate, pride, suffering, and moral conflict.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ perfidy
quiz.explanation: 背信弃义; 不忠, 背信弃义的行为. His betrayal was an act of perfidy. 他的背叛是背信弃义的行为。 | per->违背，fid->信任（拉丁fides），perfidy->违背信任=背信弃义（cf. fidelity忠诚，confide信赖，perfidious背信弃义的） || 文化联想：中文“背信弃义”最适合帮助记忆 perfidy，可以说 **an act of perfidy — “Secretly helping an enemy after promising loyalty would be an act of perfidy.”**

quiz.question: _____ subsidy
quiz.explanation: 补贴; 津贴, 国家补贴. Farmers receive a state subsidy for crops. 农民获得农作物的国家补贴。 | sub->从下，sid->坐（拉丁sedere），subsidy->从下面坐着支撑=补贴（cf. subsidize补贴，sediment沉积，preside主持，reside居住） || 文化联想：中国农业里的政府补贴最适合帮助记忆 subsidy，可以说 **a farm subsidy — “A government may provide a farm subsidy to support certain crops or stabilize agricultural production.”**

quiz.question: unwieldy _______
quiz.explanation: 笨重的; 难以处理的, 笨重的包裹. The unwieldy package was difficult to carry. 笨重的包裹很难搬运。 | un->否定，wieldy->可操控的（wield->控制），unwieldy->无法控制的=笨重（cf. wield挥舞，yield屈服，wielder操控者） || 文化联想：中国搬家时遇到又大又难抱的包裹最适合帮助记忆 unwieldy，可以说 **an unwieldy package — “A long, heavy box can be an unwieldy package that is difficult for one person to carry.”**

quiz.question: dandy ______
quiz.explanation: 花花公子; 极好的, 花花公子. The dandy fellow dressed impeccably. 花花公子穿着无可挑剔。 | dandy->花花公子（来自Andy，爱打扮的人名），dandy->注重仪表的人（cf. dapper整洁的，fop花花公子，snazzy时髦的） || 文化联想：民国老上海西装革履、特别爱打扮的公子哥形象最适合帮助记忆 dandy，可以说 **a stylish dandy — “An old Shanghai film may feature a stylish dandy dressed in an immaculate suit and polished shoes.”**

quiz.question: windy ______
quiz.explanation: 多风的; 冗长空洞的, 冗长空洞的演讲. The politician gave a windy speech full of platitudes. 政客发表了充满陈词滥调的冗长空洞演讲。 | wind->风，windy->充满风/空洞的（cf. windfall意外之财，window风眼，long-winded冗长的） || 文化联想：中文“又臭又长、空话连篇的讲话”最适合帮助记忆 windy，可以说 **a windy speech — “A politician may give a windy speech full of slogans but very little concrete information.”**

quiz.question: antibody ____
quiz.explanation: 抗体, 抗体测试. The antibody test detects immunity. 抗体测试检测免疫力。 | anti->对抗，body->身体，antibody->对抗入侵者的身体物质=抗体（cf. antibiotic抗生素，antibiotics=anti+biotic=对抗生命的药） || 文化联想：中国医院做抗体检测最适合帮助记忆 antibody，可以说 **an antibody test — “An antibody test can detect whether the immune system has produced antibodies against a particular target.”**

quiz.question: embody ______
quiz.explanation: 体现; 包含, 体现理想. Heroes embody ideals we admire. 英雄体现了我们钦佩的理想。 | em->使，body->身体，embody->使具有身体=体现（cf. body身体，disembody使无形，embodiment化身，incorporate并入） || 文化联想：梅花常被用来体现坚韧不屈的精神，最适合帮助记忆 embody，可以说 **embody resilience — “In Chinese cultural imagery, plum blossoms can embody resilience because they bloom in the cold of winter.”**

quiz.question: moody ________
quiz.explanation: 喜怒无常的, 喜怒无常的青少年. The moody teenager refused to talk. 喜怒无常的青少年拒绝说话。 | mood->情绪（古英语mod->心情），moody->情绪起伏的=喜怒无常（cf. mood情绪，gloomy阴郁，temperamental性情不定） || 文化联想：中文“青春期孩子情绪阴晴不定”最适合帮助记忆 moody，可以说 **a moody teenager — “A moody teenager may be cheerful in the morning and withdrawn by the evening.”**

quiz.question: __ _ parody
quiz.explanation: 模仿作品; 滑稽模仿, 做滑稽模仿. The comedian will do a parody of the president. 喜剧演员将对总统做滑稽模仿。 | para->旁边，ody->歌曲，parody->在旁边唱的=讽刺模仿（cf. tragedy悲剧，comedy喜剧，ode颂歌，rhapsody狂想曲） || 文化联想：春晚或网络节目里模仿经典影视桥段最适合帮助记忆 parody，可以说 **a comic parody — “A comedy show may perform a comic parody of a famous historical drama by exaggerating its most recognizable scenes.”**

quiz.question: _______ rhapsody
quiz.explanation: 狂想曲; 狂喜, 狂喜的狂想曲. The music put listeners in rapture rhapsody. 音乐使听众陷入狂喜的狂想曲。 | rhaps->缝合（希腊rhaptein->缝），ody->歌曲，rhapsody->缝合诗篇/狂想曲（cf. rapture狂喜，rabid狂热，cf. Bohemian Rhapsody波西米亚狂想曲） || 文化联想：中国音乐学院演奏自由奔放的狂想曲最适合帮助记忆 rhapsody，可以说 **a dramatic rhapsody — “A pianist may perform a dramatic rhapsody that moves freely between lyrical passages and explosive climaxes.”**

quiz.question: ______ custody
quiz.explanation: 监护; 拘留, 警方拘留. The suspect is in police custody. 嫌疑人被警方拘留。 | custod->守卫（拉丁custos->守卫者），custody->守卫下=监护/拘留（cf. custodian管理员，incustody被拘留，guard守卫） || 文化联想：中文“被警方拘留”最适合帮助记忆 custody，可以说 **police custody — “A suspect may remain in police custody while investigators complete required legal procedures.”**

quiz.question: hardy _____
quiz.explanation: 耐寒的; 强壮的, 耐寒植物. This hardy plant survives harsh winters. 这种耐寒植物能在严冬中生存。 | hardy->大胆/强壮（古法语hardi->大胆），hardy->能抵御严酷条件的（cf. bold大胆，sturdy结实，hardship艰难，hard-core核心） || 文化联想：中国北方花园里耐寒植物最适合帮助记忆 hardy，可以说 **a hardy plant — “A hardy plant can survive cold winters and return vigorously in spring.”**

quiz.question: __ jeopardy
quiz.explanation: 危险, 处于危险中. The project is in jeopardy of cancellation. 该项目处于被取消的危险中。 | jeu->游戏（法语），parti->分（Latin），jeopardy->均等的双方=危险的赌局（cf. jeupardi平分游戏，double jeopardy一罪两审） || 文化联想：中文“处在危险境地”最适合帮助记忆 jeopardy，可以说 **in jeopardy — “A project may be in jeopardy if funding disappears just before construction begins.”**

quiz.question: tardy _____
quiz.explanation: 迟到的; 缓慢的, 迟来的回复. His tardy reply arrived too late. 他迟来的回复来得太晚了。 | tard->慢（拉丁tardus->慢），tardy->行动迟缓=迟到的（cf. retard延迟，tardy迟到，tardiness迟缓） || 文化联想：中文“迟迟才回复”最适合帮助记忆 tardy，可以说 **a tardy reply — “A tardy reply to an urgent message can make the sender think the issue was ignored.”**

quiz.question: sturdy _____
quiz.explanation: 结实的; 坚固的, 坚固的框架. The chair has a sturdy frame. 椅子有坚固的框架。 | sturdy->强壮（古法语estourdi->大胆），sturdy->结实强壮的（cf. robust强壮，hardy耐寒，stout粗壮，stalwart坚定） || 文化联想：中国实木家具结实耐用最适合帮助记忆 sturdy，可以说 **a sturdy frame — “A well-made wooden chair needs a sturdy frame that can support years of daily use.”**

quiz.question: _____ understudy
quiz.explanation: 替角; 替补演员, 舞台替补演员. The stage understudy learned all the lines. 舞台替补演员学会了所有台词。 | under->在下，study->学习，understudy->在别人下面学习以备替换=替补演员（cf. underscore强调，undersell低价售出，underlie是基础） || 文化联想：中国剧场里主演生病时替补演员顶上最适合帮助记忆 understudy，可以说 **a stage understudy — “A stage understudy may suddenly perform the leading role when the principal actor becomes ill.”**

quiz.question: bawdy ____
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的; 下流的, 粗俗的笑话. He told a bawdy joke that embarrassed everyone. 他讲了一个粗俗的笑话,让每个人都感到尴尬。 | bawd->妓院老鸨（来自baud->打算），bawdy->与不正经行为有关的=粗俗（cf. lewd下流，ribald粗俗，bawdiness粗俗） || 文化联想：中文“荤笑话、粗俗笑话”最适合帮助记忆 bawdy，可以说 **a bawdy joke — “A comedian at an adults-only show may tell a bawdy joke that would be inappropriate at a family event.”**

quiz.question: dowdy _____
quiz.explanation: 过时的; 寒酸的, 寒酸的衣服. She wore a dowdy dress to the party. 她穿着寒酸的衣服去参加聚会。 | dowdy->土气（来源不明，可能来自doud->老式衣服），dowdy->过时没品味的（cf. shabby寒酸，frumpy老气，unkempt蓬乱） || 文化联想：中文“穿得土气又过时”最适合帮助记忆 dowdy，可以说 **a dowdy dress — “An old-fashioned, poorly fitted garment may look like a dowdy dress beside more modern clothing.”**

quiz.question: off-key ____
quiz.explanation: 走调的; 不合适的, 走调的音符. The singer hit an off-key note. 歌手唱了一个走调的音符。 | off->偏离，key->调/键，off-key->偏离音调的=走调（cf. on-key准确，flat升降号/平，sharp升调/锋利） || 文化联想：中国KTV里“唱跑调”最适合帮助记忆 off-key，可以说 **sing off-key — “Someone at karaoke may sing off-key but still enjoy the song with friends.”**

quiz.question: _______ lackey
quiz.explanation: 仆从; 走狗, 奴性的走狗. The servile lackey obeyed every command. 奴性的走狗服从每一个命令。 | lackey->侍从（古法语laquais->侍从），lackey->奴颜婢膝的仆人（cf. footman随从，flunky阿谀奉承者，toady马屁精） || 文化联想：中文“狗腿子、跟班”最适合帮助记忆 lackey，可以说 **a servile lackey — “A servile lackey may carry out every order from a powerful boss without question.”**

quiz.question: jockey ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 骑师; 争取, 争取位置. Politicians jockey for position before elections. 政客在选举前争取位置。 | jockey->Jock的爱称=苏格兰人/骑师，jockey->骑师/谋求优势（cf. jockey for position争位，disc jockey唱片骑师=DJ） || 文化联想：中文“抢占有利位置”最适合帮助记忆 jockey，可以说 **jockey for position — “Several companies may jockey for position before a new market becomes highly profitable.”**

quiz.question: _ medley __ _____
quiz.explanation: 混合曲; 杂录, 混合曲调. The band played a medley of tunes. 乐队演奏了混合曲调。 | medley->混合（古法语medlee->混战），medley->多首歌曲混合=混合曲（cf. mingle混合，meddle干涉，melee混战） || 文化联想：春晚或演唱会里的歌曲串烧最适合帮助记忆 medley，可以说 **a medley of songs — “A television gala may end with a medley of familiar songs performed by several singers.”**

quiz.question: galley _______
quiz.explanation: 船上厨房; 单层甲板大帆船, 船上厨房. The boat has a compact galley kitchen. 船上有一个紧凑的厨房。 | galley->大桨船（中世纪拉丁galea），galley->船的厨房在底舱（昔日奴隶划桨处，cf. galley slave桨奴，galley proof校样） || 文化联想：大型邮轮后厨最适合帮助记忆 galley，可以说 **a ship’s galley — “Cooks in a ship’s galley may prepare hundreds of meals each day while the vessel is at sea.”**

quiz.question: ____ pulley
quiz.explanation: 滑轮, 绳索滑轮. The rope pulley lifts heavy loads easily. 绳索滑轮轻松提升重物。 | pulley->滑轮（古法语polie，来自希腊），pulley->绕轴转动的滑轮（cf. pull拉，lever杠杆，block and tackle滑轮组） || 文化联想：中国工地用滑轮吊起重物最适合帮助记忆 pulley，可以说 **a rope pulley — “Workers may use a rope pulley to lift materials to an upper floor with less effort.”**

quiz.question: ____ parley
quiz.explanation: 会谈; 谈判, 举行会谈. The leaders will hold parley to discuss peace. 领导人将举行会谈讨论和平。 | parley->谈话（法语parler->说），parley->两方谈话=谈判（cf. parliament议会=说话的地方，parlor客厅，parole假释=说出词语） || 文化联想：中文“两军先谈一谈再决定是否交战”最适合帮助记忆 parley，可以说 **hold a parley — “Two opposing commanders may hold a parley to discuss terms before fighting continues.”**

quiz.question: motley ____
quiz.explanation: 杂乱的; 混杂的, 杂乱的团队. The pirate ship had a motley crew. 海盗船有一群杂乱的船员。 | motley->混杂（中古英语mottelee->杂色布料），motley->由各种颜色混合的=杂乱的（cf. motley fool宫廷小丑=穿杂色衣服） || 文化联想：中文“大杂烩、五花八门的一群人”最适合帮助记忆 motley，可以说 **a motley crew — “A volunteer team made up of students, retirees, engineers, and shopkeepers can look like a motley crew.”**

quiz.question: _______ prey
quiz.explanation: 猎物; 受害者, 天然猎物. Hawks hunt for their natural prey. 鹰捕猎它们的天然猎物。 | prey->猎物（拉丁praeda），prey->被捕食的猎物（cf. predator捕食者，rapacious贪婪，imprecation诅咒） || 文化联想：中国乡间老鹰抓野兔的画面最适合帮助记忆 prey，可以说 **natural prey — “In open grassland, a rabbit may become natural prey for a hawk.”**

quiz.question: convey _ _______
quiz.explanation: 传达; 运送, 传达信息. The letter will convey a message to the recipient. 这封信将向收件人传达信息。 | con->共同，vey->路（拉丁via），convey->通过路传递=传达（cf. convoy护送，invoice发票，voyage旅程，via经由） || 文化联想：中文“把意思传达到位”最适合帮助记忆 convey，可以说 **convey a message — “A short note can convey a message clearly even without a long explanation.”**

quiz.question: purvey ________
quiz.explanation: 供应; 提供, 供应物资. The company will purvey supplies to the military. 该公司将向军方供应物资。 | pur->提前，vey->看/供应（拉丁videre），purvey->提前看好供应=供应（cf. survey调查，purview管辖范围，provide提供） || 文化联想：中国大型活动给现场供应物资最适合帮助记忆 purvey，可以说 **purvey supplies — “A logistics company may purvey supplies to a large public event.”**

quiz.question: ____ putrefy
quiz.explanation: 腐烂; 使腐败, 肉腐烂. Without refrigeration, meat putrefy quickly. 没有冷藏,肉很快就会腐烂。 | putr->腐烂（拉丁puter），putrify->使腐烂（cf. putrid腐臭的，putrefy腐烂，impute归罪=使腐败） || 文化联想：夏天鱼肉放久后腐败发臭最适合帮助记忆 putrefy，可以说 **putrefy quickly — “Without refrigeration, raw meat can putrefy quickly in hot summer weather.”**

quiz.question: liquefy ______
quiz.explanation: 液化; 使液化, 液化黄油. Heat will liquefy butter in the pan. 加热会使平底锅中的黄油液化。 | liqu->液体（拉丁liquere），liquefy->使成为液体（cf. liquid液体，liquor酒，liqueur利口酒，liquidate清算） || 文化联想：中国厨房里黄油受热融化最适合帮助记忆 liquefy，可以说 **liquefy butter — “Gentle heat will liquefy butter in a pan within minutes.”**

quiz.question: fluffy ______
quiz.explanation: 蓬松的; 柔软的, 蓬松的枕头. The bed has a fluffy pillow for comfort. 床上有一个蓬松的枕头以增加舒适度。 | fluff->松软物（来自flue->绒毛），fluffy->充满松软绒毛的（cf. fuzz绒毛，down鸭绒，fluff松软物） || 文化联想：中国家庭常见的蓬松羽绒枕最适合帮助记忆 fluffy，可以说 **a fluffy pillow — “A fluffy pillow filled with soft down can make a bed feel especially comfortable.”**

quiz.question: stuffy ____
quiz.explanation: 闷热的; 古板的, 闷热的房间. Open the window in this stuffy room. 在这个闷热的房间里打开窗户。 | stuffy->塞满的/通气不良的（stuff->填充），stuffy->通风不畅=闷热/古板的（cf. stuff东西，stuffed填满的，no-nonsense严肃的） || 文化联想：梅雨季不开窗的房间闷得透不过气最适合帮助记忆 stuffy，可以说 **a stuffy room — “A room can become stuffy after hours with the windows closed and many people inside.”**

quiz.question: pacify ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 安抚; 平息, 安抚人群. Police tried to pacify the crowd. 警察试图安抚人群。 | pac->和平（拉丁pax），ify->使，pacify->使和平=安抚（cf. peace和平，appease安抚，pacific太平洋=和平的） || 文化联想：中文“安抚人群、让情绪平静下来”最适合帮助记忆 pacify，可以说 **pacify the crowd — “A calm explanation from organizers may help pacify the crowd after a long delay.”**

quiz.question: edify ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 启发; 教诲, 教诲年轻人. The sermon will edify the young congregation. 布道将教诲年轻的会众。 | edif->建筑（拉丁aedis->神庙），edify->建造精神=启发教诲（cf. edifice大厦，editor编辑=建立的人，education教育=建立心智） || 文化联想：中文“教书育人、启发后辈”最适合帮助记忆 edify，可以说 **edify the young — “A thoughtful teacher can edify the young by combining knowledge with good judgment.”**

quiz.question: solidify _______
quiz.explanation: 巩固; 凝固, 巩固支持. The victory will solidify support for the leader. 胜利将巩固对领导者的支持。 | solid->固体（拉丁solidus），ify->使，solidify->使固化（cf. solid固体，solidarity团结，consolidate巩固） || 文化联想：中文“巩固支持”最适合帮助记忆 solidify，可以说 **solidify support — “A successful public project may solidify support for the team that led it.”**

quiz.question: codify ____
quiz.explanation: 编纂; 整理, 编纂法律. Nations codify laws into legal codes. 国家将法律编纂成法典。 | cod->法典（拉丁codex->木板/法典），ify->使，codify->使成为法典=编纂（cf. code密码/法典，decode解码，encode编码） || 文化联想：中国古代律令整理成系统法典最适合帮助记忆 codify，可以说 **codify laws — “A government may codify laws so that rules are organized into a clear legal code.”**

quiz.question: deify _ ______
quiz.explanation: 神化; 奉为神明, 神化领导者. Ancient Romans would deify a leader after death. 古罗马人会在领导者死后将其神化。 | dei->神（拉丁deus），ify->使，deify->使成为神（cf. deity神灵，divine神圣，adieu再见=向神告别） || 文化联想：中文“把某个人神化”最适合帮助记忆 deify，可以说 **deify a leader — “A propaganda system may deify a leader by portraying that person as nearly infallible.”**

quiz.question: vilify __________
quiz.explanation: 诽谤; 中伤, 诽谤名誉. Opponents tried to vilify reputation unfairly. 反对者试图不公平地诽谤名誉。 | vil->卑鄙（拉丁vilis->低劣），ify->使，vilify->使显得卑鄙=诽谤（cf. vile卑鄙，villain恶棍，revile谴责） || 文化联想：中文“抹黑、把人说得一无是处”最适合帮助记忆 vilify，可以说 **vilify an opponent — “A campaign may vilify an opponent with personal attacks instead of debating policy.”**

quiz.question: nullify _ ________
quiz.explanation: 废除; 使无效, 废除合同. The court will nullify a contract due to fraud. 法院将因欺诈而废除合同。 | null->无（拉丁nullus），ify->使，nullify->使成为零=废除（cf. null无效，annul废除，nullity无效，annullment撤销） || 文化联想：中文“让合同作废”最适合帮助记忆 nullify，可以说 **nullify a contract — “Fraud can sometimes nullify a contract if the agreement was obtained dishonestly.”**

quiz.question: amplify _____
quiz.explanation: 放大; 扩大, 放大声音. Speakers amplify sound at the concert. 扬声器在音乐会上放大声音。 | ampl->充足（拉丁amplus），ify->使，amplify->使充足=放大（cf. ample充足，amplitude振幅，amplifier放大器） || 文化联想：中国演唱会里的扩音设备最适合帮助记忆 amplify，可以说 **amplify sound — “Large speakers amplify sound so thousands of people can hear the performance.”**

quiz.question: exemplify ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 举例说明; 例证, 例证规则. This case will exemplify the rule clearly. 这个案例将清楚地例证规则。 | exempl->例子（拉丁exemplum），ify->使，exemplify->用例子说明（cf. example例子，exemplar典范，exempt豁免） || 文化联想：中文“举个例子就说明白了”最适合帮助记忆 exemplify，可以说 **exemplify the rule — “A simple everyday case can exemplify the rule better than an abstract definition.”**

quiz.question: ramify ________
quiz.explanation: 分支; 分枝, 分支. The consequences will ramify branches throughout society. 后果将在整个社会分支。 | ram->树枝（拉丁ramus），ify->使，ramify->使产生树枝=分支（cf. ramus枝，ramification分支/后果，branch分枝） || 文化联想：中文“影响像树枝一样不断分叉扩散”最适合帮助记忆 ramify，可以说 **ramify through society — “A major policy change can ramify through society in ways that were not obvious at first.”**

quiz.question: magnify _______
quiz.explanation: 放大; 夸大, 放大结果. The microscope will magnify results for viewing. 显微镜将放大结果以供观看。 | magn->大（拉丁magnus），ify->使，magnify->使变大=放大（cf. magnificent宏伟，magnanimous宽宏，magnum大号） || 文化联想：中国实验室显微镜把细节放大最适合帮助记忆 magnify，可以说 **magnify an image — “A microscope can magnify an image so tiny structures become visible.”**

quiz.question: signify ______
quiz.explanation: 表示; 意味, 表示意图. His actions signify intent to cooperate. 他的行动表示合作的意图。 | sign->标记（拉丁signum），ify->使，signify->使有标记=表示含义（cf. sign标志，signal信号，significant显著，insignificant微不足道） || 文化联想：中文“这代表着什么意思”最适合帮助记忆 signify，可以说 **signify intent — “A signed agreement may signify intent to cooperate more formally.”**

quiz.question: indemnify ______
quiz.explanation: 赔偿; 保障, 赔偿损失. Insurance will indemnify losses from the accident. 保险将赔偿事故造成的损失。 | in->否定，damn->损害（拉丁damnum），indemnify->抵消损害=赔偿（cf. damage损害，condemn谴责，damned该死的） || 文化联想：中国保险理赔最适合帮助记忆 indemnify，可以说 **indemnify losses — “An insurance policy may indemnify losses caused by a covered accident.”**

quiz.question: clarify _____
quiz.explanation: 澄清; 阐明, 澄清要点. Let me clarify point I made earlier. 让我澄清我之前提出的要点。 | clar->清楚（拉丁clarus），ify->使，clarify->使清楚=澄清（cf. clear清楚，clarity清晰，declare宣布，clairvoyant千里眼） || 文化联想：中文“把问题说清楚”最适合帮助记忆 clarify，可以说 **clarify a point — “A teacher may draw a diagram to clarify a difficult point.”**

quiz.question: verify _ _____
quiz.explanation: 核实; 证实, 核实声明. Fact-checkers verify a claim before publication. 事实核查员在发布前核实声明。 | ver->真（拉丁verus），ify->使，verify->使真实=核实（cf. veracious真实，verdict裁决，verisimilar逼真，aver断言） || 文化联想：中国事实核查最适合帮助记忆 verify，可以说 **verify a claim — “A journalist should verify a claim before publishing it as fact.”**

quiz.question: glorify ________
quiz.explanation: 美化; 颂扬, 美化暴力. Movies should not glorify violence unnecessarily. 电影不应该不必要地美化暴力。 | glori->荣耀（拉丁gloria），ify->使，glorify->使有荣耀=美化（cf. glory荣耀，glorious光荣的，vainglorious自负的） || 文化联想：中文“别把暴力包装成英雄主义”最适合帮助记忆 glorify，可以说 **glorify violence — “A film can depict conflict without trying to glorify violence.”**

quiz.question: vitrify ____
quiz.explanation: 使玻璃化, 使粘土玻璃化. High heat will vitrify clay into pottery. 高温会使粘土玻璃化成陶器。 | vitrum->玻璃（拉丁），vitrify->使变成玻璃（cf. vitreous玻璃状的，vitriol硫酸=腐蚀性玻璃，in vitro体外实验） || 文化联想：景德镇高温烧瓷时坯体发生玻璃化最适合帮助记忆 vitrify，可以说 **vitrify clay — “High kiln temperatures can vitrify clay and make ceramic bodies dense and hard.”**

quiz.question: purify _____
quiz.explanation: 净化; 提纯, 净化水. Filters purify water for drinking. 过滤器净化饮用水。 | pur->纯（拉丁purus），ify->使，purify->使纯洁（cf. pure纯，purity纯洁，purge清除，impure不纯） || 文化联想：中国家庭净水器最适合帮助记忆 purify，可以说 **purify water — “A good filtration system can purify water by removing many unwanted contaminants.”**

quiz.question: falsify _______
quiz.explanation: 伪造; 篡改, 伪造记录. Its illegal to falsify records. 伪造记录是非法的。 | fals->假（拉丁falsus），ify->使，falsify->使成为假的=伪造（cf. false假，fallacy谬误，infallible不会错，default违约） || 文化联想：中文“篡改账目”最适合帮助记忆 falsify，可以说 **falsify records — “An employee who changes financial data dishonestly may falsify records.”**

quiz.question: emulsify _____
quiz.explanation: 使乳化, 使酱汁乳化. Whisking will emulsify sauce ingredients. 搅拌会使酱汁成分乳化。 | emuls->榨出（拉丁emulgere->榨取），emulsify->使成为乳液（cf. emulsion乳液，milk牛奶，emulsifier乳化剂） || 文化联想：中国厨房调沙拉酱或蛋黄酱最适合帮助记忆 emulsify，可以说 **emulsify a sauce — “Whisking oil and egg yolk together can emulsify a sauce into a smooth mixture.”**

quiz.question: intensify _______
quiz.explanation: 加强; 强化, 加强努力. We must intensify efforts to meet the deadline. 我们必须加强努力以按时完成。 | intens->紧绷（拉丁intensus），ify->使，intensify->使更紧绷=加强（cf. intense强烈，tension紧张，intensive密集） || 文化联想：中文“加大力度”最适合帮助记忆 intensify，可以说 **intensify efforts — “Rescue teams may intensify efforts when bad weather is approaching.”**

quiz.question: classify ____
quiz.explanation: 分类; 归类, 分类数据. Scientists classify data into categories. 科学家将数据分类。 | class->类别（拉丁classis），ify->使，classify->使归入类别=分类（cf. class班级/类，classic经典，classification分类） || 文化联想：中文“分门别类”最适合帮助记忆 classify，可以说 **classify data — “Researchers may classify data by age, region, or category before analysis.”**

quiz.question: ossify ____ _______
quiz.explanation: 骨化; 僵化, 僵化成常规. Procedures can ossify into routine over time. 程序随着时间推移会僵化成常规。 | os->骨（拉丁os），ify->使，ossify->使硬化如骨=僵化（cf. osseous骨质的，ossification骨化，petrify使石化） || 文化联想：中文“老规矩越久越僵、最后制度僵化”最适合帮助记忆 ossify，可以说 **ossify into routine — “A flexible procedure can ossify into routine if no one questions it for years.”**

quiz.question: ratify _ ______
quiz.explanation: 批准; 认可, 批准条约. Congress must ratify a treaty before it takes effect. 国会必须批准条约才能生效。 | rat->认为有效（拉丁ratus），ify->使，ratify->使被认为有效=批准（cf. ratio比例，rate评价，irrational不理性） || 文化联想：中国学生学习国际条约程序时最适合帮助记忆 ratify，可以说 **ratify a treaty — “A legislature may need to ratify a treaty before it becomes binding.”**

quiz.question: stratify _______
quiz.explanation: 分层; 使分层, 使社会分层. Economic inequality will stratify society. 经济不平等会使社会分层。 | strat->层（拉丁stratum），ify->使，stratify->使成层=分层（cf. stratum地层，strategy战略，stratosphere平流层） || 文化联想：中文“社会分层”最适合帮助记忆 stratify，可以说 **stratify society — “Large and persistent income gaps can stratify society into sharply separated groups.”**

quiz.question: rectify _____
quiz.explanation: 纠正; 改正, 纠正错误. The company will rectify error immediately. 公司将立即纠正错误。 | rect->直（拉丁rectus），ify->使，rectify->使变直=纠正（cf. correct纠正，direction方向，erect直立，rectangle长方形） || 文化联想：中文“把错误纠正过来”最适合帮助记忆 rectify，可以说 **rectify an error — “An accountant may issue a corrected report to rectify an error in the original figures.”**

quiz.question: sanctify ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使神圣; 批准, 使结合神圣. The ceremony will sanctify the union. 仪式将使结合神圣。 | sanct->神圣（拉丁sanctus），ify->使，sanctify->使神圣（cf. saint圣人，sanctuary圣所，sanction制裁/批准） || 文化联想：sanctify 是“使神圣”，可用宗教婚礼把结合视为神圣盟约来记忆，可以说 **sanctify the union — “In a religious ceremony, the couple may ask the ritual to sanctify the union.”**

quiz.question: fructify _____
quiz.explanation: 使结果实; 使成功, 使计划成功. Hard work will fructify plans eventually. 努力工作最终会使计划成功。 | fruct->果实（拉丁fructus），ify->使，fructify->使结果实=使成功（cf. fruit水果，fructose果糖，usufruct使用权） || 文化联想：中文“让计划开花结果”最适合帮助记忆 fructify，可以说 **fructify a plan — “Patient investment and good execution can fructify a plan that once existed only on paper.”**

quiz.question: stultify ______
quiz.explanation: 使显得愚蠢; 阻碍, 阻碍增长. Excessive regulation can stultify growth. 过度监管会阻碍增长。 | stult->愚蠢（拉丁stultus），ify->使，stultify->使显得愚蠢/阻碍（cf. stultification阻碍，stolid迟钝，dull愚钝） || 文化联想：中文“扼杀成长、让人越来越不会思考”最适合帮助记忆 stultify，可以说 **stultify growth — “A rigid environment can stultify growth by discouraging curiosity and experimentation.”**

quiz.question: fortify ________
quiz.explanation: 加强; 巩固, 加强防御. The army will fortify defenses along the border. 军队将加强边境防御。 | fort->强壮（拉丁fortis），ify->使，fortify->使强壮=加强（cf. forte长处，fortress要塞，effort努力，comfort安慰） || 文化联想：中国古城墙加固防御最适合帮助记忆 fortify，可以说 **fortify defenses — “Engineers may fortify defenses around a vulnerable site before a major storm.”**

quiz.question: mortify _____
quiz.explanation: 使蒙羞; 使屈辱, 使骄傲蒙羞. The defeat will mortify pride of the team. 失败会使球队的骄傲蒙羞。 | mort->死（拉丁mors），ify->使，mortify->使感到像死一样=使蒙羞（cf. mortal死亡，immortal不死，mortgage抵押=死亡的承诺） || 文化联想：中文“丢脸丢到想找个地缝钻进去”最适合帮助记忆 mortify，可以说 **mortify one’s pride — “Being publicly corrected after boasting may mortify one’s pride.”**

quiz.question: testify _____ ____
quiz.explanation: 作证; 证明, 宣誓作证. Witnesses must testify under oath in court. 证人必须在法庭上宣誓作证。 | test->见证（拉丁testis->证人），ify->使，testify->作为证人说明（cf. testament遗嘱，attest证明，protest抗议，testimony证词） || 文化联想：中文“出庭宣誓作证”最适合帮助记忆 testify，可以说 **testify under oath — “A witness may testify under oath and answer questions about what was seen.”**

quiz.question: stagy ______
quiz.explanation: 做作的; 夸张的, 做作的表演. The stagy acting ruined the dramatic scene. 做作的表演破坏了戏剧场景。 | stage->舞台，stagy->像在舞台上一样夸张=做作的（cf. stage舞台，stagecraft舞台技巧，upstage抢风头） || 文化联想：中文“演得太舞台腔、装腔作势”最适合帮助记忆 stagy，可以说 **stagy acting — “A film performance can feel stagy when every gesture is exaggerated like theater.”**

quiz.question: stodgy ____
quiz.explanation: 油腻的; 古板的, 油腻的食物. The restaurant serves heavy, stodgy food. 餐厅提供厚重油腻的食物。 | stodgy->填满（stodge->填满），stodgy->厚重难消化的=油腻/古板（cf. solid固体，stolid迟钝，stout粗壮，heavy重） || 文化联想：中文“又厚重又腻、吃几口就撑”最适合帮助记忆 stodgy，可以说 **stodgy food — “A meal heavy with dense starch and little freshness can feel stodgy.”**

quiz.question: _______ elegy
quiz.explanation: 挽歌; 哀歌, 葬礼挽歌. The poet wrote a moving funeral elegy. 诗人写了一首感人的葬礼挽歌。 | elegy->悲歌（希腊elegeia，来自elegos->哀叹），elegy->哀悼诗（cf. eulogy悼词=好话，elegy哀歌，elegiac哀伤的） || 文化联想：中国追悼会上的哀歌最适合帮助记忆 elegy，可以说 **a funeral elegy — “A poet may write a funeral elegy to mourn the death of a respected friend.”**

quiz.question: flaggy ________
quiz.explanation: 板状的; 松弛的, 板状沉积物. The geologist studied flaggy sediment layers. 地质学家研究板状沉积物层。 | flaggy->板岩状（flag->石板），flaggy->薄板状的（cf. flagstone石板，flag旗帜/石板，flagging疲倦的/铺石板） || 文化联想：中文“像旗子一样松垮下垂”最适合帮助记忆 flaggy，可以说 **flaggy sediment — “Soft, flaggy sediment may hang loosely instead of forming a firm layer.”**

quiz.question: ____ buggy
quiz.explanation: 婴儿车; 小车, 婴儿车. She pushed the baby buggy through the park. 她推着婴儿车穿过公园。 | buggy->小车（来源不明，可能来自bug=虫），buggy->小型轻便车（cf. bug虫，buggy软件缺陷多的，baby carriage婴儿车） || 文化联想：中国婴儿车最适合帮助记忆 buggy，可以说 **a baby buggy — “Parents may push a baby buggy through a park on a sunny afternoon.”**

quiz.question: _____ prodigy
quiz.explanation: 神童; 奇才, 神童. Mozart was a musical child prodigy. 莫扎特是音乐神童。 | prodig->奇异（拉丁prodigium->神迹），prodigy->神迹般的才能=神童（cf. prodigious巨大，prodigal挥霍，prodigy天才） || 文化联想：中国人口中的“小神童”最适合帮助记忆 prodigy，可以说 **a child prodigy — “A child prodigy may perform difficult piano works years earlier than most students.”**

quiz.question: effigy _______
quiz.explanation: 肖像; 雕像, 焚烧肖像. Protesters engaged in effigy burning. 抗议者进行焚烧肖像。 | ef->向外，fig->形状/面貌（拉丁fingere），effigy->模拟的形象=肖像（cf. figure形状，figurine小雕像，disfigure破坏外貌） || 文化联想：中文“烧毁某人的雕像以示抗议”最适合帮助记忆 effigy，可以说 **burn an effigy — “Protesters may burn an effigy as a symbolic expression of anger toward a public figure.”**

quiz.question: mangy ___
quiz.explanation: 生疥癣的; 肮脏的, 生疥癣的狗. A mangy dog wandered the streets. 一只生疥癣的狗在街上游荡。 | mange->疥癣（法语，来自拉丁manducare->吃），mangy->被疥癣虫吃掉毛的（cf. mange疥癣，mangy肮脏的，manger马槽） || 文化联想：中国流浪狗毛发打结、脏乱的样子最适合帮助记忆 mangy，可以说 **a mangy dog — “A neglected stray may look like a mangy dog with patchy, unhealthy fur.”**

quiz.question: stingy ______
quiz.explanation: 吝啬的; 小气的, 吝啬的人. The stingy person never tipped servers. 吝啬的人从不给服务员小费。 | sting->刺（象声词），stingy->像蜇刺一样不肯放开钱（cf. sting刺，stringent严格，stinginess吝啬） || 文化联想：中文“铁公鸡、一毛不拔”最适合帮助记忆 stingy，可以说 **a stingy person — “A stingy person may refuse to contribute even a small amount to a shared meal.”**

quiz.question: spongy ______
quiz.explanation: 海绵状的; 柔软的, 海绵状组织. The spongy tissue absorbs moisture. 海绵状组织吸收水分。 | sponge->海绵（希腊spongos），spongy->像海绵一样多孔的（cf. sponge海绵，sponge on蹭饭，spontaneous自发） || 文化联想：中国生物课里的海绵组织最适合帮助记忆 spongy，可以说 **spongy tissue — “Some plant structures contain spongy tissue with many small air spaces.”**

quiz.question: ______ pedagogy
quiz.explanation: 教育学; 教学法, 现代教育学. Modern pedagogy emphasizes active learning. 现代教育学强调主动学习。 | ped->儿童（希腊pais），agogy->引导，pedagogy->引导儿童的学问=教育学（cf. pedant学究，pediatrics儿科，pedagogue教师） || 文化联想：中文“教学方法”最适合帮助记忆 pedagogy，可以说 **modern pedagogy — “Modern pedagogy often emphasizes active learning rather than memorization alone.”**

quiz.question: _____ genealogy
quiz.explanation: 家谱学; 宗谱, 追溯家谱. Many people trace genealogy online now. 现在许多人在网上追溯家谱。 | geneal->出生/世代（希腊genea），logy->学问，genealogy->研究世代的学问=家谱学（cf. gene基因，genesis起源，genial和蔼） || 文化联想：中国家谱追溯祖先最适合帮助记忆 genealogy，可以说 **trace a genealogy — “A family may trace a genealogy through old clan records and ancestral names.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ analogy
quiz.explanation: 类比; 相似, 做类比. Teachers draw an analogy to explain concepts. 教师做类比来解释概念。 | ana->按比例（希腊），logy->说/比例，analogy->按比例说明=类比（cf. analog模拟，analogous类似，homologous同源） || 文化联想：中文“打个比方”最适合帮助记忆 analogy，可以说 **draw an analogy — “A teacher may draw an analogy between electrical current and flowing water to explain a new concept.”**

quiz.question: _____ pharmacology
quiz.explanation: 药理学, 研究药理学. Medical students study pharmacology extensively. 医学生广泛研究药理学。 | pharmac->药（希腊pharmakon），logy->学问，pharmacology->研究药物的学问（cf. pharmacy药店，pharmaceutical药物的，antidote解毒剂） || 文化联想：中国药学院研究药物作用最适合帮助记忆 pharmacology，可以说 **study pharmacology — “Medical students study pharmacology to understand how drugs act in the body.”**

quiz.question: _____ archaeology
quiz.explanation: 考古学, 研究考古学. She decided to study archaeology in college. 她决定在大学研究考古学。 | archae->古代（希腊archaios），logy->学问，archaeology->研究古代的学问（cf. archaic古老的，archive档案，arcane秘密的） || 文化联想：西安考古工地最适合帮助记忆 archaeology，可以说 **study archaeology — “Students may study archaeology by examining artifacts, layers of soil, and ancient structures.”**

quiz.question: speleology ____
quiz.explanation: 洞穴学, 洞穴学俱乐部. The speleology club explores underground caves. 洞穴学俱乐部探索地下洞穴。 | speleo->洞穴（希腊spelaion），logy->学问，speleology->研究洞穴的学问（cf. cave洞穴，spelunking洞穴探险） || 文化联想：中国喀斯特地区洞穴调查最适合帮助记忆 speleology，可以说 **a speleology club — “A university speleology club may explore limestone caves and map underground passages.”**

quiz.question: ______ psychology
quiz.explanation: 心理学, 社会心理学. Social psychology examines group behavior. 社会心理学研究群体行为。 | psych->心灵（希腊psyche），logy->学问，psychology->研究心灵的学问（cf. psyche心灵，psychoanalysis心理分析，psychiatry精神病学） || 文化联想：中国大学心理系最适合帮助记忆 psychology，可以说 **social psychology — “A social psychology course may examine how group pressure influences individual decisions.”**

quiz.question: ________ pathology
quiz.explanation: 病理学, 临床病理学. Clinical pathology diagnoses diseases through lab tests. 临床病理学通过实验室检查诊断疾病。 | path->痛苦/疾病（希腊pathos），logy->学问，pathology->研究疾病的学问（cf. sympathy同情，empathy共情，apathy冷漠） || 文化联想：中国医院病理科最适合帮助记忆 pathology，可以说 **clinical pathology — “Clinical pathology helps doctors diagnose disease through laboratory examination of blood and tissue.”**

quiz.question: _____ ornithology
quiz.explanation: 鸟类学, 研究鸟类学. Birdwatchers often study ornithology. 观鸟者经常研究鸟类学。 | ornitho->鸟（希腊ornis），logy->学问，ornithology->研究鸟类的学问（cf. ornithologist鸟类学家，Ornith-） || 文化联想：中国自然保护区里的观鸟研究最适合帮助记忆 ornithology，可以说 **study ornithology — “A student who loves birds may study ornithology and spend mornings identifying species in wetlands.”**

quiz.question: ______ anthology
quiz.explanation: 选集; 文选, 诗歌选集. The poetry anthology contains classic works. 诗歌选集包含经典作品。 | antho->花（希腊anthos），logy->收集，anthology->收集的花=选集（cf. anthology花束=精选，antholysis花的分解，chrysanthemum菊花） || 文化联想：中国古诗词选本最适合帮助记忆 anthology，可以说 **a poetry anthology — “A poetry anthology may collect selected works from Li Bai, Du Fu, and many other poets.”**

quiz.question: ___________ philology
quiz.explanation: 语言学; 文献学, 比较语言学. Comparative philology studies language relationships. 比较语言学研究语言关系。 | philo->热爱（希腊），logy->说/学问，philology->热爱语言的学问=语言学（cf. philosophy哲学，philanthropy慈善，bibliophile爱书人） || 文化联想：中国大学中文系做古文字和语言史研究最适合帮助记忆 philology，可以说 **comparative philology — “A scholar may use comparative philology to study how related words changed across languages over time.”**

quiz.question: _____ etymology
quiz.explanation: 词源学, 研究词源学. Linguists study etymology to trace word origins. 语言学家研究词源学来追溯词源。 | etymon->真实的词（希腊），logy->学问，etymology->追溯词真实来源的学问（cf. etym真实，epistemology认识论） || 文化联想：中文“追根溯源看一个词从哪儿来”最适合帮助记忆 etymology，可以说 **study etymology — “A language learner may study etymology to see how a modern word developed from an older root.”**

quiz.question: _____ ethnology
quiz.explanation: 民族学, 研究民族学. Anthropologists study ethnology of indigenous peoples. 人类学家研究土著民族的民族学。 | ethno->民族（希腊ethnos），logy->学问，ethnology->研究民族的学问（cf. ethnic民族的，ethnocentric民族中心主义） || 文化联想：中国民族学博物馆研究不同民族文化最适合帮助记忆 ethnology，可以说 **study ethnology — “Researchers may study ethnology by comparing customs, kinship, dress, and ritual across communities.”**

quiz.question: _____ terminology
quiz.explanation: 术语; 专门用语, 法律术语. Legal terminology can be confusing. 法律术语可能令人困惑。 | termin->界限/术语（拉丁terminus），logy->学问，terminology->研究专业术语的学问（cf. terminal终端，determine决定，exterminate消灭） || 文化联想：中文“法律术语”最适合帮助记忆 terminology，可以说 **legal terminology — “A law student must learn legal terminology before reading complex court opinions efficiently.”**

quiz.question: _______ numerology
quiz.explanation: 数字命理学, 中国数字命理学. Chinese numerology assigns meanings to numbers. 中国数字命理学赋予数字意义。 | numer->数（拉丁numerus），logy->学问，numerology->赋予数字神秘意义的学问（cf. numeral数字，numerous众多，innumerable无数） || 文化联想：中国传统命理里常把数字赋予吉凶意义，最适合帮助记忆 numerology，可以说 **Chinese numerology — “Popular Chinese numerology may attach symbolic meanings to numbers such as eight or four.”**

quiz.question: _____ meteorology
quiz.explanation: 气象学, 研究气象学. Weather forecasters study meteorology. 天气预报员研究气象学。 | meteor->大气现象（希腊meteoros->高空的），logy->学问，meteorology->研究大气现象的学问（cf. meteor流星，meteorite陨石） || 文化联想：中国气象局天气预报最适合帮助记忆 meteorology，可以说 **study meteorology — “A student may study meteorology to understand clouds, pressure systems, storms, and forecasting.”**

quiz.question: _____ horology
quiz.explanation: 钟表学, 研究钟表学. Watchmakers study horology to master their craft. 制表师研究钟表学以掌握技艺。 | hor->时间/小时（希腊hora），logy->学问，horology->研究时间测量的学问（cf. hour小时，horoscope星相=时间的观测） || 文化联想：故宫钟表馆最适合帮助记忆 horology，可以说 **study horology — “A museum conservator may study horology to understand the design and repair of historic clocks.”**

quiz.question: _______ petrology
quiz.explanation: 岩石学, 火成岩石学. Igneous petrology studies volcanic rocks. 火成岩石学研究火山岩。 | petro->石（希腊petra），logy->学问，petrology->研究岩石的学问（cf. petroleum石油，Peter彼得=磐石，petrify使石化） || 文化联想：中国地质大学研究火成岩最适合帮助记忆 petrology，可以说 **igneous petrology — “A geology student may study igneous petrology by examining minerals and textures in volcanic rock.”**

quiz.question: ___ astrology
quiz.explanation: 占星术, 流行占星术. Pop astrology appears in many magazines. 流行占星术出现在许多杂志中。 | astro->星（希腊astron），logy->学问，astrology->从星象预测的学问（cf. astronomy天文学=星的法则，astronaut宇航员） || 文化联想：astrology 是占星术，可用中国学生学习西方星座文化时来记忆，可以说 **popular astrology — “A magazine may publish popular astrology that links zodiac signs with personality traits.”**

quiz.question: ________ neurology
quiz.explanation: 神经学, 临床神经学. Clinical neurology treats nervous system disorders. 临床神经学治疗神经系统疾病。 | neur->神经（希腊neuron），logy->学问，neurology->研究神经的学问（cf. neuron神经元，neurosis神经症，neural神经的） || 文化联想：中国医院神经内科最适合帮助记忆 neurology，可以说 **clinical neurology — “Clinical neurology focuses on disorders of the brain, spinal cord, nerves, and muscles.”**

quiz.question: _____ paleontology
quiz.explanation: 古生物学, 研究古生物学. Scientists study paleontology to learn about dinosaurs. 科学家研究古生物学以了解恐龙。 | paleo->古老（希腊palaios），onto->存在，logy->学问，paleontology->研究古代存在的学问（cf. archaic古老，ontology本体论） || 文化联想：中国恐龙化石博物馆最适合帮助记忆 paleontology，可以说 **study paleontology — “A student may study paleontology by examining fossils that reveal ancient life.”**

quiz.question: _____ gerontology
quiz.explanation: 老年学, 研究老年学. Doctors study gerontology to treat aging patients. 医生研究老年学以治疗老年患者。 | geronto->老人（希腊geron），logy->学问，gerontology->研究老年的学问（cf. gerontocracy老人统治，geriatric老年医学） || 文化联想：中国老龄化研究最适合帮助记忆 gerontology，可以说 **study gerontology — “Researchers study gerontology to understand aging from biological, psychological, and social perspectives.”**

quiz.question: _____ histology
quiz.explanation: 组织学, 研究组织学. Medical students study histology under microscopes. 医学生在显微镜下研究组织学。 | histo->组织（希腊histos->织布），logy->学问，histology->研究组织的学问（cf. history历史=织成的东西，histogram直方图） || 文化联想：中国医学院显微镜下看组织切片最适合帮助记忆 histology，可以说 **study histology — “Medical students study histology by examining thin tissue sections under a microscope.”**

quiz.question: ____ cytology
quiz.explanation: 细胞学, 细胞细胞学. Cell cytology examines cellular structure. 细胞细胞学检查细胞结构。 | cyto->细胞（希腊kytos），logy->学问，cytology->研究细胞的学问（cf. cytoplasm细胞质，lymphocyte淋巴细胞，eukaryote真核生物） || 文化联想：中国医院细胞学检查最适合帮助记忆 cytology，可以说 **cell cytology — “A laboratory may use cytology to examine individual cells for abnormal changes.”**

quiz.question: _______ _ eulogy
quiz.explanation: 悼词; 颂词, 致悼词. The son will deliver a eulogy at the funeral. 儿子将在葬礼上致悼词。 | eu->好，logy->说，eulogy->说好话=颂词/悼词（cf. euphemism委婉说法，euphoria兴奋，eugenics优生学，elegy挽歌） || 文化联想：中国追悼会上对逝者生平的赞颂最适合帮助记忆 eulogy，可以说 **deliver a eulogy — “A close friend may deliver a eulogy that recalls the character and achievements of the person who died.”**

quiz.question: ______ allergy
quiz.explanation: 过敏, 花生过敏. She has a severe peanut allergy. 她有严重的花生过敏。 | allos->其他（希腊），erg->活动，allergy->对其他物质的过度反应=过敏（cf. energy能量，allergic过敏的，allergen过敏原） || 文化联想：中国学校常见的花生过敏提醒最适合帮助记忆 allergy，可以说 **a peanut allergy — “A child with a severe peanut allergy must avoid foods that may contain traces of peanuts.”**

quiz.question: _____ metallurgy
quiz.explanation: 冶金学, 研究冶金学. Engineers study metallurgy to understand metals. 工程师研究冶金学以了解金属。 | metall->金属（希腊metallon），urgy->工艺，metallurgy->金属工艺的学问（cf. metal金属，metallic金属的，alloy合金） || 文化联想：中国钢铁厂最适合帮助记忆 metallurgy，可以说 **study metallurgy — “An engineering student may study metallurgy to understand how metals are extracted, processed, and strengthened.”**

quiz.question: ______ oligarchy
quiz.explanation: 寡头政治, 统治寡头. The ruling oligarchy controlled all wealth. 统治寡头控制了所有财富。 | oligo->少数（希腊oligos），archy->统治，oligarchy->少数人统治（cf. oligopoly寡头垄断，aristocracy贵族，democracy民主） || 文化联想：oligarchy 是政治学里的“少数人统治”，可用课堂中的权力集中概念来记忆，可以说 **a ruling oligarchy — “A country may be described as a ruling oligarchy when a small elite controls most political power.”**

quiz.question: matriarchy _______
quiz.explanation: 母系社会, 母系社会. The matriarchy society was led by women. 母系社会由女性领导。 | matri->母亲（拉丁mater），archy->统治，matriarchy->母亲统治（cf. patriarch族长，matrix母体，matrimony婚姻=母亲之道） || 文化联想：中文“母系家庭结构”可帮助记忆 matriarchy，但两者不完全等价，可以说 **a matriarchal society — “Anthropologists may describe a society as matriarchal when women hold unusually strong authority in family or social organization.”**

quiz.question: _____ anarchy
quiz.explanation: 无政府状态, 完全无政府状态. The revolution led to total anarchy. 革命导致完全无政府状态。 | an->无，archy->统治，anarchy->无统治=无政府（cf. anarchist无政府主义者，monarchy君主制，hierarchy等级制度） || 文化联想：中文“天下大乱、无人管束”最适合帮助记忆 anarchy，可以说 **total anarchy — “When formal authority collapses completely, a city may descend into total anarchy.”**

quiz.question: ________ monarchy
quiz.explanation: 君主制, 绝对君主制. France had an absolute monarchy before the revolution. 法国在革命前有绝对君主制。 | mono->一人（希腊），archy->统治，monarchy->一人统治=君主制（cf. monopoly垄断，monologue独白，monogamy一夫一妻） || 文化联想：monarchy 是“君主制”，可用中国学生学习欧洲王室制度时来记忆，可以说 **an absolute monarchy — “In an absolute monarchy, the monarch holds very broad governing power.”**

quiz.question: starchy ____
quiz.explanation: 含淀粉的, 含淀粉的食物. Potatoes are starchy food high in carbohydrates. 土豆是碳水化合物含量高的含淀粉食物。 | starch->淀粉（古英语stercan->使硬），starchy->含淀粉的/死板的（cf. starch淀粉，stiff硬的，starchy也指刻板） || 文化联想：中国人吃馒头、米饭这类淀粉多的食物最适合帮助记忆 starchy，可以说 **starchy food — “Rice, noodles, and steamed buns are familiar examples of starchy food.”**

quiz.question: sketchy ____
quiz.explanation: 粗略的; 可疑的, 粗略的计划. The sketchy plan lacked important details. 粗略的计划缺少重要细节。 | sketch->素描（荷兰语schets->轮廓），sketchy->只有轮廓的=粗略/可疑（cf. sketch素描，sketchy design粗略设计，shady可疑） || 文化联想：中文“计划很粗糙、细节不清楚”最适合帮助记忆 sketchy，可以说 **a sketchy plan — “A sketchy plan with no budget or timeline is unlikely to survive serious review.”**

quiz.question: touchy _______
quiz.explanation: 敏感的; 易怒的, 敏感的话题. Politics is a touchy subject at family dinners. 政治在家庭晚餐上是敏感的话题。 | touch->触摸，touchy->一触就跳=敏感的（cf. touch接触，touching感人的，out of touch脱节） || 文化联想：中文“这个话题很敏感，一说就容易翻脸”最适合帮助记忆 touchy，可以说 **a touchy subject — “Family money can become a touchy subject when inheritance is involved.”**

quiz.question: _______ calligraphy
quiz.explanation: 书法, 中国书法. Chinese calligraphy is an ancient art form. 中国书法是一种古老的艺术形式。 | calli->美丽（希腊kalos），graphy->书写，calligraphy->美丽的书写=书法（cf. callisthenics健美操，kaleidoscope万花筒=美丽的形状） || 文化联想：中国毛笔书法最适合帮助记忆 calligraphy，可以说 **Chinese calligraphy — “Chinese calligraphy turns written characters into an art of line, rhythm, and balance.”**

quiz.question: ______ discography
quiz.explanation: 唱片目录, 艺术家唱片目录. The artist discography lists all recordings. 艺术家唱片目录列出所有录音。 | disc->圆盘/唱片（拉丁discus），graphy->记录，discography->唱片的记录=唱片目录（cf. disk磁盘，disco迪斯科，discus铁饼） || 文化联想：中国歌手把多年发行的专辑整理成作品目录最适合帮助记忆 discography，可以说 **an artist’s discography — “A music fan may explore an artist’s discography album by album in chronological order.”**

quiz.question: ______ choreography
quiz.explanation: 编舞; 舞蹈设计, 芭蕾编舞. The ballet choreography was innovative and beautiful. 芭蕾编舞创新且美丽。 | chore->舞蹈（希腊choreia），graphy->记录/设计，choreography->设计舞蹈动作（cf. chorus合唱，choir合唱团，choral合唱的） || 文化联想：中国舞剧编舞最适合帮助记忆 choreography，可以说 **ballet choreography — “A choreographer may design ballet choreography that coordinates every movement with the music.”**

quiz.question: _________ autobiography
quiz.explanation: 自传, 名人自传. The celebrity autobiography became a bestseller. 名人自传成为畅销书。 | auto->自己，bio->生命，graphy->书写，autobiography->自己写自己的生命=自传（cf. biology生物学，biography传记，autobiographical自传的） || 文化联想：中国明星出版自传最适合帮助记忆 autobiography，可以说 **a celebrity autobiography — “A celebrity autobiography may recount childhood, career setbacks, fame, and private turning points.”**

quiz.question: _________ bibliography
quiz.explanation: 参考书目, 注释参考书目. The annotated bibliography explains each source. 注释参考书目解释每个来源。 | biblio->书（希腊biblion），graphy->书写/记录，bibliography->书籍的记录=参考书目（cf. Bible圣经=书，bibliophile爱书人） || 文化联想：中国大学论文最后的参考书目最适合帮助记忆 bibliography，可以说 **an annotated bibliography — “A graduate student may prepare an annotated bibliography that summarizes the value of each source.”**

quiz.question: _____ demography
quiz.explanation: 人口统计学, 研究人口统计学. Sociologists study demography to understand populations. 社会学家研究人口统计学以了解人口。 | demo->人民（希腊demos），graphy->书写/记录，demography->记录人口的学问（cf. democracy民主，epidemic流行病，pandemic全球流行） || 文化联想：中国人口普查数据最适合帮助记忆 demography，可以说 **study demography — “Researchers study demography to understand population size, age structure, migration, births, and deaths.”**

quiz.question: ______ atrophy
quiz.explanation: 萎缩; 衰退, 肌肉萎缩. Inactivity causes muscle atrophy. 不活动会导致肌肉萎缩。 | a->否定，troph->营养（希腊trophe），atrophy->缺乏营养=萎缩（cf. trophy奖杯=营养的成果，hypertrophy过度生长，dystrophy营养不良） || 文化联想：中国医院康复科最熟悉的肌肉萎缩最适合帮助记忆 atrophy，可以说 **muscle atrophy — “Long periods of immobility can lead to muscle atrophy unless strength is gradually rebuilt.”**

quiz.question: splashy _________
quiz.explanation: 引人注目的; 华而不实的, 引人注目的标题. The tabloid used splashy headlines to sell papers. 小报用引人注目的标题来卖报纸。 | splash->溅（象声词），splashy->像水花四溅一样引人注目的（cf. splash溅，splatter飞溅，flashy华而不实） || 文化联想：中文“标题做得很炸眼、特别抢眼”最适合帮助记忆 splashy，可以说 **splashy headlines — “A tabloid may use splashy headlines to attract attention even when the underlying story is ordinary.”**

quiz.question: ______ antipathy
quiz.explanation: 反感; 厌恶, 强烈的反感. He felt strong antipathy toward his rival. 他对对手感到强烈的反感。 | anti->反对，path->感觉（希腊），antipathy->反对的感觉=反感（cf. sympathy同情，empathy共情，apathy冷漠，pathetic可怜的） || 文化联想：中文“打心底里反感”最适合帮助记忆 antipathy，可以说 **strong antipathy — “Years of bitter rivalry can create strong antipathy between two groups.”**

quiz.question: frothy ______
quiz.explanation: 起泡的; 轻浮的, 起泡的咖啡. The cappuccino has frothy coffee foam on top. 卡布奇诺上面有起泡的咖啡泡沫。 | froth->泡沫（古挪威froða），frothy->充满泡沫的=轻浮的（cf. froth泡沫，foam泡沫，frothy empty talk空话） || 文化联想：中国咖啡店奶泡丰富的卡布奇诺最适合帮助记忆 frothy，可以说 **frothy coffee — “A cappuccino topped with thick milk foam can look pleasantly frothy.”**

quiz.question: earthy _____
quiz.explanation: 朴实的; 粗俗的, 朴实的幽默. The comedians earthy humor appealed to many. 喜剧演员朴实的幽默吸引了许多人。 | earth->土地，earthy->像泥土一样朴实/粗俗的（cf. earth地球，earthen陶制的，down-to-earth实际的） || 文化联想：中文“很接地气、带点粗粝真实感”最适合帮助记忆 earthy，可以说 **earthy humor — “A village comedy may use earthy humor drawn from ordinary work, food, and family life.”**

quiz.question: finicky _____
quiz.explanation: 挑剔的; 过分讲究的, 挑剔的食客. The finicky eater refused most foods. 挑剔的食客拒绝大多数食物。 | finicky->过分讲究（可能来自fine->精细），finicky->对细节过分挑剔的（cf. fussy挑剔，picky挑剔，fastidious讲究） || 文化联想：中文“挑食得特别厉害”最适合帮助记忆 finicky，可以说 **a finicky eater — “A finicky eater may reject a dish because the texture is slightly different from what was expected.”**

quiz.question: stocky _____
quiz.explanation: 矮壮的; 结实的, 结实的体格. The wrestler had a stocky build. 摔跤手有结实的体格。 | stock->树干（古英语stocc），stocky->像树干一样粗短的=矮壮的（cf. stock库存/树干，stalwart坚定，stout粗壮，sturdy结实） || 文化联想：中国举重运动员结实敦厚的体格最适合帮助记忆 stocky，可以说 **a stocky build — “A weightlifter may have a stocky build with a broad torso and powerful legs.”**

quiz.question: balky ______
quiz.explanation: 不听使唤的; 倔强的, 不听使唤的引擎. The balky engine refused to start. 不听使唤的引擎拒绝启动。 | balk->障碍（古英语balca->横梁），balky->设置障碍不肯前进的=倔强的（cf. balk阻止/犹豫，obstacle障碍，stubborn固执） || 文化联想：中文“老机器动不动就罢工”最适合帮助记忆 balky，可以说 **a balky engine — “An old tractor with a balky engine may refuse to start on a cold morning.”**

quiz.question: perky ________
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 神气的, 活泼的态度. She maintained a perky attitude despite setbacks. 尽管遭受挫折,她仍保持活泼的态度。 | perk->精神振作（来源不明），perky->精神奕奕的=活泼的（cf. perk up振作，perky精神的，sprightly活泼，vivacious有活力） || 文化联想：中文“精神头十足、元气满满”最适合帮助记忆 perky，可以说 **a perky attitude — “A perky attitude can make an early morning meeting feel more energetic.”**

quiz.question: pesky _______
quiz.explanation: 讨厌的; 麻烦的, 讨厌的问题. The pesky problem kept recurring. 讨厌的问题不断重现。 | pesky->麻烦的（pest的变体），pesky->像害虫一样令人讨厌的（cf. pest害虫，pesticide杀虫剂，pestilent有害的） || 文化联想：中文“烦人的小毛病、老来打扰”最适合帮助记忆 pesky，可以说 **a pesky problem — “A tiny software bug can become a pesky problem if it keeps returning after every update.”**

quiz.question: frisky _____
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 爱闹着玩的, 活泼的小狗. The frisky puppy bounced around the yard. 活泼的小狗在院子里蹦蹦跳跳。 | frisk->活蹦乱跳（可能来自frisk->搜身也=快速动作），frisky->精力充沛爱玩耍的（cf. frisk搜身/蹦跳，brisk活跃） || 文化联想：中国小区里活蹦乱跳的小狗最适合帮助记忆 frisky，可以说 **a frisky puppy — “A frisky puppy may race around the courtyard, chase leaves, and demand another game.”**

quiz.question: husky _____
quiz.explanation: 沙哑的; 强壮的, 沙哑的声音. She spoke in a husky voice. 她用沙哑的声音说话。 | husk->外壳（古挪威húss），husky->像外壳一样干燥粗糙=沙哑（cf. husk谷壳，Husky哈士奇犬，hustle推挤） || 文化联想：中文“烟嗓”最适合帮助记忆 husky，可以说 **a husky voice — “A singer with a low, slightly rough tone may have a husky voice.”**

quiz.question: ___________ anomaly
quiz.explanation: 异常; 反常现象, 统计异常. The data showed a statistical anomaly. 数据显示了统计异常。 | an->无，omal->规律（希腊homalos->平坦），anomaly->不符合规律的=异常（cf. anomalous异常的，normal正常，paranormal超自然） || 文化联想：中文“数据里冒出一个反常点”最适合帮助记忆 anomaly，可以说 **a statistical anomaly — “A single result far outside the normal range may be a statistical anomaly worth investigating.”**

quiz.question: unworldly ____
quiz.explanation: 不谙世事的; 超凡脱俗的, 不谙世事的僧侣. The unworldly monk devoted himself to prayer. 不谙世事的僧侣致力于祈祷。 | un->否定，worldly->世俗的，unworldly->不属于世俗的=超凡脱俗（cf. worldly世俗，otherworldly超凡的，naive天真） || 文化联想：中国传统故事里不问世事、远离尘俗的修行者形象最适合帮助记忆 unworldly，可以说 **an unworldly monk — “An unworldly monk in a mountain temple may care little about money, fashion, or worldly status.”**

quiz.question: timely ________
quiz.explanation: 及时的; 适时的, 及时的提醒. The timely reminder helped me meet the deadline. 及时的提醒帮助我按时完成。 | time->时间，ly->形容词后缀，timely->在正确时间的=及时的（cf. untimely过早，timeline时间线，timeless永恒的） || 文化联想：中文“及时雨”最适合帮助记忆 timely，可以说 **a timely reminder — “A timely reminder the day before a deadline can prevent an important task from being forgotten.”**

quiz.question: untimely _____
quiz.explanation: 不合时宜的; 过早的, 过早的死亡. His untimely death shocked everyone. 他过早的死亡震惊了所有人。 | un->否定，timely->适时的，untimely->不在合适时间的=过早的（cf. timely及时，premature过早，inopportune不合时机） || 文化联想：中文“英年早逝”最适合帮助记忆 untimely，可以说 **an untimely death — “The untimely death of a talented young artist may shock an entire community.”**

quiz.question: comely ____
quiz.explanation: 清秀的; 标致的, 清秀的脸. She had a comely face and kind eyes. 她有一张清秀的脸和善良的眼睛。 | comely->美丽（古英语cymlic->精美的），comely->五官端正好看的（cf. becoming合适/好看，handsome英俊，fair美好） || 文化联想：古典小说里常写“眉清目秀”，最适合帮助记忆 comely，可以说 **a comely face — “A historical novel may describe a young woman as having a comely face with clear features and gentle eyes.”**

quiz.question: homely ______
quiz.explanation: 朴实的; 平凡的, 朴实的智慧. The grandmother shared homely wisdom. 祖母分享了朴实的智慧。 | home->家，homely->像家一样朴实的=朴实/相貌平平（cf. homelike像家一样，homespun自织/朴实，cozy舒适） || 文化联想：中文“家常智慧、朴素道理”最适合帮助记忆 homely，可以说 **homely wisdom — “A grandmother may offer homely wisdom about saving money, treating people well, and living within one’s means.”**

quiz.question: ____ contumely
quiz.explanation: 侮辱; 轻蔑, 抛出侮辱. Angry critics hurl contumely at the politician. 愤怒的批评者对政客抛出侮辱。 | contum->傲慢（拉丁contumax），contumely->傲慢地羞辱（cf. contumacious违抗，contumacy抗命，insolent傲慢） || 文化联想：中文“当众羞辱、恶言相加”最适合帮助记忆 contumely，可以说 **hurl contumely — “An angry crowd may hurl contumely at a disgraced official instead of offering reasoned criticism.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ philately
quiz.explanation: 集邮, 集邮爱好. His hobby of philately began in childhood. 他的集邮爱好始于童年。 | philos->热爱，atelia->免税（希腊，邮票=免付邮资的证明），philately->热爱免邮费证明=集邮（cf. philatelist集邮家，philosophy哲学） || 文化联想：中国老一辈人的集邮册最适合帮助记忆 philately，可以说 **a hobby of philately — “A hobby of philately may begin with collecting commemorative stamps issued for major events.”**

quiz.question: _________ gadfly
quiz.explanation: 牛虻; 挑衅者, 政治挑衅者. The political gadfly criticized every policy. 政治挑衅者批评每一项政策。 | gad->刺棒（古挪威gaddr），fly->飞，gadfly->用刺棒刺的飞虫=牛虻/挑衅者（cf. Socrates被称为雅典的gadfly） || 文化联想：苏格拉底“牛虻”这一西方典故可帮助中国学生记忆 gadfly，可以说 **a political gadfly — “A political gadfly constantly challenges officials and forces uncomfortable questions into public debate.”**

quiz.question: earthly _________
quiz.explanation: 尘世的; 世俗的, 尘世的快乐. He renounced earthly pleasures. 他放弃了尘世的快乐。 | earth->地球，ly->形容词，earthly->属于地球/尘世的（cf. unearthly超凡，earthen土制的，down-to-earth实际的） || 文化联想：中文“尘世享乐”最适合帮助记忆 earthly，可以说 **earthly pleasures — “A monk in a traditional story may renounce earthly pleasures such as wealth, luxury, and status.”**

quiz.question: unearthly _______
quiz.explanation: 怪异的; 可怕的, 怪异的寂静. An unearthly silence filled the room. 怪异的寂静充满了房间。 | un->否定，earthly->尘世的，unearthly->不属于尘世的=怪异（cf. supernatural超自然，eerie诡异，uncanny离奇） || 文化联想：深夜老宅突然安静得出奇最适合帮助记忆 unearthly，可以说 **an unearthly silence — “An abandoned courtyard at midnight may fall into an unearthly silence that feels almost supernatural.”**

quiz.question: readily _________
quiz.explanation: 容易地; 乐意地, 容易获得的. Information is readily available online. 信息在网上容易获得。 | ready->准备好（古英语ræde->骑马），readily->准备就绪地=容易地（cf. readiness准备，already已经，readily乐意） || 文化联想：中文“随手就能查到”最适合帮助记忆 readily，可以说 **readily available — “Train schedules, maps, and payment information are now readily available on a smartphone.”**

quiz.question: _____ homily
quiz.explanation: 说教; 训诫, 道德说教. The priest delivered a moral homily. 牧师发表了道德说教。 | homilos->人群（希腊），homily->向人群讲道=布道/说教（cf. homiletics讲道学，homilize说教，sermon布道） || 文化联想：homily 是宗教讲道中的训诫，可用中国教堂礼拜来记忆，可以说 **a moral homily — “During a church service in China, a priest may deliver a moral homily about compassion and responsibility.”**

quiz.question: ____ perfunctorily
quiz.explanation: 敷衍地; 例行公事地, 敷衍地完成. The task was done perfunctorily without care. 任务被敷衍地完成,毫不用心。 | per->彻底，funct->完成（拉丁），perfunctorily->只是走完程序地=敷衍地（cf. function功能，defunct停止运作，perfunctory草草了事） || 文化联想：中文“走过场、敷衍了事”最适合帮助记忆 perfunctorily，可以说 **done perfunctorily — “A safety inspection done perfunctorily may miss exactly the defect that later causes trouble.”**

quiz.question: wily ___
quiz.explanation: 狡猾的; 诡计多端的, 狡猾的狐狸. The wily fox escaped the hunters. 狡猾的狐狸逃脱了猎人。 | wile->计谋（古英语wil->陷阱），wily->充满计谋的=狡猾（cf. guile狡猾，sly狡猾，beguile迷惑，wiles花招） || 文化联想：《聊斋》或民间故事里狡猾狐狸的形象最适合帮助记忆 wily，可以说 **a wily fox — “A wily fox in a folktale may escape a trap by misleading the hunter.”**

quiz.question: dally ____
quiz.explanation: 闲荡; 玩弄, 玩弄. Do not dally with important decisions. 不要玩弄重要的决定。 | dally->消磨时间（古法语dalier->聊天），dally->拖延/玩弄（cf. daily每天，dillydally拖拖拉拉，dawdle磨蹭） || 文化联想：中文“磨磨蹭蹭、迟迟不做决定”最适合帮助记忆 dally，可以说 **dally over a decision — “A buyer who continues to dally over a decision may lose the house to another bidder.”**

quiz.question: proverbially ________
quiz.explanation: 众所周知地, 众所周知地谨慎. He is proverbially cautious in business. 他在商业上众所周知地谨慎。 | proverb->谚语（拉丁proverbium），proverbially->像谚语一样众所周知地（cf. proverb谚语，proverbial众所周知的，wise wisdom） || 文化联想：中文“出了名地谨慎”最适合帮助记忆 proverbially，可以说 **proverbially cautious — “An experienced accountant may be proverbially cautious whenever large sums of money are involved.”**

quiz.question: ____ exponentially
quiz.explanation: 指数地; 迅速地, 指数增长. The company continues to grow exponentially. 公司继续指数增长。 | exponent->指数（ex+ponere->放置出来），exponentially->以指数方式地（cf. exponential指数的，exponent倡导者/指数，propose提议） || 文化联想：中文“指数级增长”最适合帮助记忆 exponentially，可以说 **grow exponentially — “A viral app can grow exponentially when each new user brings in several more users.”**

quiz.question: rally ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 集结; 重整, 集结军队. The general will rally the troops for battle. 将军会为战斗集结军队。 | rally->重新集合（re+ally->重新联合），rally->重整/集会（cf. ally盟友，alliance联盟，re-ally重新联合=rally） || 文化联想：中文“把士气重新鼓起来”最适合帮助记忆 rally，可以说 **rally the team — “A coach may rally the team after a poor first half and send the players back out with renewed confidence.”**

quiz.question: tally ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 计数; 记录, 计票. Officials will tally the votes tonight. 官员今晚将计票。 | tally->计数棒（拉丁talea->棒），tally->在木棒上刻痕计数（cf. talley棒，tally mark计数符号，tally ho猎狐喊声） || 文化联想：中国投票或班委选举后逐张计票最适合帮助记忆 tally，可以说 **tally the votes — “Election workers may tally the votes carefully before announcing the final result.”**

quiz.question: ________ filly
quiz.explanation: 小母马, 活泼的小母马. The spirited filly won the race. 活泼的小母马赢得了比赛。 | filly->小母马（古挪威fylja），filly->未成年的雌马（cf. foal马驹，colt小公马，mare母马，stallion种公马） || 文化联想：内蒙古马场里的年轻小母马最适合帮助记忆 filly，可以说 **a spirited filly — “A spirited filly may race across the grassland before settling beside the herd.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ folly
quiz.explanation: 愚蠢; 荒唐事, 愚蠢的行为. That was an act of folly. 那是愚蠢的行为。 | fol->愚蠢（法语fou->疯子），folly->愚蠢的行为（cf. fool傻瓜，foolish愚蠢，folly愚蠢行为，cf. Shakespeare's folly） || 文化联想：中文“聪明反被聪明误的一桩蠢事”最适合帮助记忆 folly，可以说 **an act of folly — “Borrowing heavily to speculate on a rumor can turn into an expensive act of folly.”**

quiz.question: jolly ____
quiz.explanation: 快乐的; 愉快的, 非常好. Thats a jolly good idea! 那是个非常好的主意! | jolly->愉快（可能来自jol->圣诞节/冬至节日），jolly->快乐的/英式强调语（cf. jolly hockey sticks极度热情，jollity快活） || 文化联想：英式表达里的“非常不错”最适合帮助记忆 jolly，可以说 **jolly good — “After tasting a well-made pot of tea, a British guest might say that it is jolly good.”**

quiz.question: sully __________
quiz.explanation: 玷污; 损害, 玷污声誉. The scandal will sully reputation. 丑闻会玷污声誉。 | sully->弄脏（古法语souiller->弄脏），sully->使不洁=玷污（cf. soil泥土/污染，defile玷污，tarnish失去光泽） || 文化联想：中文“给名声抹黑”最适合帮助记忆 sully，可以说 **sully a reputation — “A corruption scandal can sully a reputation built over many years.”**

quiz.question: unseemly ________
quiz.explanation: 不得体的; 不适当的, 不得体的行为. His unseemly behavior shocked the guests. 他不得体的行为震惊了客人。 | un->否定，seemly->得体（古英语gesæmlic->合适的），unseemly->不得体的（cf. seem看起来，seeming表面上，it seems好像） || 文化联想：中国正式宴席上大声失礼最适合帮助记忆 unseemly，可以说 **unseemly behavior — “Shouting insults during a formal banquet would be considered unseemly behavior.”**

quiz.question: melancholy ____
quiz.explanation: 忧郁; 悲伤, 忧郁的心情. She fell into a melancholy mood. 她陷入了忧郁的心情。 | melan->黑（希腊melas），choly->胆汁（希腊），melancholy->黑胆汁=忧郁（古医学四体液：黑胆汁多=忧郁，cf. melanin黑色素） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里许多哀婉场景最适合帮助记忆 melancholy，可以说 **a melancholy mood — “A quiet scene of falling blossoms in Dream of the Red Chamber can create a melancholy mood.”**

quiz.question: comply ____
quiz.explanation: 遵守; 服从, 遵守. Companies must comply with regulations. 公司必须遵守法规。 | com->共同，ply->折叠/弯曲（拉丁），comply->弯曲以配合=遵守（cf. supply供应，apply申请，imply暗示，reply回复） || 文化联想：中文“遵守规定”最适合帮助记忆 comply，可以说 **comply with regulations — “A factory must comply with safety and environmental regulations before operating legally.”**

quiz.question: ____ gingerly
quiz.explanation: 小心翼翼地, 小心翼翼地移动. Move gingerly on the icy steps. 在结冰的台阶上小心翼翼地移动。 | ginger->生姜/小心（可能来自人们小心翼翼地踩热炭），gingerly->小心翼翼地（cf. ginger生姜，ginger up激励，gingerly=with ginger=小心） || 文化联想：中国北方冬天结冰台阶上小心挪步最适合帮助记忆 gingerly，可以说 **move gingerly — “An older person may move gingerly down icy steps while holding the railing.”**

quiz.question: miserly ______
quiz.explanation: 吝啬的; 小气的, 吝啬的习惯. His miserly habits made him unpopular. 他吝啬的习惯使他不受欢迎。 | miser->吝啬鬼（拉丁miser->悲惨的），miserly->像吝啬鬼一样的（cf. miserable悲惨，misery痛苦，miser守财奴） || 文化联想：中文“铁公鸡、一毛不拔”最适合帮助记忆 miserly，可以说 **miserly habits — “Someone with miserly habits may refuse to spend even a small amount on necessary repairs.”**

quiz.question: measly ______
quiz.explanation: 微不足道的; 少得可怜的, 微不足道的数量. They offered a measly amount for the work. 他们为这项工作提供了微不足道的数量。 | measles->麻疹（皮疹斑点小），measly->像麻疹一样少而可怜的（cf. paltry微不足道，piddling极少的，trifling微小的） || 文化联想：中文“少得可怜”最适合帮助记忆 measly，可以说 **a measly amount — “After hours of difficult work, receiving only a measly amount of pay would feel insulting.”**

quiz.question: expressly ______
quiz.explanation: 明确地; 特意地, 明确禁止. The rules expressly forbid smoking. 规则明确禁止吸烟。 | express->表达（拉丁exprimere->压出），expressly->明确地=特意表达地（cf. express快递/表达，explicit明确，specifically特意） || 文化联想：中文“白纸黑字明确禁止”最适合帮助记忆 expressly，可以说 **expressly forbid — “Building rules may expressly forbid smoking in elevators and enclosed hallways.”**

quiz.question: sprightly _____
quiz.explanation: 活泼的; 轻快的, 轻快的舞蹈. The children performed a sprightly dance. 孩子们表演了轻快的舞蹈。 | sprite->精灵（拉丁spiritus->灵魂），sprightly->像精灵一样轻盈活泼（cf. sprite精灵，spirit精神，spritely活泼） || 文化联想：中国少儿舞蹈比赛里轻快活泼的舞步最适合帮助记忆 sprightly，可以说 **a sprightly dance — “Children may perform a sprightly dance with quick steps and cheerful music at a school show.”**

quiz.question: unjustly _______
quiz.explanation: 不公正地, 不公正地指控. He was unjustly accused of theft. 他被不公正地指控盗窃。 | un->否定，justly->公正地，unjustly->不公正地（cf. just公正，justice正义，injustice不公正，justify证明正确） || 文化联想：中文“被冤枉”最适合帮助记忆 unjustly，可以说 **unjustly accused — “A person unjustly accused of theft may spend years trying to clear a damaged reputation.”**

quiz.question: drizzly ___
quiz.explanation: 毛毛雨的; 下毛毛雨的, 毛毛雨天. It was a cold, drizzly day. 那是一个寒冷的毛毛雨天。 | drizzle->毛毛雨（古英语dreosan->落下），drizzly->下毛毛雨的（cf. drizzle毛毛雨，drool流口水，drip滴落） || 文化联想：江南梅雨季连绵毛毛雨最适合帮助记忆 drizzly，可以说 **a drizzly day — “A gray, drizzly day in the Jiangnan region can make the stone lanes shine with moisture.”**

quiz.question: seamy ____
quiz.explanation: 肮脏的; 丑恶的, 丑恶的一面. The novel exposed the seamy side of politics. 小说揭露了政治的丑恶一面。 | seam->缝（古英语seam->缝合），seamy->缝合处外翻=丑陋的一面（cf. seam缝，seamstress女裁缝，seamy side衣服内侧缝线） || 文化联想：中文“光鲜背后的阴暗面”最适合帮助记忆 seamy，可以说 **the seamy side — “An investigative report may expose the seamy side of an industry that looks glamorous from the outside.”**

quiz.question: ________ monogamy
quiz.explanation: 一夫一妻制, 实行一夫一妻制. Most societies practice monogamy. 大多数社会实行一夫一妻制。 | mono->一，gamy->婚姻（希腊gamos），monogamy->一人婚姻=一夫一妻（cf. bigamy重婚，polygamy一夫多妻，misogamy厌婚） || 文化联想：中国现代婚姻法语境中的一夫一妻制最适合帮助记忆 monogamy，可以说 **the practice of monogamy — “Modern marriage law generally treats the practice of monogamy as the legal norm.”**

quiz.question: misogamy ______
quiz.explanation: 厌婚; 反对婚姻, 厌婚立场. His misogamy stance surprised his family. 他的厌婚立场让家人感到惊讶。 | miso->厌恶（希腊），gamy->婚姻，misogamy->厌恶婚姻（cf. misogyny厌女症，misanthropy厌世，monogamy一夫一妻） || 文化联想：中文“恐婚、反对婚姻”最适合帮助记忆 misogamy，可以说 **a misogamy stance — “A character who believes marriage itself should be avoided may express a strong misogamy stance.”**

quiz.question: ______ blasphemy
quiz.explanation: 亵渎; 渎神, 犯亵渎罪. To say such things is to commit blasphemy. 说这样的话就是犯亵渎罪。 | blasph->说坏话（希腊blaptein->伤害+pheme->说），blasphemy->对神说坏话=亵渎（cf. euphemism委婉说法=好话，prophet先知） || 文化联想：blasphemy 是宗教语境里的“亵渎神圣”，可用中国学生学习世界宗教来记忆，可以说 **commit blasphemy — “In some religious traditions, openly insulting what believers regard as sacred may be described as committing blasphemy.”**

quiz.question: _______ pygmy
quiz.explanation: 侏儒; 矮人, 非洲侏儒. African pygmy tribes live in rainforests. 非洲侏儒部落生活在雨林中。 | pygme->拳头大小（希腊，古人用"拳头"作为测量单位），pygmy->拳头大小的人=矮人（cf. fist拳头，pugilism拳击，pygmy最小的） || 文化联想：pygmy 是旧式人类学称呼，现代使用需谨慎，可用中国学生读旧教材时来记忆，可以说 **the term pygmy — “In older anthropology texts, students may encounter the term pygmy for certain Central African peoples, though modern usage should be handled carefully.”**

quiz.question: palmy ____
quiz.explanation: 繁荣的; 兴旺的, 繁荣时期. He remembered the palmy days of his youth. 他记得青年时期的繁荣时光。 | palm->棕榈（拉丁palma，胜利象征），palmy->像胜利棕榈一样繁荣的（cf. palm棕榈/手掌，palmist手相师，triumph凯旋） || 文化联想：中文“黄金年代、最风光的时候”最适合帮助记忆 palmy，可以说 **the palmy days — “An old filmmaker may remember the palmy days when local cinemas were packed every weekend.”**

quiz.question: _____ agronomy
quiz.explanation: 农学, 研究农学. Agricultural students study agronomy. 农业学生研究农学。 | agro->田地（希腊agros），nomy->法则，agronomy->田地的法则=农学（cf. agriculture农业，agrarian土地的，astronomy天文=星的法则） || 文化联想：中国农业大学研究作物、土壤和耕作最适合帮助记忆 agronomy，可以说 **study agronomy — “Agricultural students study agronomy to improve crop production, soil management, and farming systems.”**

quiz.question: _________ gastronomy
quiz.explanation: 烹饪学; 美食法, 分子烹饪学. Molecular gastronomy transforms food chemistry. 分子烹饪学改变了食物化学。 | gastro->胃（希腊gaster），nomy->法则，gastronomy->让胃满意的法则=美食学（cf. gastric胃的，gastritis胃炎，gastropub美食酒吧） || 文化联想：中国高端餐厅的分子料理最适合帮助记忆 gastronomy，可以说 **molecular gastronomy — “A chef may use molecular gastronomy to transform familiar ingredients into unexpected textures.”**

quiz.question: _________ autonomy
quiz.explanation: 自治; 自主权, 政治自治. The region gained political autonomy. 该地区获得了政治自治。 | auto->自己，nomy->法则，autonomy->自己制定法则=自治（cf. autonomous自治的，astronomy天文，economy经济=家的管理） || 文化联想：中文“自主权、自己管理自己”最适合帮助记忆 autonomy，可以说 **local autonomy — “A region with local autonomy may manage certain affairs through its own institutions within a larger state.”**

quiz.question: smarmy ______
quiz.explanation: 虚情假意的; 谄媚的, 虚情假意的赞美. His smarmy praise made everyone uncomfortable. 他虚情假意的赞美让每个人都感到不舒服。 | smarm->油腔滑调（来自smear->涂抹），smarmy->像油一样滑腻的=虚情假意（cf. unctuous油腻/谄媚，obsequious谄媚，smear涂抹） || 文化联想：中文“油腔滑调地拍马屁”最适合帮助记忆 smarmy，可以说 **smarmy praise — “Smarmy praise from an employee can sound insincere when every sentence flatters the boss.”**

quiz.question: _ miscellany __ ______
quiz.explanation: 杂集; 混合物, 散文杂集. The book is a miscellany of essays. 这本书是散文杂集。 | miscel->混合（拉丁miscere），lany->物品，miscellany->混合的各种物品=杂集（cf. miscellaneous杂项，mix混合，medley混合曲） || 文化联想：中国散文选集里东一篇西一篇的杂文最适合帮助记忆 miscellany，可以说 **a miscellany of essays — “A literary miscellany may contain travel notes, criticism, memoir, and short essays in one volume.”**

quiz.question: accompany _ ______
quiz.explanation: 陪伴; 伴随, 陪伴朋友. I will accompany a friend to the concert. 我会陪伴朋友去音乐会。 | ac->朝向，company->伙伴（拉丁com+panis->共同吃饼），accompany->作为伙伴相随（cf. companion伙伴，company公司，pantry食品室） || 文化联想：中国朋友一起去演唱会最适合帮助记忆 accompany，可以说 **accompany a friend — “Someone may accompany a friend to a concert even without knowing the singer very well.”**

quiz.question: _____ botany
quiz.explanation: 植物学, 研究植物学. Biologists study botany extensively. 生物学家广泛研究植物学。 | botane->植物（希腊），botany->研究植物的学问（cf. botanical植物学的，botanist植物学家，herb草药） || 文化联想：中国植物园里的植物分类课最适合帮助记忆 botany，可以说 **study botany — “A university student may study botany by examining plant structure, reproduction, and classification.”**

quiz.question: _____ progeny
quiz.explanation: 后代; 子孙, 皇室后裔. The royal progeny inherited the throne. 皇室后裔继承了王位。 | pro->向前，geny->出生（拉丁gignere），progeny->向前生育的=后代（cf. gene基因，genesis起源，generate产生，congenital先天的） || 文化联想：中国族谱记录一代代后人最适合帮助记忆 progeny，可以说 **future progeny — “A family genealogy may record the progeny of a common ancestor across many generations.”**

quiz.question: _____ ignominy
quiz.explanation: 耻辱; 不名誉, 彻底的耻辱. The defeat brought utter ignominy. 失败带来了彻底的耻辱。 | ig->无，nomin->名誉（拉丁nomen），ignominy->失去名誉=耻辱（cf. ignominious可耻的，nominate提名，nominal名义的） || 文化联想：中文“丢尽脸面、蒙受奇耻大辱”最适合帮助记忆 ignominy，可以说 **utter ignominy — “A public official exposed for serious corruption may leave office in utter ignominy.”**

quiz.question: satiny ______
quiz.explanation: 缎子般的; 光滑的, 缎子般的表面. The paint has a satiny finish. 油漆有缎子般的表面。 | satin->丝缎（来自中国泉州Quanzhou阿拉伯名Zaitun），satiny->像丝缎一样光滑的（cf. silky丝滑，glossy光泽，satin丝缎） || 文化联想：苏杭丝绸那种柔滑微亮的质感最适合帮助记忆 satiny，可以说 **a satiny finish — “A finely woven silk fabric may have a soft, satiny finish that reflects light gently.”**

quiz.question: _______ calumny
quiz.explanation: 诽谤; 中伤, 恶毒的诽谤. He suffered vicious calumny from his enemies. 他遭受了敌人恶毒的诽谤。 | calumni->虚假指控（拉丁calumnia），calumny->虚假指控=诽谤（cf. slander口头诽谤，libel书面诽谤，calumniate诽谤） || 文化联想：中文“恶意诽谤、泼脏水”最适合帮助记忆 calumny，可以说 **vicious calumny — “Inventing a damaging accusation and spreading it publicly can become vicious calumny.”**

quiz.question: canny ________
quiz.explanation: 精明的; 机敏的, 精明的投资者. The canny investor made wise choices. 精明的投资者做出了明智的选择。 | can->知道（苏格兰方言），canny->知道门道的=精明的（cf. uncanny离奇，can能够，ken知识范围） || 文化联想：中文“精打细算、很会盘算”最适合帮助记忆 canny，可以说 **a canny investor — “A canny investor may compare price, cash flow, risk, and financing before buying.”**

quiz.question: uncanny ___________
quiz.explanation: 离奇的; 不可思议的, 不可思议的相似. Theres an uncanny resemblance between them. 他们之间有不可思议的相似。 | un->否定，canny->精明/自然，uncanny->超出自然范围的=离奇（cf. canny精明，eerie诡异，supernatural超自然） || 文化联想：中文“像见了鬼一样不可思议地相似”最适合帮助记忆 uncanny，可以说 **an uncanny resemblance — “Two unrelated actors may have an uncanny resemblance that surprises everyone who sees them together.”**

quiz.question: _____ cacophony
quiz.explanation: 刺耳的声音; 不和谐音, 城市喧嚣. The urban cacophony never stops. 城市喧嚣从不停止。 | caco->坏（希腊kakos），phony->声音，cacophony->坏声音=刺耳（cf. euphony悦耳，symphony交响，telephone电话） || 文化联想：春节庙会里锣鼓、叫卖和人声混在一起最适合帮助记忆 cacophony，可以说 **an urban cacophony — “Traffic, horns, construction, and loudspeakers can merge into an urban cacophony.”**

quiz.question: ___ colony
quiz.explanation: 殖民地; 群体, 蚁群. The ant colony worked together efficiently. 蚁群高效地协同工作。 | colon->定居者（拉丁colonus），colony->定居者的群体=殖民地（cf. colonize殖民，colonial殖民地的，colonnade柱廊） || 文化联想：中国生物课里一整窝合作生活的蚂蚁最适合帮助记忆 colony，可以说 **an ant colony — “An ant colony can coordinate thousands of workers through simple local signals.”**

quiz.question: ________ hegemony
quiz.explanation: 霸权; 领导权, 文化霸权. Cultural hegemony shapes social values. 文化霸权塑造社会价值观。 | hegemon->领导者（希腊hegeisthai->领导），hegemony->领导权/霸权（cf. Hegemony霸权，hegemonic霸权主义，exarchy总督区） || 文化联想：中文“谁掌握话语权、主导权”最适合帮助记忆 hegemony，可以说 **cultural hegemony — “A dominant media culture may exert cultural hegemony by shaping what people treat as normal or prestigious.”**

quiz.question: _____ ceremony
quiz.explanation: 典礼; 仪式, 国家典礼. The state ceremony was attended by dignitaries. 国家典礼有政要出席。 | caerimonia->宗教仪式（拉丁，来源不明），ceremony->正式的仪式（cf. ceremonious隆重的，ceremonial礼仪的，ritual仪式） || 文化联想：中国大型国家纪念活动的庄重仪式最适合帮助记忆 ceremony，可以说 **a state ceremony — “A state ceremony may follow precise protocol, music, dress, and seating arrangements.”**

quiz.question: ________ acrimony
quiz.explanation: 尖刻; 辛辣, 恶毒的尖刻. The debate was marked by venomous acrimony. 辩论以恶毒的尖刻为特征。 | acri->锋利/辛辣（拉丁acer），mony->状态，acrimony->尖锐辛辣的状态=尖刻（cf. acrid辛辣，acrimony尖刻，acrobat杂技=尖端行走） || 文化联想：中文“唇枪舌剑、怨气冲天”最适合帮助记忆 acrimony，可以说 **bitter acrimony — “A family inheritance dispute can descend into bitter acrimony if old grievances resurface.”**

quiz.question: ______ patrimony
quiz.explanation: 遗产; 世袭财产, 家族遗产. The estate was part of the family patrimony. 这处房产是家族遗产的一部分。 | patri->父亲（拉丁pater），mony->状态，patrimony->来自父亲的财产=遗产（cf. patriot爱国者，patronage赞助，matrimony婚姻=母道） || 文化联想：中国老宅、祖产传给后人的概念最适合帮助记忆 patrimony，可以说 **family patrimony — “An ancestral house may form part of a family patrimony passed from one generation to the next.”**

quiz.question: ____-_______ monotony
quiz.explanation: 单调; 乏味, 令人麻木的单调. The mind-numbing monotony of the job was exhausting. 工作令人麻木的单调令人筋疲力尽。 | mono->单一，tony->声调（希腊tonos），monotony->只有一个声调=单调（cf. monotone单调，monotonous乏味，monologue独白） || 文化联想：中文“每天重复一样的活，单调得让人麻木”最适合帮助记忆 monotony，可以说 **mind-numbing monotony — “Doing the same mechanical task for ten hours a day can create mind-numbing monotony.”**

quiz.question: corny ____
quiz.explanation: 陈腐的; 老套的, 老套的台词. He used a corny line to flirt. 他用老套的台词调情。 | corny->玉米乡村的（corn->玉米/老旧），corny->过时陈腐的（cf. corny joke老掉牙的笑话，corn玉米，stale陈旧，cliché陈词滥调） || 文化联想：中文“土味老套台词”最适合帮助记忆 corny，可以说 **a corny line — “A dating drama may use a corny line that sounds romantic only because everyone has heard it before.”**

quiz.question: thorny _____
quiz.explanation: 棘手的; 多刺的, 棘手的问题. Immigration is a thorny issue in politics. 移民是政治中的棘手问题。 | thorn->刺（古英语），thorny->像荆棘一样难以处理的（cf. thorn荆棘，prickly多刺的，thorny problem棘手问题） || 文化联想：中文“棘手问题”最适合帮助记忆 thorny，可以说 **a thorny issue — “How to balance redevelopment with historic preservation can become a thorny issue.”**

quiz.question: puny ______
quiz.explanation: 微小的; 微弱的, 微弱的努力. His puny effort was insufficient. 他微弱的努力是不够的。 | puny->生后（法语puiné->后来出生的），puny->后来出生的=较小弱小的（cf. junior年幼，infant婴儿，puisne法官=后任法官） || 文化联想：中文“这么点力气根本不够”最适合帮助记忆 puny，可以说 **a puny effort — “A puny effort is unlikely to solve a problem that requires sustained work.”**

quiz.question: brawny ____
quiz.explanation: 肌肉发达的; 强壮的, 强壮的手臂. The laborer had brawny arms from hard work. 劳工因辛勤工作而有强壮的手臂。 | brawn->肌肉（古法语braon->肥肉），brawny->肌肉发达的（cf. brawn肌肉力量，brawl争斗，robust强壮，muscular肌肉发达） || 文化联想：中国工地长期体力劳动者粗壮有力的手臂最适合帮助记忆 brawny，可以说 **brawny arms — “Years of heavy manual work can give a laborer brawny arms and powerful shoulders.”**

quiz.question: coy _____
