quiz.explanation: 害羞的; 忸怩作态的, 害羞的微笑. She gave a coy smile and looked away. 她露出害羞的微笑,看向别处。 | coy->安静（古法语coi->安静），coy->故作羞涩（cf. quiet安静，quiescent静止，coyness忸怩，decoy诱饵） || 文化联想：中文“含羞带怯地一笑”最适合帮助记忆 coy，可以说 **a coy smile — “A character in a romantic drama may give a coy smile and quickly look away.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ decoy
quiz.explanation: 诱饵; 圈套, 用作诱饵. Hunters use as decoy to attract ducks. 猎人用作诱饵来吸引鸭子。 | de->进入，coy->笼子（荷兰语kooi->鸟笼），decoy->引入笼中的=诱饵（cf. coy害羞，cage鸟笼，decoy诱饵） || 文化联想：中文“放个诱饵引对方上钩”最适合帮助记忆 decoy，可以说 **use a decoy — “Wildlife researchers may use a decoy model to attract birds close enough for observation.”**

quiz.question: _____ killjoy
quiz.explanation: 扫兴的人, 派对扫兴者. Do not be a party killjoy! 不要做派对扫兴者! | kill->杀死，joy->快乐，killjoy->杀死快乐的人=扫兴者（cf. spoilsport扫兴者，wet blanket扫兴的人，buzzkill扫兴） || 文化联想：中文“扫兴鬼”最适合帮助记忆 killjoy，可以说 **a party killjoy — “A guest who complains about every song, dish, and game can become a party killjoy.”**

quiz.question: cloy ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 使厌腻; 使倒胃口, 使糖倒胃口. Too much sweetness will cloy with sugar. 太多的甜味会使糖倒胃口。 | cloy->填满（古法语encloyer->用钉子堵住），cloy->甜到倒胃口（cf. satiate使满足，surfeited过量，cloying过甜的） || 文化联想：中文“甜得发腻”最适合帮助记忆 cloy，可以说 **cloy with sweetness — “A dessert overloaded with syrup may cloy with sweetness after only a few bites.”**

quiz.question: ______ ploy
quiz.explanation: 策略; 手段, 聪明的策略. It was a clever ploy to win votes. 这是赢得选票的聪明策略。 | ploy->策略（可能来自deploy部署的缩写），ploy->用于达目的的策略（cf. deploy部署，gambit开局策略，stratagem计谋） || 文化联想：《三十六计》里声东击西式的小策略最适合帮助记忆 ploy，可以说 **a clever ploy — “Offering a small concession first can be a clever ploy to draw attention away from a larger negotiating goal.”**

quiz.question: annoy ___ _________
quiz.explanation: 使恼怒; 打扰, 惹恼邻居. Loud music will annoy the neighbors. 大声音乐会惹恼邻居。 | an->朝向，noy->厌恶（拉丁nausea/nocere->伤害），annoy->给人带来厌恶=惹恼（cf. annoyance烦恼，noxious有毒，obnoxious讨厌） || 文化联想：中国小区深夜放很大声音乐最容易 annoy 邻居，可以说 **annoy the neighbors — “Playing loud music after midnight will annoy the neighbors in an apartment building.”**

quiz.question: grumpy ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 脾气暴躁的, 脾气暴躁的老人. The grumpy old man yelled at kids. 脾气暴躁的老人对孩子们大喊大叫。 | grump->抱怨者（象声词，模拟咕哝声），grumpy->爱咕哝抱怨的=脾气暴躁（cf. grumble嘟囔，grunt咕哝，groan呻吟） || 文化联想：中文“脾气臭、动不动就发火”最适合帮助记忆 grumpy，可以说 **a grumpy old man — “A grumpy old man may complain about children playing, cars parking, and almost everything else.”**

quiz.question: snappy ________
quiz.explanation: 敏捷的; 时髦的, 敏捷的反击. She had a snappy comeback ready. 她准备了敏捷的反击。 | snap->咬/啪（象声词），snappy->像闪电一样快=敏捷的（cf. snap折断/快照，snappy dresser时髦穿着者，make it snappy快点） || 文化联想：中文“机灵地马上回一句”最适合帮助记忆 snappy，可以说 **a snappy comeback — “A quick-witted comedian may answer an insult with a snappy comeback that makes the audience laugh.”**

quiz.question: scrappy _____
quiz.explanation: 杂乱的; 好斗的, 杂乱的笔记. His scrappy notes were hard to read. 他杂乱的笔记很难读。 | scrap->碎片/废料，scrappy->像碎片一样凌乱的/好斗的（cf. scrap废料，scrappy fighter好斗的，rag and scrap零碎） || 文化联想：中文“东一块西一块、零零散散的笔记”最适合帮助记忆 scrappy，可以说 **scrappy notes — “Scrappy notes written on receipts and loose paper can be difficult to organize later.”**

quiz.question: floppy ____
quiz.explanation: 松软的; 软盘, 软盘. Old computers used floppy disk for storage. 旧电脑使用软盘存储。 | flop->软软倒下（象声词），floppy->松软垂下的（cf. flop失败，flip翻转，floppy hat宽檐帽，floppy disk软盘） || 文化联想：中国老电脑里的软盘最适合帮助记忆 floppy，可以说 **a floppy disk — “Older computers once stored small files on a floppy disk long before USB drives became common.”**

quiz.question: raspy _____
quiz.explanation: 刺耳的; 粗糙的, 刺耳的声音. The singer had a raspy voice from smoking. 歌手因吸烟而有刺耳的声音。 | rasp->刺耳声/锉（古法语rasper->刮），raspy->像锉一样粗糙刺耳的（cf. rasp锉/刺耳声，husky沙哑，hoarse沙哑） || 文化联想：中文“嗓子粗哑刺耳”最适合帮助记忆 raspy，可以说 **a raspy voice — “After shouting for hours at a stadium, a fan may wake up with a raspy voice.”**

quiz.question: espy _ ______
quiz.explanation: 看到; 发现, 看到人影. I could espy a figure in the distance. 我能看到远处的人影。 | espy->看到（古法语espier->侦察），espy->远距发现（cf. spy间谍，espionage间谍活动，spy out侦察，bespy注视） || 文化联想：中文“远远瞥见一个人影”最适合帮助记忆 espy，可以说 **espy a figure — “From a mountain trail, a hiker may espy a figure moving along a distant ridge.”**

quiz.question: lapidary ___________
quiz.explanation: 宝石的; 简洁优美的, 碑文. The monument bore a lapidary inscription. 纪念碑上刻有简洁优美的碑文。 | lapid->石头（拉丁lapis），lapidary->关于石头雕刻的=简洁精雕的（cf. lapis lazuli青金石，dilapidate破坏=拆石头，cf. lapidary precision精准） || 文化联想：中国碑刻上短而有力的铭文最适合帮助记忆 lapidary，可以说 **a lapidary inscription — “A stone memorial may carry a lapidary inscription whose few words are polished and memorable.”**

quiz.question: __ _ quandary
quiz.explanation: 困境; 进退两难, 处于困境. She found herself in a quandary. 她发现自己处于困境。 | quandary->困境（来源不明，可能来自拉丁quando->何时），quandary->不知该如何的困境（cf. dilemma进退两难，predicament困境，quagmire泥沼） || 文化联想：中文“进退两难”最适合帮助记忆 quandary，可以说 **be in a quandary — “A buyer who loves a house but dislikes the financial risk may find himself in a quandary.”**

quiz.question: dreary _______
quiz.explanation: 沉闷的; 令人沮丧的, 沉闷的天气. The dreary weather lasted all week. 沉闷的天气持续了整整一周。 | dreary->悲伤（古英语dreórig->血淋淋的/悲伤），dreary->阴沉令人沮丧的（cf. drear悲凉，gloomy阴暗，dismal令人沮丧） || 文化联想：江南冬季阴冷灰暗的连雨天最适合帮助记忆 dreary，可以说 **dreary weather — “Several days of cold rain and gray skies can make winter weather feel dreary.”**

quiz.question: weary ________
quiz.explanation: 疲倦的; 厌倦的, 疲惫的旅行者. The weary traveler finally reached home. 疲惫的旅行者终于到家了。 | weary->疲倦（古英语wérig），weary->精疲力竭（cf. wear穿磨损，wear out磨损/疲惫，wearisome令人疲倦的） || 文化联想：春运长途回家后的疲惫旅客最适合帮助记忆 weary，可以说 **a weary traveler — “After an overnight train and a long bus ride, a weary traveler may finally reach the family home.”**

quiz.question: ___ vagary
quiz.explanation: 奇想; 反复无常, 奇怪的反复无常. The odd vagary of fate surprised everyone. 奇怪的命运反复无常让所有人惊讶。 | vagary->漫游（拉丁vagari->漫游），vagary->思想漫无边际=奇想/无常（cf. vagrant流浪者，vague模糊，extravagant奢侈=超出范围漫游） || 文化联想：中文“命运无常、突然拐个弯”最适合帮助记忆 vagary，可以说 **a vagary of fate — “A chance meeting that completely changes a career can seem like a strange vagary of fate.”**

quiz.question: chary __ _____
quiz.explanation: 谨慎的; 小心的, 谨慎对待风险. Investors should be chary of risks. 投资者应该谨慎对待风险。 | chary->谨慎（古英语cearig->充满担忧），chary->谨慎小心的（cf. care关心，careful小心，wary警惕，chary of谨慎于） || 文化联想：中文“投资要谨慎，别冒没必要的险”最适合帮助记忆 chary，可以说 **be chary of risk — “A cautious investor may be chary of risk when an asset has risen too quickly.”**

quiz.question: _________ intermediary
quiz.explanation: 中间人; 调解人, 金融中介. The financial intermediary arranged the deal. 金融中介安排了这笔交易。 | inter->之间，mediary->居中的（拉丁medius），intermediary->居于中间的人=中介（cf. mediate调解，medium媒介，Mediterranean地中海） || 文化联想：中国银行或券商在交易中充当中介最适合帮助记忆 intermediary，可以说 **a financial intermediary — “A bank can act as a financial intermediary between savers and borrowers.”**

quiz.question: subsidiary _______
quiz.explanation: 子公司; 附属的, 子公司. The subsidiary company operates independently. 子公司独立运营。 | subsidium->后备部队（拉丁，sub->在下，sid->坐），subsidiary->提供后援支持的=辅助的（cf. subsidy补贴，subside减退，reside居住） || 文化联想：中国大型集团旗下子公司最适合帮助记忆 subsidiary，可以说 **a subsidiary company — “A large technology group may own a subsidiary company that operates under a separate brand.”**

quiz.question: incendiary ______
quiz.explanation: 纵火的; 煽动性的, 燃烧装置. Police found an incendiary device. 警方发现了一个燃烧装置。 | incend->点火（拉丁incendere），incendiary->用来点火的（cf. incense香/激怒，kindle点燃，arson纵火，incandescent白炽） || 文化联想：incendiary 可指燃烧装置，也可指煽动性言论；用新闻里的“煽动性措辞”来记忆更安全，可以说 **incendiary rhetoric — “Incendiary rhetoric can turn an already tense public dispute into something much harder to control.”**

quiz.question: auxiliary _____
quiz.explanation: 辅助的; 备用的, 辅助电源. The building has auxiliary power backup. 大楼有辅助电源备份。 | auxil->增援（拉丁auxilium->帮助），auxiliary->提供增援的=辅助的（cf. augment增加，August威严，inauguration就职） || 文化联想：中国大楼停电时启动备用电源最适合帮助记忆 auxiliary，可以说 **auxiliary power — “A hospital may switch to auxiliary power when the main electrical supply fails.”**

quiz.question: pecuniary ________
quiz.explanation: 金钱的; 财务的, 金钱利益. He had no pecuniary interest in the project. 他对该项目没有金钱利益。 | pecuni->钱（拉丁pecunia->牲畜=财富），pecuniary->关于金钱的（cf. impecunious贫困，peculiar特别=个人的，fee费用） || 文化联想：中文“经济利益、钱方面的利害关系”最适合帮助记忆 pecuniary，可以说 **a pecuniary interest — “A board member should disclose a pecuniary interest before voting on a contract that could bring personal financial gain.”**

quiz.question: ___ apiary
quiz.explanation: 蜂房; 养蜂场, 蜂房. The bee apiary produces honey. 蜂房生产蜂蜜。 | api->蜜蜂（拉丁apis），apiary->蜜蜂的居所=蜂房（cf. apiculture养蜂业，apitherapy蜂疗，cf. apiarian养蜂人） || 文化联想：中国乡村养蜂合作社最适合帮助记忆 apiary，可以说 **a bee apiary — “A rural cooperative may maintain a bee apiary beside orchards and fields to produce honey and support pollination.”**

quiz.question: ____ aviary
quiz.explanation: 鸟舍; 大鸟笼, 鸟舍. The bird aviary housed exotic species. 鸟舍饲养了异国物种。 | avi->鸟（拉丁avis），aviary->鸟的居所=鸟舍（cf. aviation航空，aviator飞行员，avifauna鸟类群，auspicious吉祥=鸟兆） || 文化联想：中国动物园的大型鸟舍最适合帮助记忆 aviary，可以说 **a bird aviary — “A large bird aviary may allow visitors to walk among parrots, finches, and other species.”**

quiz.question: ancillary _____
quiz.explanation: 辅助的; 附属的, 辅助人员. Ancillary staff support the main team. 辅助人员支持主要团队。 | ancilla->女奴（拉丁），ancillary->像女奴一样服务的=辅助的（cf. ancilla附属物，auxiliary辅助，subsidiary从属） || 文化联想：中文“辅助人员、配套支持”最适合帮助记忆 ancillary，可以说 **ancillary staff — “Ancillary staff such as technicians and coordinators can keep a hospital department running smoothly.”**

quiz.question: capillary ______
quiz.explanation: 毛细管的, 毛细管作用. Capillary action draws water upward. 毛细管作用向上吸水。 | capill->头发（拉丁capillus），capillary->像头发一样细的管子=毛细管（cf. capital头/首都，capitalize利用，cape海角=头部） || 文化联想：中国物理课里毛细管吸水最适合帮助记忆 capillary，可以说 **capillary action — “Capillary action can draw water upward through a very narrow tube against gravity.”**

quiz.question: exemplary _______
quiz.explanation: 模范的; 典型的, 模范行为. Her exemplary conduct earned praise. 她的模范行为赢得了赞扬。 | exempl->例子（拉丁exemplum），exemplary->作为例子的=模范的（cf. example例子，exemplify举例说明，exempt豁免） || 文化联想：中文“模范行为、值得大家学习”最适合帮助记忆 exemplary，可以说 **exemplary conduct — “A student who returns a lost wallet untouched may be praised for exemplary conduct.”**

quiz.question: customary ________
quiz.explanation: 习惯的; 惯例的, 习惯做法. Its customary practice to shake hands. 握手是习惯做法。 | custom->习俗（拉丁consuetudo），customary->习俗性的（cf. custom习俗，customer顾客，accustom使习惯，customs海关） || 文化联想：春节见长辈拜年属于熟悉的惯例场景，最适合帮助记忆 customary，可以说 **a customary practice — “Visiting older relatives during Spring Festival is a customary practice in many families.”**

quiz.question: canary ______
quiz.explanation: 金丝雀; 淡黄色, 金丝雀黄. She wore a bright canary yellow dress. 她穿着明亮的金丝雀黄连衣裙。 | Canary->加那利群岛（拉丁Canaria->犬岛），canary->加那利群岛上的黄色小鸟（cf. canary yellow金丝雀黄，canine犬的） || 文化联想：金丝雀鲜亮的黄色最适合帮助记忆 canary，可以说 **canary yellow — “A bright canary yellow jacket can stand out immediately in a crowded street.”**

quiz.question: _____ granary
quiz.explanation: 粮仓; 谷仓, 粮仓. The grain granary stores the harvest. 粮仓储存收获的粮食。 | gran->粮食（拉丁granum->谷粒），granary->存储谷粒的地方=粮仓（cf. grain谷粒，granite花岗岩=粒状石，granule颗粒） || 文化联想：中国古代常说“天下粮仓”，最适合帮助记忆 granary，可以说 **a grain granary — “A well-stocked grain granary could help a farming community survive a poor harvest.”**

quiz.question: mercenary _______
quiz.explanation: 雇佣兵; 唯利是图的, 雇佣兵. The mercenary soldier fought for money. 雇佣兵为钱而战。 | merced->报酬（拉丁merces），mercenary->为报酬服务的人=雇佣兵（cf. merchant商人，mercy仁慈=不要报酬，merit功绩） || 文化联想：mercenary 是“为钱作战的雇佣兵”，可用中国学生学习世界军事史来记忆，可以说 **a mercenary soldier — “A mercenary soldier fights primarily for pay rather than loyalty to a particular country.”**

quiz.question: plenary _______
quiz.explanation: 全体的; 全体会议, 全体会议. The plenary session included all members. 全体会议包括所有成员。 | plen->充满/全（拉丁plenus），plenary->全体充满的=全体（cf. plenty充足，replenish补充，supplement补充，complete完整） || 文化联想：中国大型会议里的全体大会最适合帮助记忆 plenary，可以说 **a plenary session — “At a large academic conference, every participant may attend the opening plenary session.”**

quiz.question: interdisciplinary ________
quiz.explanation: 跨学科的, 跨学科研究. Interdisciplinary research combines multiple fields. 跨学科研究结合了多个领域。 | inter->之间，disciplinary->学科的（disciplina->教学），interdisciplinary->在学科之间=跨学科的（cf. discipline纪律，disciple门徒，discipline教导） || 文化联想：中国人工智能研究常结合计算机、数学、语言学等领域，最适合帮助记忆 interdisciplinary，可以说 **interdisciplinary research — “Modern AI often requires interdisciplinary research combining computer science, mathematics, linguistics, and cognitive science.”**

quiz.question: culinary ____
quiz.explanation: 烹饪的, 烹饪艺术. He studied culinary arts at a prestigious school. 他在一所著名学校学习烹饪艺术。 | culina->厨房（拉丁），culinary->厨房相关的=烹饪的（cf. kiln窑炉，culinary art烹饪艺术，cuisine菜系） || 文化联想：淮扬菜讲究刀工、火候与摆盘的完整厨艺体系最适合帮助记忆 culinary，可以说 **culinary arts — “A chef studying Huaiyang cuisine may spend years mastering the culinary arts of cutting, seasoning, cooking, and presentation.”**

quiz.question: _________ seminary
quiz.explanation: 神学院; 学院, 宗教神学院. He attended a religious seminary to become a priest. 他参加了宗教神学院成为牧师。 | semin->种子（拉丁semen），seminary->播种知识的地方=神学院（cf. seminal开创性的，inseminate播种，semen精液） || 文化联想：seminary 是基督教神学院，可用中国学生参观教会学校或学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **a religious seminary — “A student studying Christianity may learn that a religious seminary trains people for ministry and theological work.”**

quiz.question: preliminary _____
quiz.explanation: 初步的; 预备的, 预赛. The team advanced past the preliminary round. 球队通过了预赛。 | pre->之前，limin->门槛（拉丁limen），preliminary->越过门槛之前的=预备的（cf. eliminate淘汰=踢出门槛，subliminal阈下的） || 文化联想：中国体育比赛先打预赛再进决赛最适合帮助记忆 preliminary，可以说 **a preliminary round — “A young table-tennis player must survive the preliminary round before entering the main competition.”**

quiz.question: ________ luminary
quiz.explanation: 杰出人物; 名人, 行业名人. An industry luminary gave the keynote speech. 一位行业名人发表了主题演讲。 | lumin->光（拉丁lumen），luminary->发光者=杰出人物（cf. illuminate照亮，luminous发光的，lumen流明，lunar月亮的） || 文化联想：钱学森这类在专业领域具有巨大影响力的杰出人物最适合帮助记忆 luminary，可以说 **a scientific luminary — “A scientific luminary can shape an entire field through influential research, teaching, and leadership.”**

quiz.question: veterinary ______
quiz.explanation: 兽医的, 兽医诊所. Take your pet to the veterinary clinic. 把你的宠物带到兽医诊所。 | veter->老/经验丰富（拉丁vetus），veterinary->治疗老/役畜的=兽医（cf. veteran老兵，inveterate根深蒂固，veto否决权） || 文化联想：中国城市里给猫狗看病的宠物医院最适合帮助记忆 veterinary，可以说 **a veterinary clinic — “A family may take a sick cat to a veterinary clinic for examination and treatment.”**

quiz.question: visionary ______
quiz.explanation: 有远见的; 空想家, 有远见的领导者. The visionary leader transformed the company. 有远见的领导者改变了公司。 | vis->看（拉丁videre），visionary->能看到未来的人=有远见的（cf. vision视觉，visible可见，supervise监督，television电视） || 文化联想：中文“有远见、能看到未来趋势”最适合帮助记忆 visionary，可以说 **a visionary leader — “A visionary leader may invest in a new technology years before most competitors recognize its importance.”**

quiz.question: stationary ____
quiz.explanation: 静止的; 固定的, 固定自行车. She exercises on a stationary bike. 她在固定自行车上锻炼。 | statio->站立（拉丁stare），stationary->固定站立不动的（注意区分stationery文具，cf. station站，statue雕像） || 文化联想：中国健身房里原地骑但车身不移动的单车最适合帮助记忆 stationary，可以说 **a stationary bike — “A gym member can pedal hard on a stationary bike while remaining in exactly the same place.”**

quiz.question: reactionary ______
quiz.explanation: 反动的; 保守的, 反动势力. Reactionary forces opposed the reforms. 反动势力反对改革。 | reaction->反应，ary->倾向于，reactionary->倾向于向后反应的=反动的（cf. react反应，revolutionary革命的，progressive进步的） || 文化联想：reactionary 是政治史里的“反动、极端守旧”概念，可用中国学生学习近现代史时来记忆，可以说 **reactionary forces — “In a history class, students may read about reactionary forces that resist reform and try to restore an older political order.”**

quiz.question: _____ functionary
quiz.explanation: 公务员; 官员, 党务官员. The party functionary attended all meetings. 党务官员参加了所有会议。 | function->职能（拉丁fungi->执行），functionary->执行职能的人=官员（cf. function功能，defunct停止，malfunction故障） || 文化联想：中文“按职务办事的官员”最适合帮助记忆 functionary，可以说 **an administrative functionary — “An administrative functionary may carry out routine duties according to established rules rather than set policy personally.”**

quiz.question: discretionary ________
quiz.explanation: 自由支配的; 任意的, 可自由支配的开支. The budget includes discretionary spending. 预算包括可自由支配的开支。 | discret->分辨/判断（拉丁discernere），discretionary->依判断决定的（cf. discreet谨慎，discrete分离的，discretion酌情） || 文化联想：中国家庭预算里“旅游、娱乐、升级电子产品”属于可自由决定的部分，最适合帮助记忆 discretionary，可以说 **discretionary spending — “A family can cut discretionary spending on travel and entertainment when it needs to save more money.”**

quiz.question: cautionary ____
quiz.explanation: 警告的; 告诫的, 警世故事. The movie serves as a cautionary tale. 这部电影是一个警世故事。 | caution->谨慎（拉丁cautio），cautionary->起警告作用的（cf. caution警告，precaution预防，incautious不谨慎） || 文化联想：“守株待兔”这类用故事提醒人不要犯同样错误的寓言最适合帮助记忆 cautionary，可以说 **a cautionary tale — “The story can serve as a cautionary tale about relying on luck instead of adapting to changing circumstances.”**

quiz.question: hoary ______
quiz.explanation: 灰白的; 古老的, 古老的传说. The hoary legend has been told for centuries. 古老的传说已流传了几个世纪。 | hoary->白发（古英语har->灰白），hoary->灰白头发的=古老的（cf. hoarfrost白霜，hoary old joke陈年老笑话，gray灰） || 文化联想：中文“陈年老传说”最适合帮助记忆 hoary，可以说 **a hoary legend — “A hoary legend repeated for centuries may survive even after nobody remembers where it began.”**

quiz.question: ______ itinerary
quiz.explanation: 旅行计划; 路线, 旅行行程. The travel itinerary includes five countries. 旅行行程包括五个国家。 | iter->旅程（拉丁iter->道路），itinerary->旅程的记录=行程（cf. itinerant流动的，reiterate重复，exit出口=出去的路） || 文化联想：中国游客出发前把每天城市、酒店和景点排好的行程表最适合帮助记忆 itinerary，可以说 **a travel itinerary — “A traveler may prepare a travel itinerary listing each day’s train, hotel, and sightseeing plans.”**

quiz.question: ______ emissary
quiz.explanation: 使者; 密使, 秘密使者. A secret emissary delivered the message. 一位秘密使者传递了信息。 | emiss->派出（拉丁emittere），emissary->被派出的人=使者（cf. emit发射，emission排放，missile导弹=被发射的，mission任务） || 文化联想：古装剧里秘密奉命出使传信的人最适合帮助记忆 emissary，可以说 **a secret emissary — “A ruler in a historical drama may send a secret emissary to deliver a private message to an ally.”**

quiz.question: glossary _____
quiz.explanation: 术语表; 词汇表, 术语表术语. The glossary terms are defined at the back. 术语表术语在后面定义。 | gloss->注释（希腊glossa->语言），glossary->词语注释的汇编=词汇表（cf. gloss光泽/注释，glossy光亮的，polyglot多语言） || 文化联想：中国技术教材最后专门解释专业词汇的一页最适合帮助记忆 glossary，可以说 **a technical glossary — “A textbook may include a technical glossary that defines unfamiliar terms for beginners.”**

quiz.question: proprietary ________
quiz.explanation: 专有的; 私有的, 专有软件. The company uses proprietary software. 公司使用专有软件。 | propri->自己的（拉丁proprius），proprietary->属于所有者的=专有的（cf. proper适当的，property财产，appropriate挪用/适当） || 文化联想：公司内部不公开源代码、只有授权用户能使用的软件最适合帮助记忆 proprietary，可以说 **proprietary software — “A company may rely on proprietary software whose source code and license are controlled by a single owner.”**

quiz.question: monetary ______
quiz.explanation: 货币的; 金融的, 货币政策. The central bank sets monetary policy. 中央银行制定货币政策。 | moneta->铸币（拉丁，Juno Moneta女神），monetary->货币相关的（cf. money金钱，mint铸币厂，monitor警告=朱诺女神在警告） || 文化联想：中文“货币政策”最适合帮助记忆 monetary，可以说 **monetary policy — “A central bank can use monetary policy to influence interest rates, credit conditions, and inflation.”**

quiz.question: hereditary _______
quiz.explanation: 遗传的; 世袭的, 遗传性疾病. Hemophilia is a hereditary disease. 血友病是遗传性疾病。 | hered->继承（拉丁heres->继承人），hereditary->通过继承传递的（cf. inherit继承，heir继承人，heritage遗产） || 文化联想：中国医院问诊时常会询问家族病史，最适合帮助记忆 hereditary，可以说 **a hereditary disease — “A doctor may ask about relatives because a hereditary disease can be passed from one generation to the next.”**

quiz.question: solitary ___________
quiz.explanation: 单独的; 孤独的, 单独监禁. The prisoner was placed in solitary confinement. 囚犯被单独监禁。 | solit->单独（拉丁solus->孤独），solitary->独自一人的（cf. solo独奏，solitude孤独，sole唯一，sole脚底） || 文化联想：中文“单独监禁、与其他人完全隔离”最适合帮助记忆 solitary，可以说 **solitary confinement — “A prisoner in solitary confinement is kept apart from the general prison population.”**

quiz.question: sanitary __________
quiz.explanation: 卫生的; 清洁的, 卫生条件. The restaurant maintains sanitary conditions. 餐厅保持卫生条件。 | sanit->健康（拉丁sanitas），sanitary->保持健康清洁的（cf. sane清醒，sanitize消毒，insane疯狂，sanatorium疗养院） || 文化联想：中国餐馆后厨检查最看重清洁、消毒和食品保存，最适合帮助记忆 sanitary，可以说 **sanitary conditions — “A restaurant must maintain sanitary conditions in its kitchen to reduce the risk of contamination.”**

quiz.question: ________ dignitary
quiz.explanation: 显要人物; 高官, 来访显要. The visiting dignitary received a warm welcome. 来访显要受到热烈欢迎。 | dignit->尊严（拉丁dignitas），dignitary->有尊严地位的人=显要（cf. dignity尊严，dignified庄重，condescend屈尊，indignation愤慨） || 文化联想：国际会议机场迎宾时隆重接待的重要来宾最适合帮助记忆 dignitary，可以说 **a visiting dignitary — “Officials may arrange a formal reception for a visiting dignitary arriving for an international conference.”**

quiz.question: complementary ______
quiz.explanation: 互补的; 补充的, 互补色. Red and green are complementary colors. 红色和绿色是互补色。 | complet->填满（拉丁），complementary->互相填满缺口的（注意区分complimentary赞美的，cf. complete完整，supplement补充） || 文化联想：中国美术课堂学习红绿、蓝橙等互补关系最适合帮助记忆 complementary，可以说 **complementary colors — “An art student may place complementary colors side by side to create strong visual contrast.”**

quiz.question: rudimentary ______
quiz.explanation: 基本的; 初步的, 基本技能. He has only rudimentary skills in cooking. 他只有烹饪的基本技能。 | rudiment->最初的学习（拉丁rudis->粗糙未加工），rudimentary->最初级的（cf. rude粗鲁/原始，erudite博学=去除粗糙，rudiment基础） || 文化联想：刚学毛笔字只会基本握笔和横竖撇捺最适合帮助记忆 rudimentary，可以说 **rudimentary skills — “A beginner in calligraphy may have only rudimentary skills in brush control and basic strokes.”**

quiz.question: alimentary _____
quiz.explanation: 营养的; 消化的, 消化道. The alimentary canal processes food. 消化道处理食物。 | aliment->食物（拉丁alimentum），alimentary->与食物营养相关的（cf. alimony赡养费，alimentation进食，nourish滋养） || 文化联想：中国医学院解剖课里的“消化道”最适合帮助记忆 alimentary，可以说 **the alimentary canal — “The alimentary canal carries food through the digestive system from the mouth onward.”**

quiz.question: ______ commentary
quiz.explanation: 评论; 注释, 体育评论. The sports commentary was entertaining. 体育评论很有趣。 | comment->评注（拉丁commentari->仔细思考），commentary->对事件的持续评注（cf. comment评论，commend赞扬，commence开始） || 文化联想：央视或其他体育频道边比赛边解说最适合帮助记忆 commentary，可以说 **sports commentary — “Good sports commentary explains tactics and key moments while the match is unfolding.”**

quiz.question: involuntary ______
quiz.explanation: 非自愿的; 无意识的, 非自愿抽搐. He had an involuntary twitch in his eye. 他的眼睛有非自愿抽搐。 | in->否定，voluntary->自愿的（拉丁velle->愿意），involuntary->非自愿的（cf. volunteer自愿者，volition意志，benevolent善意） || 文化联想：中文“眼皮不受控制地跳一下”最适合帮助记忆 involuntary，可以说 **an involuntary twitch — “Fatigue or stress can sometimes cause an involuntary twitch around the eye.”**

quiz.question: votary __ ___
quiz.explanation: 信徒; 热心者, 艺术热心者. She is a devoted votary of art. 她是艺术的忠实热心者。 | vot->誓言（拉丁votum），votary->发誓献身的人=信徒/热心者（cf. vote投票，devout虔诚，devote奉献，votive还愿的） || 文化联想：在敦煌艺术保护中一生投入研究与保存的人可以帮助记忆 votary，可以说 **a votary of art — “A conservator who devotes an entire career to preserving Dunhuang murals could be described as a votary of art.”**

quiz.question: _____ tributary
quiz.explanation: 支流; 进贡国, 河流支流. The river tributary flows into the main stream. 河流支流流入主河道。 | tribut->给予（拉丁tribuere），tributary->向主河流贡献水流的（cf. tribute贡物，contribute贡献，distribute分发，attribute归因） || 文化联想：嘉陵江汇入长江的地理关系最适合帮助记忆 tributary，可以说 **a major tributary — “The Jialing River is a major tributary that flows into the Yangtze at Chongqing.”**

quiz.question: salutary ______
quiz.explanation: 有益的; 有用的, 有益的教训. The failure taught a salutary lesson. 失败教会了有益的教训。 | salut->健康（拉丁salus），salutary->有益于健康/改善的（cf. salute敬礼=祝平安，salubrious有益健康，salutation问候） || 文化联想：中文“吃一堑长一智”最适合帮助记忆 salutary，可以说 **a salutary lesson — “A costly mistake can become a salutary lesson if it changes how future decisions are made.”**

quiz.question: ______ statuary
quiz.explanation: 雕像; 雕塑, 大理石雕像. The garden features marble statuary. 花园以大理石雕像为特色。 | stat->站立（拉丁stare），statuary->站立的雕塑=雕像的总称（cf. statue雕像，stature身高，status地位，static静态） || 文化联想：龙门石窟成片石刻佛像最适合帮助记忆 statuary，可以说 **stone statuary — “The Longmen Grottoes contain extensive stone statuary carved into cliffs and caves.”**

quiz.question: obituary ______
quiz.explanation: 讣告, 讣告通知. The obituary notice appeared in the newspaper. 讣告通知出现在报纸上。 | obit->死亡（拉丁obire->走向死亡），obituary->关于死亡的通告=讣告（cf. obituary栏，oblivion遗忘，mortuary太平间） || 文化联想：中文“报纸上的讣告”最适合帮助记忆 obituary，可以说 **an obituary notice — “A newspaper may publish an obituary notice summarizing a person’s life and announcing the death.”**

quiz.question: mortuary _______
quiz.explanation: 太平间; 殡仪的, 殡葬科学. He studied mortuary science in college. 他在大学学习殡葬科学。 | mort->死亡（拉丁mors），mortuary->与死亡相关的场所/学问（cf. mortal死亡，immortal不死，mortgage抵押=死亡之承诺） || 文化联想：中国殡葬服务专业学习遗体处理、仪式和行业规范的场景最适合帮助记忆 mortuary，可以说 **mortuary science — “Students in funeral-service programs may study mortuary science, including care of the deceased and professional practice.”**

quiz.question: _____ estuary
quiz.explanation: 河口; 三角江, 河口. The river estuary meets the ocean. 河口与海洋汇合。 | estuary->潮汐进入处（拉丁aestus->潮汐），estuary->潮汐汇入的河口（cf. estival夏天的，aestivate夏眠，estivation夏眠） || 文化联想：长江水流进入东海的开阔河口最适合帮助记忆 estuary，可以说 **the Yangtze estuary — “The Yangtze estuary is where river water meets the sea and is strongly influenced by tides.”**

quiz.question: decry __________
quiz.explanation: 谴责; 公开反对, 谴责腐败. Politicians decry corruption publicly. 政客公开谴责腐败。 | de->向下，cry->呼喊，decry->大声反对=公开谴责（cf. cry呼喊，outcry大声抗议，decry vs descry区分） || 文化联想：中文“公开谴责腐败”最适合帮助记忆 decry，可以说 **decry corruption — “Citizens and journalists may decry corruption when public power is abused for private gain.”**

quiz.question: descry _ ____
quiz.explanation: 看见; 发现, 看见船帆. The lookout could descry a sail on the horizon. 瞭望员能看见地平线上的船帆。 | de->彻底，scry->查看（古法语descrier），descry->仔细察看发现=远处看见（cf. decry谴责，espy发现，descry远距发现） || 文化联想：古代烽火台哨兵极目远眺、终于发现远处目标最适合帮助记忆 descry，可以说 **descry a distant sail — “From a high lookout, a watchman may descry a distant sail near the horizon.”**

quiz.question: ______ husbandry
quiz.explanation: 畜牧业; 农业, 现代畜牧业. Modern husbandry uses advanced technology. 现代畜牧业使用先进技术。 | husband->家庭主人（古挪威husbondi->房屋主人），husbandry->主人管理农场的技能=农业（cf. husband丈夫/节约，housewife家庭主妇） || 文化联想：内蒙古牧区现代化养牛养羊最适合帮助记忆 husbandry，可以说 **modern animal husbandry — “Modern animal husbandry can combine careful breeding, nutrition, veterinary care, and pasture management.”**

quiz.question: polyandry ________
quiz.explanation: 一妻多夫制, 一妻多夫制婚姻. Polyandry marriage is rare in most cultures. 一妻多夫制婚姻在大多数文化中很罕见。 | poly->多，andr->男人（希腊aner），polyandry->一女多男的婚姻（cf. polygamy一夫多妻，androgynous雌雄同体，android机器人） || 文化联想：polyandry 是人类学中的“一妻多夫制”，可用中国学生学习世界婚姻制度时来记忆，可以说 **polyandry marriage — “In an anthropology class, students may study a polyandry marriage in which one woman has more than one husband.”**

quiz.question: sundry _____
quiz.explanation: 各种各样的; 杂项的, 杂项. The store sells sundry items. 商店出售杂项。 | sundry->分开的/各种（古英语syndrig->分离的），sundry->各种各样的（cf. sunder分开，asunder分裂，all and sundry所有人） || 文化联想：中国老式杂货铺里针线、灯泡、肥皂等什么都卖最适合帮助记忆 sundry，可以说 **sundry items — “A neighborhood shop may sell sundry items ranging from batteries and soap to sewing needles.”**

quiz.question: ____ wizardry
quiz.explanation: 魔法; 巫术, 高级魔法. The movie features high wizardry effects. 电影以高级魔法效果为特色。 | wizard->智者/巫师（wise->聪明），wizardry->巫师的技能=魔法（cf. wise聪明，wisdom智慧，wizard巫师，cf. Wizard of Oz绿野仙踪） || 文化联想：《西游记》里孙悟空七十二变最适合帮助记忆 wizardry，可以说 **high wizardry — “In a fantasy retelling of Journey to the West, spectacular transformations may look like high wizardry.”**

quiz.question: tawdry _______
quiz.explanation: 俗丽的; 廉价而花哨的, 俗丽的珠宝. She wore tawdry jewelry that looked fake. 她戴着看起来假的俗丽珠宝。 | tawdry->来自St Audrey（圣奥德里节的廉价花边），tawdry->廉价花哨（cf. shoddy劣质，gaudy艳丽，tacky俗气） || 文化联想：夜市地摊上镀金掉色、看着华丽其实廉价的首饰最适合帮助记忆 tawdry，可以说 **tawdry jewelry — “A night-market stall may sell tawdry jewelry that sparkles brightly but looks cheap up close.”**

quiz.question: _____ sorcery
quiz.explanation: 巫术; 魔法, 黑魔法. The villain practiced black sorcery. 恶棍修炼黑魔法。 | sorcer->占卜者（古法语sorcier，拉丁sors->命运），sorcery->通过占卜施法=巫术（cf. sort分类/命运，lot命运，oracle神谕） || 文化联想：《聊斋》式志怪故事中的邪术场景最适合帮助记忆 sorcery，可以说 **black sorcery — “A villain in a supernatural tale may use black sorcery to frighten or curse other characters.”**

quiz.question: leery __ _________
quiz.explanation: 警惕的; 猜疑的, 警惕陌生人. Parents teach children to be leery of strangers. 父母教孩子警惕陌生人。 | leery->警觉（来源不明，可能来自leer->斜眼看），leery->怀疑警惕的（cf. wary警惕，chary谨慎，suspicious可疑） || 文化联想：中文“不要轻易相信陌生人”最适合帮助记忆 leery，可以说 **be leery of strangers — “Parents often teach young children to be leery of strangers who ask them to go somewhere alone.”**

quiz.question: peery ____
quiz.explanation: 窥视的; 好奇的, 窥视的眼睛. The detective had sharp peery eyes. 侦探有敏锐的窥视眼睛。 | peer->仔细看（来源不明，可能来自appear出现），peery->爱窥视的（cf. peer凝视，peering仔细看，peer同龄人） || 文化联想：中文“好奇地盯着看、眼神一直往里探”最适合帮助记忆 peery，可以说 **peery eyes — “A curious child may watch a mysterious box with peery eyes, eager to see what is inside.”**

quiz.question: ___________ puffery
quiz.explanation: 吹捧; 夸大宣传, 广告吹捧. The advertising puffery was clearly exaggerated. 广告吹捧明显夸张。 | puff->吹气/夸大（象声词），puffery->夸大吹捧=浮夸宣传（cf. puff吹气，puffed up自大，powder puff粉扑） || 文化联想：中国电商直播里“全网第一、史上最好”这类明显夸大的宣传最适合帮助记忆 puffery，可以说 **advertising puffery — “Claims such as ‘the greatest product ever made’ are often examples of advertising puffery rather than measurable facts.”**

quiz.question: ______ drudgery
quiz.explanation: 苦工; 单调乏味的工作, 办公室苦工. He hated the office drudgery of paperwork. 他讨厌文书工作的办公室苦工。 | drudge->苦干（来源不明），drudgery->单调辛苦的劳动（cf. drudge苦干，toil辛劳，grind磨/苦干，slog艰苦劳动） || 文化联想：中文“每天填表、盖章、复制粘贴的办公室苦活”最适合帮助记忆 drudgery，可以说 **office drudgery — “Hours of repetitive forms, copying, and filing can turn routine administration into office drudgery.”**

quiz.question: _________ skullduggery
quiz.explanation: 欺诈; 诡计, 政治诡计. The scandal revealed political skullduggery. 丑闻揭露了政治诡计。 | skull->头骨，duggery->欺诈（skulduggery的变体），skullduggery->骷髅般的诡计=欺诈（cf. skulk潜伏，underhand不光彩，chicanery诡辩） || 文化联想：古装权谋剧里暗中设局、偷偷做手脚最适合帮助记忆 skullduggery，可以说 **political skullduggery — “A historical drama may depict political skullduggery involving secret deals, forged messages, and hidden alliances.”**

quiz.question: forgery ______
quiz.explanation: 伪造; 伪造罪, 伪造罪. He was arrested on a forgery charge. 他因伪造罪被捕。 | forge->锻造/伪造（拉丁fabricare），forgery->非法的伪造（cf. forge铁匠铺/伪造，counterfeit假冒，falsify伪造） || 文化联想：古玩市场仿造名家字画最适合帮助记忆 forgery，可以说 **a forgery charge — “Selling a fake painting as an authentic work can lead to a forgery charge.”**

quiz.question: ____ periphery
quiz.explanation: 外围; 边缘, 城市外围. They live on the city periphery. 他们住在城市外围。 | peri->周围（希腊），phery->携带（希腊pherein），periphery->携带在周围=外围（cf. peripheral周边，perimeter周长，atmosphere大气层） || 文化联想：北京城区不断向外扩展的城郊地带最适合帮助记忆 periphery，可以说 **the city periphery — “New housing developments often appear first on the city periphery before becoming part of the urban core.”**

quiz.question: ________ fishery
quiz.explanation: 渔场; 渔业, 近海渔场. The offshore fishery provides jobs. 近海渔场提供就业机会。 | fish->鱼，ery->场所，fishery->捕鱼的场所=渔场（cf. bakery面包店，brewery酿酒厂，nursery托儿所） || 文化联想：舟山群岛传统海洋捕捞最适合帮助记忆 fishery，可以说 **an offshore fishery — “An offshore fishery near the Zhoushan Islands can support fishing fleets, ports, and local seafood markets.”**

quiz.question: _________ trickery
quiz.explanation: 欺骗; 诡计, 政治诡计. Voters are tired of political trickery. 选民厌倦了政治诡计。 | trick->欺骗（古法语trichier->欺骗），trickery->欺骗的行为（cf. trick诡计，tricky棘手，chicanery诡辩，duplicity两面性） || 文化联想：古装剧里靠假消息、障眼法和圈套取胜最适合帮助记忆 trickery，可以说 **political trickery — “A court intrigue may rely on political trickery rather than open argument or lawful procedure.”**

quiz.question: _____ crockery
quiz.explanation: 陶器; 瓦器, 中国陶器. The china crockery was beautifully painted. 中国陶器绘制精美。 | crock->陶罐（古英语crocca），crockery->陶罐等陶器的总称（cf. crock陶罐，crocodile鳄鱼=穿陶石的动物，crochet钩针） || 文化联想：中国家庭成套青花瓷碗碟最适合帮助记忆 crockery，可以说 **china crockery — “A family may keep a set of blue-and-white china crockery for special meals and guests.”**

quiz.question: ____-_______ raillery
quiz.explanation: 善意的嘲弄; 打趣, 善意的打趣. Friends engaged in good-natured raillery. 朋友们进行善意的打趣。 | rail->嘲笑（法语railler->嘲弄），raillery->善意的嘲弄（cf. banter打趣，rail at责骂，badinage轻松玩笑） || 文化联想：相声搭档互相“损”几句但并无恶意最适合帮助记忆 raillery，可以说 **good-natured raillery — “Two xiangsheng performers may trade good-natured raillery that sounds sharp but remains playful.”**

quiz.question: _____ artillery
quiz.explanation: 火炮; 炮兵, 重炮. The army deployed heavy artillery. 军队部署了重炮。 | artill->机械（拉丁ars->技艺），artillery->用技艺制造的攻城机械=火炮（cf. art艺术，artisan工匠，artifact人工制品） || 文化联想：中国军事博物馆里的大口径火炮最适合帮助记忆 artillery，可以说 **heavy artillery — “A military museum may display heavy artillery designed to fire powerful shells over long distances.”**

quiz.question: ___ drollery
quiz.explanation: 滑稽; 诙谐, 冷幽默. His dry drollery amused the audience. 他的冷幽默逗乐了观众。 | droll->滑稽（荷兰语drol->小矮人），drollery->滑稽诙谐的表演（cf. droll滑稽的，whimsy奇思，waggish滑稽的） || 文化联想：相声演员一本正经地抛出荒诞包袱最适合帮助记忆 drollery，可以说 **dry drollery — “A comedian may use dry drollery by delivering an absurd line with a completely serious face.”**

quiz.question: ______ cutlery
quiz.explanation: 餐具, 银餐具. The table was set with silver cutlery. 桌子上摆着银餐具。 | cut->切，lery->工具，cutlery->切割用的器具=餐具（cf. cut切，scissors剪刀，cutlass短弯刀，cutler刀具商） || 文化联想：中国高级酒店西式宴会摆出的银质刀叉勺最适合帮助记忆 cutlery，可以说 **silver cutlery — “A formal hotel banquet may place polished silver cutlery beside each plate.”**

quiz.question: _________ chicanery
quiz.explanation: 欺骗; 诡辩, 政治欺骗. The investigation uncovered political chicanery. 调查揭露了政治欺骗。 | chicane->玩文字游戏（法语chicanerie），chicanery->通过诡辩欺骗（cf. chicane赛道急转弯/诡计，trickery诡计，skulduggery阴谋） || 文化联想：中文“靠文字游戏和程序小动作钻空子”最适合帮助记忆 chicanery，可以说 **legal chicanery — “A dishonest company may use legal chicanery to delay responsibility without addressing the real issue.”**

quiz.question: _______ finery
quiz.explanation: 华丽服饰; 装饰, 婚礼盛装. The bride wore beautiful wedding finery. 新娘穿着美丽的婚礼盛装。 | fine->精致（拉丁finis->最优质），finery->精美华丽的衣服（cf. fine罚款/精美，refine精炼，define定义=设定界限） || 文化联想：中式婚礼里新娘的礼服、珠宝和头饰最适合帮助记忆 finery，可以说 **wedding finery — “A bride may wear elaborate wedding finery including an embroidered dress, jewelry, and ceremonial hair ornaments.”**

quiz.question: ___ refinery
quiz.explanation: 精炼厂, 炼油厂. The oil refinery processes crude oil. 炼油厂加工原油。 | re->再次，fine->精炼，refinery->再次精炼的工厂（cf. refine精炼，fine精美，define定义，confine限制） || 文化联想：中国大型石化基地把原油加工成燃料和化工原料最适合帮助记忆 refinery，可以说 **an oil refinery — “An oil refinery processes crude oil into fuels and other useful petroleum products.”**

quiz.question: _________ trumpery
quiz.explanation: 华而不实的东西; 废物, 毫无价值的华而不实之物. The shop sold worthless trumpery. 商店出售毫无价值的华而不实之物。 | trumpery->欺骗（古法语tromper->欺骗），trumpery->表面华丽实则无价值的东西（cf. trump王牌，trompe loeil错视画，deceive欺骗） || 文化联想：庙会地摊上花花绿绿却没什么价值的小玩意最适合帮助记忆 trumpery，可以说 **worthless trumpery — “A stall may be piled with worthless trumpery that looks colorful but has little real value.”**

quiz.question: slippery _____
quiz.explanation: 滑的; 狡猾的, 滑坡. This is a slippery slope argument. 这是一个滑坡论证。 | slip->滑（古英语slipian），slippery->容易滑倒的=滑溜/狡猾（cf. slip滑倒，slippery slope滑坡谬误，evasive狡滑） || 文化联想：北方冬天结冰的石阶一步不稳就容易滑倒，最适合帮助记忆 slippery，可以说 **a slippery slope — “An icy stone path can become a slippery slope where one careless step causes a fall.”**

quiz.question: ____ cemetery
quiz.explanation: 墓地; 公墓, 城市公墓. The city cemetery is well maintained. 城市公墓维护良好。 | koimeterion->睡觉的地方（希腊），cemetery->长眠之处=墓地（cf. dormitory宿舍=睡觉，cemetery原意"睡眠之处"） || 文化联想：清明节人们前往城市墓园祭扫最适合帮助记忆 cemetery，可以说 **a city cemetery — “Families may visit a city cemetery during Qingming to clean graves and remember relatives who have died.”**

quiz.question: ______ effrontery
quiz.explanation: 厚颜无耻, 厚颜无耻. His brazen effrontery shocked everyone. 他厚颜无耻震惊了所有人。 | ef->去除，front->额头（拉丁frons），effrontery->去除额头=无脸面=厚颜无耻（cf. front正面，affront冒犯，confront对抗） || 文化联想：中文“厚颜无耻、证据摆在眼前还敢强辩”最适合帮助记忆 effrontery，可以说 **brazen effrontery — “Denying an obvious wrongdoing despite clear evidence can display brazen effrontery.”**

quiz.question: ________ artery
quiz.explanation: 动脉, 冠状动脉. Blockage in the coronary artery is dangerous. 冠状动脉堵塞很危险。 | arteri->动脉（希腊arteria->导管），artery->输送血液的管道=动脉（cf. aorta主动脉，artery高速公路，arterial主要的） || 文化联想：中国医院心内科最熟悉的冠状动脉最适合帮助记忆 artery，可以说 **a coronary artery — “A blocked coronary artery can reduce blood flow to the heart muscle and cause serious illness.”**

quiz.question: ________ monastery
quiz.explanation: 修道院, 佛教寺院. The Buddhist monastery sits atop the mountain. 佛教寺院坐落在山顶。 | monast->独居（希腊monos->独），monastery->独自修行的地方（cf. monk修道士，monopoly垄断，monogamy一夫一妻，solo独奏） || 文化联想：五台山佛教寺院群最适合帮助记忆 monastery，可以说 **a Buddhist monastery — “A Buddhist monastery on Mount Wutai may include halls for worship, study, residence, and communal life.”**

quiz.question: ________ lottery
quiz.explanation: 彩票; 抽签, 国家彩票. She bought a national lottery ticket. 她买了一张国家彩票。 | lot->命运/抽签（古英语hlot），lottery->抽签的游戏=彩票（cf. lot命运，allot分配，ballot选票=小球，jeopardy危险） || 文化联想：中国街头福利彩票销售点最适合帮助记忆 lottery，可以说 **a lottery ticket — “A customer may buy a lottery ticket at an authorized kiosk and wait for the drawing.”**

quiz.question: ________ pottery
quiz.explanation: 陶器; 陶艺, 手工陶器. The shop sells handmade pottery. 商店出售手工陶器。 | pot->锅（古英语pott），pottery->制作陶罐的地方/陶器（cf. pot锅，potty幼儿马桶，potter陶工，Pottery Barn陶仓） || 文化联想：景德镇手工拉坯、上釉、烧制陶器最适合帮助记忆 pottery，可以说 **handmade pottery — “A Jingdezhen artisan may shape handmade pottery on a wheel before glazing and firing it.”**

quiz.question: _____ query
quiz.explanation: 疑问; 询问, 现场询问. The journalist made a field query. 记者进行了现场询问。 | quaerere->寻找/询问（拉丁），query->询问（cf. question疑问，request请求，quest探索，inquest调查，acquire获取） || 文化联想：程序员在数据库里写查询语句最适合帮助记忆 query，可以说 **a database query — “A developer may run a database query to find all orders placed during a particular week.”**

quiz.question: ______ __ inquiry
quiz.explanation: 调查; 询问, 发起调查. Officials will launch an inquiry into the matter. 官员将对此事发起调查。 | in->进入，quiry->寻找（拉丁quaerere），inquiry->深入寻找=调查（cf. query询问，acquire获取，inquest调查审讯） || 文化联想：中文“成立调查组、正式展开调查”最适合帮助记忆 inquiry，可以说 **launch an inquiry — “Officials may launch an inquiry after a serious construction accident to determine what went wrong.”**

quiz.question: cavalry ______
quiz.explanation: 骑兵, 骑兵冲锋. The cavalry charge was decisive. 骑兵冲锋是决定性的。 | caval->马（法语cheval，拉丁caballus），cavalry->骑马的军队=骑兵（cf. cavalier骑士，chivalry骑士精神，cavalcade骑马游行） || 文化联想：中国古代骑兵冲锋的战场画面最适合帮助记忆 cavalry，可以说 **a cavalry charge — “In a historical battle, mounted soldiers may launch a cavalry charge across open ground.”**

quiz.question: ______ rivalry
quiz.explanation: 竞争; 对抗, 市场竞争. Market rivalry drives innovation. 市场竞争推动创新。 | rival->竞争者（拉丁rivalis->用同一河流的人），rivalry->相互竞争的状态（cf. rival对手，derive源自，river河=大家争的资源） || 文化联想：中国电商平台争夺用户、商家和流量最适合帮助记忆 rivalry，可以说 **market rivalry — “Intense market rivalry can push competing e-commerce platforms to lower fees and improve service.”**

quiz.question: _____ revelry
quiz.explanation: 狂欢; 欢闹, 喧闹的狂欢. Noisy revelry continued until dawn. 喧闹的狂欢持续到黎明。 | revel->狂欢（古法语reveler->叛逆/狂欢），revelry->放纵狂欢（cf. rebel叛逆，revelation启示，revel沉迷于） || 文化联想：春节跨年夜街头锣鼓、人群和欢呼最适合帮助记忆 revelry，可以说 **noisy revelry — “Noisy revelry may continue late into the night during a large New Year celebration.”**

quiz.question: _____ allegory
quiz.explanation: 寓言; 讽喻, 道德寓言. The story is a moral allegory about greed. 这个故事是关于贪婪的道德寓言。 | allos->其他（希腊），agory->说（希腊agoreuein->在广场演讲），allegory->用其他方式说出=寓言（cf. category类别，allegory隐喻故事） || 文化联想：“愚公移山”可以作为坚持不懈的寓意故事来帮助记忆 allegory，可以说 **a moral allegory — “The story of Yu the Great or the Foolish Old Man can be read as a moral allegory about persistence and human determination.”**

quiz.question: ______ pillory
quiz.explanation: 颈手枷; 示众, 公开示众. Critics put him in the public pillory. 批评者让他公开示众。 | pillar->柱子（拉丁pila），pillory->固定在柱子上示众的枷=颈手枷（cf. pillar支柱，pillory公开羞辱，milestone里程碑） || 文化联想：中文“被公开钉在耻辱柱上”最适合帮助记忆 pillory，可以说 **a public pillory — “A company exposed for serious fraud may face a public pillory in the press and on social media.”**

quiz.question: _______ armory
quiz.explanation: 军械库; 兵工厂, 武器库. The weapons armory stores military equipment. 武器库储存军事装备。 | arma->武器（拉丁），armory->存储武器的地方（cf. arm手臂/武装，army军队，armor盔甲，armada舰队） || 文化联想：古代王府或军营专门存放兵器的库房最适合帮助记忆 armory，可以说 **a weapons armory — “A palace guard might keep swords, bows, armor, and other equipment in a secured weapons armory.”**

quiz.question: provisory ________
quiz.explanation: 临时的; 暂时的, 临时合同. They signed a provisory contract. 他们签署了临时合同。 | provis->预见（拉丁providere），provisory->依条件而定的=临时的（cf. provide提供，provision供应，improvise即兴=未事先准备） || 文化联想：provisory 表示“暂定的、临时的”，可用中国商务谈判先签暂行协议来记忆，可以说 **a provisory contract — “Two companies may sign a provisory contract while lawyers continue negotiating the final terms.”**

quiz.question: compulsory _________
quiz.explanation: 强制的; 义务的, 义务教育. Compulsory education is required by law. 法律规定义务教育。 | compuls->强迫（拉丁compellere），compulsory->被强迫的（cf. compel强迫，impulse冲动，repulse击退，pulse脉冲） || 文化联想：中国“九年义务教育”最适合帮助记忆 compulsory，可以说 **compulsory education — “China’s system of compulsory education requires children to receive a defined period of basic schooling.”**

quiz.question: cursory ______
quiz.explanation: 粗略的; 草率的, 粗略的一瞥. He gave the document a cursory glance. 他对文件粗略地看了一眼。 | curs->奔跑（拉丁currere），cursory->匆忙跑过的=粗略的（cf. course路线，cursor光标，currency流通货币，excursion远足） || 文化联想：中文“走马观花地看一眼”最适合帮助记忆 cursory，可以说 **a cursory glance — “A rushed inspector may give the document only a cursory glance and miss an important detail.”**

quiz.question: _______ accessory
quiz.explanation: 附件; 配件, 时尚配件. She bought a fashion accessory to match her dress. 她买了一个时尚配件来搭配她的连衣裙。 | ac->朝向，cess->走（拉丁cedere），accessory->走向旁边的=附件/同谋（cf. access进入，necessary必要，exceed超出） || 文化联想：玉佩、丝巾等可作为服装搭配的小物件最适合帮助记忆 accessory，可以说 **a fashion accessory — “A jade pendant can serve as a fashion accessory as well as a culturally meaningful ornament.”**

quiz.question: illusory ____
quiz.explanation: 虚幻的; 错觉的, 虚幻的希望. The promise proved to be illusory hope. 承诺被证明是虚幻的希望。 | illus->欺骗（拉丁illudere->嘲弄），illusory->像幻觉一样的=虚幻的（cf. illusion幻觉，allusion暗示，delusion妄想） || 文化联想：“镜花水月”最适合帮助记忆 illusory，可以说 **an illusory hope — “A plan based entirely on impossible assumptions may create an illusory hope of easy success.”**

quiz.question: mandatory _______
quiz.explanation: 强制的; 法定的, 强制性会议. Attendance at the mandatory meeting is required. 必须出席强制性会议。 | mandat->命令（拉丁mandatum->委托），mandatory->被命令的=强制的（cf. mandate命令，command命令，demand要求，commend赞扬） || 文化联想：中国公司要求全员参加的会议最适合帮助记忆 mandatory，可以说 **a mandatory meeting — “Employees may be required to attend a mandatory meeting about workplace safety.”**

quiz.question: obligatory ____
quiz.explanation: 义务的; 必须的, 义务职责. Military service is an obligatory duty. 服兵役是义务职责。 | oblig->绑定（拉丁obligare），obligatory->被绑定的=必须的（cf. oblige迫使，obligation义务，ligate扎紧，ligament韧带） || 文化联想：中文“该做就必须做的职责”最适合帮助记忆 obligatory，可以说 **an obligatory duty — “Submitting required tax documents can be an obligatory duty rather than a matter of personal preference.”**

quiz.question: derogatory ______
quiz.explanation: 贬损的; 轻蔑的, 贬损的评论. He made a derogatory remark about her work. 他对她的工作做出了贬损的评论。 | de->向下，rogat->询问/提议（拉丁），derogatory->向下提议削减=贬损（cf. abrogate废除，arrogate僭取，interrogate审讯） || 文化联想：中文“带贬低意味的话”最适合帮助记忆 derogatory，可以说 **a derogatory remark — “Mocking someone’s accent with a derogatory remark can be insulting and discriminatory.”**

quiz.question: purgatory ____
quiz.explanation: 炼狱, 炼狱之火. Souls suffer in purgatory fire. 灵魂在炼狱之火中受苦。 | purg->清洗（拉丁purgare），purgatory->清洗罪孽的地方=炼狱（cf. purge清除，pure纯洁，expurgate删除，purify净化） || 文化联想：purgatory 是天主教“炼狱”概念，可用中国学生学习世界宗教时来记忆，可以说 **the fires of purgatory — “In Catholic teaching, purgatory is understood as a state of purification before heaven.”**

quiz.question: nugatory _______
quiz.explanation: 无价值的; 无效的, 无价值的开支. The nugatory expense was a waste of money. 无价值的开支是浪费金钱。 | nugat->无价值（拉丁nugari->说废话），nugatory->毫无价值的（cf. nugget金块，negligible可忽略，null无效） || 文化联想：中文“花了钱却一点作用都没有”最适合帮助记忆 nugatory，可以说 **a nugatory expense — “Paying repeatedly for a report that nobody reads can become a nugatory expense with no practical effect.”**

quiz.question: conciliatory _______
quiz.explanation: 安抚的; 和解的, 和解的姿态. He made a conciliatory gesture to end the dispute. 他做出了和解的姿态来结束争端。 | concili->调解（拉丁conciliare->使和解），conciliatory->旨在和解的（cf. council理事会，counsel建议，reconcile调和） || 文化联想：邻里争执时先主动道歉、递出和解信号最适合帮助记忆 conciliatory，可以说 **a conciliatory gesture — “Offering to meet halfway can be a conciliatory gesture that helps calm a neighborhood dispute.”**

quiz.question: dilatory _______
quiz.explanation: 拖延的; 延误的, 拖延战术. The lawyer used dilatory tactics in court. 律师在法庭上使用拖延战术。 | dilat->拖延（拉丁dilatio->延迟），dilatory->造成延迟的（cf. delay延迟，dilate扩张，late晚，dilatory tactics拖延战术） || 文化联想：中文“拖字诀”最适合帮助记忆 dilatory，可以说 **dilatory tactics — “A committee may use dilatory tactics by repeatedly postponing a decision it does not want to make.”**

quiz.question: ambulatory _______
quiz.explanation: 能走动的; 流动的, 能走动的病人. The ambulatory patient can walk without assistance. 能走动的病人可以独立行走。 | ambul->行走（拉丁ambulare），ambulatory->能够行走的（cf. ambulance救护车，amble漫步，preamble序言=行走之前） || 文化联想：中国医院里可以下床行走、不需卧床监护的病人最适合帮助记忆 ambulatory，可以说 **an ambulatory patient — “An ambulatory patient can walk independently and may not need continuous bed care.”**

quiz.question: ______ signatory
quiz.explanation: 签署者; 签约国, 条约签署者. All treaty signatory nations must comply. 所有条约签署国必须遵守。 | sign->标记/签名（拉丁signum），signatory->在文件上签名的=签署者（cf. sign标志，signal信号，signature签名，design设计） || 文化联想：中国学生学习国际条约时最适合帮助记忆 signatory，可以说 **a treaty signatory — “A treaty signatory is a country or party that has formally signed the agreement.”**

quiz.question: minatory ____
quiz.explanation: 威胁的; 恐吓的, 威胁的语气. He spoke in a minatory tone. 他用威胁的语气说话。 | minat->威胁（拉丁minari），minatory->充满威胁的（cf. menace威胁，ominous不祥，threatening威胁性的，minatory=threatening） || 文化联想：中文“带威胁意味的口气”最适合帮助记忆 minatory，可以说 **a minatory tone — “A debt collector who speaks in a minatory tone may make the listener feel threatened.”**

quiz.question: discriminatory ________
quiz.explanation: 歧视性的, 歧视性做法. The discriminatory practice was ruled illegal. 歧视性做法被裁定为非法。 | discrimin->区分（拉丁discriminare），discriminatory->通过区分进行歧视的（cf. discriminate区分，crime犯罪，crisp清晰） || 文化联想：招聘中因为性别、年龄或其他无关特征区别对待最适合帮助记忆 discriminatory，可以说 **a discriminatory practice — “Rejecting qualified applicants solely because of an irrelevant personal characteristic can be a discriminatory practice.”**

quiz.question: anticipatory ____
quiz.explanation: 预期的; 先发的, 预期保释. The court granted anticipatory bail. 法院批准了预期保释。 | anti->提前，cipat->抓取（拉丁capere），anticipatory->提前抓取=预期的（cf. anticipate预料，participate参与，emancipate解放） || 文化联想：anticipatory bail 是印度等法域使用的法律概念，可用中国法学生学习比较法时来记忆，可以说 **anticipatory bail — “In a comparative-law class, a student may learn that anticipatory bail can protect a person from immediate arrest under certain legal systems.”**

quiz.question: migratory _____
quiz.explanation: 迁徙的; 流动的, 候鸟. Migratory birds fly south for winter. 候鸟为过冬飞往南方。 | migrat->迁徙（拉丁migrare），migratory->迁移的（cf. migrate迁徙，emigrate移民出，immigrate移民入，transmigration轮回） || 文化联想：鄱阳湖每年迎来大量候鸟越冬最适合帮助记忆 migratory，可以说 **migratory birds — “Poyang Lake attracts large numbers of migratory birds that arrive seasonally along major flyways.”**

quiz.question: ________ oratory
quiz.explanation: 演讲术; 雄辩, 有力的演讲. His powerful oratory moved the audience. 他有力的演讲打动了观众。 | orat->说话（拉丁orare），oratory->演讲的技艺（cf. orator演说家，oral口语的，oration演说，orator vs demagogue） || 文化联想：中国学校演讲比赛里慷慨激昂的演说最适合帮助记忆 oratory，可以说 **powerful oratory — “A skilled student speaker may use powerful oratory to hold the audience’s attention throughout a debate.”**

quiz.question: compensatory _______
quiz.explanation: 补偿的; 赔偿的, 赔偿金. The court awarded compensatory damages. 法院裁定赔偿金。 | compens->秤重平衡（拉丁compensare），compensatory->用于平衡损失的（cf. compensation赔偿，pension养老金，spend花费） || 文化联想：中文民事诉讼里“补偿性赔偿”最适合帮助记忆 compensatory，可以说 **compensatory damages — “A court may award compensatory damages to repay a person for proven financial loss or injury.”**

quiz.question: gustatory _________
quiz.explanation: 味觉的, 味觉感受器. Gustatory receptors detect flavors. 味觉感受器检测味道。 | gust->品味（拉丁gustus），gustatory->与品味味觉相关的（cf. gusto热情，disgust厌恶，robust强壮=充满活力如美食） || 文化联想：中国生物课学习舌头上的味觉感受器最适合帮助记忆 gustatory，可以说 **gustatory receptors — “Gustatory receptors help the nervous system detect different taste-related chemicals in food.”**

quiz.question: _____ observatory
quiz.explanation: 天文台; 观测站, 太空观测站. The space observatory monitors distant galaxies. 太空观测站监测遥远的星系。 | observ->观察（拉丁observare），observatory->用于观察的建筑=观测站（cf. observe观察，observation观察，conserve保存） || 文化联想：北京古观象台或现代天文台最适合帮助记忆 observatory，可以说 **an astronomical observatory — “An astronomical observatory uses specialized instruments to study stars, planets, and other objects in the sky.”**

quiz.question: _____ conservatory
quiz.explanation: 温室; 音乐学院, 玻璃温室. The glass conservatory houses tropical plants. 玻璃温室容纳热带植物。 | conserv->保存（拉丁conservare），conservatory->保存植物/音乐的地方（cf. conserve保存，conservation保护，preserve保护） || 文化联想：中国大型植物园里的玻璃温室最适合帮助记忆 conservatory，可以说 **a glass conservatory — “A botanical garden may use a glass conservatory to protect tropical plants through a cold northern winter.”**

quiz.question: olfactory _____
quiz.explanation: 嗅觉的, 嗅神经. The olfactory nerve detects smells. 嗅神经检测气味。 | olfact->嗅（拉丁olfacere->闻嗅），olfactory->与嗅觉相关的（cf. olfaction嗅觉，smell嗅觉，gustatory味觉） || 文化联想：中国医学院解剖课里的嗅神经最适合帮助记忆 olfactory，可以说 **the olfactory nerve — “The olfactory nerve carries smell-related information from the nose toward the brain.”**

quiz.question: refractory _____
quiz.explanation: 难熔的; 倔强的, 难熔金属. Refractory metal withstands high temperatures. 难熔金属耐高温。 | re->对抗，fract->破（拉丁frangere），refractory->对抗破碎/管理=难控制的（cf. refract折射，fracture骨折，infract违反） || 文化联想：中国航天和高温工业常用钨等耐高温金属最适合帮助记忆 refractory，可以说 **a refractory metal — “Tungsten is a refractory metal valued for retaining strength at extremely high temperatures.”**

quiz.question: _______ refectory
quiz.explanation: 食堂; 餐厅, 大学食堂. Students eat in the college refectory. 学生在大学食堂吃饭。 | re->再次，fect->做/修复（拉丁reficere->恢复），refectory->恢复体力的地方=食堂（cf. perfect完美，affect影响，defect缺陷） || 文化联想：寺院里僧众共同用餐的食堂最适合帮助记忆 refectory，可以说 **a monastery refectory — “Monks may gather in a monastery refectory for simple communal meals at fixed times each day.”**

quiz.question: ______ trajectory
quiz.explanation: 轨迹; 弹道, 飞行轨迹. The flight trajectory was carefully calculated. 飞行轨迹被仔细计算。 | traject->投掷穿越（拉丁trajectus，trans+jacere->投），trajectory->投掷物经过的路径（cf. project投影，inject注射，reject拒绝） || 文化联想：神舟飞船升空后沿着精确计算的路径飞行，最适合帮助记忆 trajectory，可以说 **a flight trajectory — “Engineers carefully calculate a spacecraft’s flight trajectory from launch through reentry.”**

quiz.question: contradictory _________
quiz.explanation: 矛盾的; 对立的, 矛盾的陈述. The witness made a contradictory statement. 证人做出了矛盾的陈述。 | contra->对抗，dict->说（拉丁dicere），contradictory->反向说的=矛盾的（cf. predict预言，dictate命令，verdict裁决） || 文化联想：中文“前后自相矛盾”最适合帮助记忆 contradictory，可以说 **a contradictory statement — “A witness who gives two incompatible accounts has made a contradictory statement.”**

quiz.question: valedictory _______
quiz.explanation: 告别的; 告别演说, 告别演说. The senior gave the valedictory address. 高年级学生发表了告别演说。 | vale->再见（拉丁vale->保重），dict->说，valedictory->说再见的=告别演说（cf. valedictorian告别致辞者，farewell告别） || 文化联想：中国大学毕业典礼上的告别致辞最适合帮助记忆 valedictory，可以说 **a valedictory address — “A graduating student may deliver a valedictory address that looks back on school life and says farewell.”**

quiz.question: perfunctory ___
quiz.explanation: 敷衍的; 例行公事的, 敷衍的点头. He gave a perfunctory nod and left. 他敷衍地点了点头就离开了。 | per->彻底，funct->执行（拉丁fungi），perfunctory->只是把程序走完的=敷衍（cf. function功能，defunct停止，malfunction故障） || 文化联想：中文“敷衍地点一下头”最适合帮助记忆 perfunctory，可以说 **a perfunctory nod — “A busy official may give a perfunctory nod without really listening to the question.”**

quiz.question: transitory ___
quiz.explanation: 短暂的; 转瞬即逝的, 短暂的快乐. Fame brings only transitory joy. 名声只带来短暂的快乐。 | transit->经过（拉丁transire），transitory->经过即逝的=短暂的（cf. transition过渡，transit交通，transient短暂的） || 文化联想：“人生如朝露”最适合帮助记忆 transitory，可以说 **transitory joy — “The excitement of winning a minor prize may bring only transitory joy before ordinary life resumes.”**

quiz.question: ____ repository
quiz.explanation: 仓库; 贮藏室, 数据存储库. The data repository stores all records. 数据存储库存储所有记录。 | re->回，posit->放置（拉丁ponere），repository->放东西回去的地方=仓库（cf. deposit存款，compose作曲，expose暴露） || 文化联想：敦煌藏经洞像一座保存知识的宝库，最适合帮助记忆 repository，可以说 **a document repository — “An archive can serve as a document repository that preserves records for future researchers.”**

quiz.question: expository _______
quiz.explanation: 说明的; 解释的, 说明文写作. Students practice expository writing in class. 学生在课堂上练习说明文写作。 | ex->向外，posit->放置，expository->向外放置展开=说明的（cf. expose暴露，exposition博览会，expose暴露） || 文化联想：中国语文课里的说明文最适合帮助记忆 expository，可以说 **expository writing — “Expository writing explains a subject clearly through facts, examples, and logical organization.”**

quiz.question: desultory ____________
quiz.explanation: 散漫的; 不连贯的, 散漫的对话. They engaged in desultory conversation. 他们进行了散漫的对话。 | de->离开，sult->跳（拉丁salire），desultory->从一个跳到另一个=漫无目的（cf. result结果，insult侮辱，exult欢腾，somersault翻筋斗） || 文化联想：中文“东拉西扯、想到哪儿聊到哪儿”最适合帮助记忆 desultory，可以说 **a desultory conversation — “Old friends may drift through a desultory conversation that jumps from family to travel to politics.”**

quiz.question: inventory ____
quiz.explanation: 清单; 存货, 库存清单. Check the inventory list for supplies. 检查物资库存清单。 | invent->找到（拉丁invenire->来到），inventory->找到并记录的=清单（cf. invent发明，invention发明，event事件=出来的事） || 文化联想：中国商店年底盘点库存最适合帮助记忆 inventory，可以说 **an inventory list — “A shopkeeper may check an inventory list while counting every item on the shelves.”**

quiz.question: peremptory _____
quiz.explanation: 专横的; 断然的, 专横的命令. He issued a peremptory order. 他发出了专横的命令。 | per->彻底，empt->取得（拉丁emere->买），peremptory->彻底取消辩解余地的=专横（cf. exempt豁免，preempt抢先，redeem救赎） || 文化联想：古装剧里不容辩驳的严厉命令最适合帮助记忆 peremptory，可以说 **a peremptory order — “A commander may issue a peremptory order that leaves no room for argument.”**

quiz.question: circumlocutory ______
quiz.explanation: 迂回的; 婉转的, 迂回的回答. His circumlocutory answer avoided the question. 他迂回的回答回避了问题。 | circum->绕圈，locut->说（拉丁loqui），circumlocutory->绕圈说话的=迂回的（cf. eloquent雄辩，colloquial口语，soliloquy独白） || 文化联想：中文“绕来绕去就是不正面回答”最适合帮助记忆 circumlocutory，可以说 **a circumlocutory answer — “A spokesperson may give a circumlocutory answer that uses many words while avoiding the central question.”**

quiz.question: statutory ____
quiz.explanation: 法定的; 依法的, 法定职责. It is their statutory duty to report crimes. 报告犯罪是他们的法定职责。 | statut->规定（拉丁statuere），statutory->由法规规定的（cf. statute法规，status地位，institute机构，constitute构成） || 文化联想：中文“白纸黑字写进法律的职责”最适合帮助记忆 statutory，可以说 **a statutory duty — “A public agency may have a statutory duty to publish certain records under the law.”**

quiz.question: harry ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 骚扰; 掠夺, 骚扰敌人. The troops will harry the enemy constantly. 军队将不断骚扰敌人。 | harry->劫掠（古英语hergian->劫掠），harry->骚扰掠夺（cf. harass骚扰，raid突袭，maraud掠夺） || 文化联想：古代轻骑兵不断骚扰敌军的战术最适合帮助记忆 harry，可以说 **harry the enemy — “Mobile troops may harry the enemy with repeated small attacks that prevent rest and regrouping.”**

quiz.question: parry _ ____
quiz.explanation: 挡开; 回避, 挡开一击. The boxer managed to parry a blow. 拳击手设法挡开了一击。 | parry->格挡（法语parer->防护，拉丁parare->准备），parry->格挡攻击（cf. prepare准备，parade阅兵，repair修复） || 文化联想：太极推手顺势化开对方来力最适合帮助记忆 parry，可以说 **parry a blow — “A skilled fighter can parry a blow by redirecting the attack instead of absorbing it directly.”**

quiz.question: _____ quarry
quiz.explanation: 采石场; 猎物, 采石场. Workers extract marble from the stone quarry. 工人从采石场开采大理石。 | quarry->方形石块（拉丁quadraria），quarry->开采方石的地方/猎物（cf. square方形，quarter四分之一，quarrel争吵=争方石？） || 文化联想：北京皇家建筑使用汉白玉所需的采石场最适合帮助记忆 quarry，可以说 **a stone quarry — “Workers at a stone quarry may cut large blocks of marble for construction and sculpture.”**

quiz.question: _____ ferry
quiz.explanation: 渡船, 河渡船. The river ferry crosses every hour. 河渡船每小时过河一次。 | ferry->载运（古英语ferian->运载），ferry->摆渡（cf. ferry渡船，transfer转移，prefer偏好，differ不同） || 文化联想：长江沿岸过去常见的过江渡船最适合帮助记忆 ferry，可以说 **a river ferry — “A river ferry may carry passengers and bicycles between two towns on opposite banks.”**

quiz.question: paltry ___
quiz.explanation: 微不足道的; 可怜的, 微不足道的金额. quiz.question: _____ infantry
quiz.explanation: 步兵, 轻步兵. quiz.question: entry ___
quiz.explanation: 入口; 进入, 入场费. Pay the entry fee at the gate. 在门口支付入场费。 | enter->进入（拉丁intrare），entry->进入的行为=入口（cf. enter进入，entrance入口，entrant参赛者，entrepreneur创业者） || 文化联想：中国景区门口买票最适合帮助记忆 entry，可以说 **an entry fee — “Visitors may pay an entry fee before entering a historic garden.”**

quiz.question: ___ gentry
quiz.explanation: 绅士阶层, 绅士阶层. quiz.question: carpentry ______
quiz.explanation: 木工; 木工活, 木工技能.
