quiz.question: _________ zealotry
quiz.explanation: 狂热; 盲信, 宗教狂热. Religious zealotry can be dangerous. 宗教狂热可能很危险。 | zeal->热忱（希腊zelos），zealotry->过度热忱=狂热盲信（cf. zealous热心的，jealous嫉妒=过度在意，zeal热情） || 文化联想：zealotry 指过度狂热，可用中国学生学习世界宗教与政治运动时来记忆，可以说 **religious zealotry — “Religious zealotry can become dangerous when absolute certainty turns into hostility toward outsiders.”**

quiz.question: _____ pastry
quiz.explanation: 糕点; 面点, 水果糕点. She baked a delicious fruit pastry. 她烤了美味的水果糕点。 | paste->面团（拉丁pasta），pastry->用面团制作的点心（cf. pasta意面，paste糊，pastel粉彩=面糊颜色，pastor牧师） || 文化联想：苏式酥点层层起酥最适合帮助记忆 pastry，可以说 **a fruit pastry — “A baker may fold butter into dough repeatedly to create the flaky layers of a fruit pastry.”**

quiz.question: _____ ancestry
quiz.explanation: 祖先; 血统, 追溯祖先. DNA tests can trace ancestry. DNA测试可以追溯祖先。 | ances->之前（拉丁ante），try->来的人，ancestry->来自之前的人=祖先（cf. ancestor祖先，antecedent先例，antique古物） || 文化联想：中国族谱一代代追溯先人最适合帮助记忆 ancestry，可以说 **trace ancestry — “A family may use old clan records to trace ancestry across many generations.”**

quiz.question: ____ tapestry
quiz.explanation: 挂毯; 织锦, 丰富的织锦. The wall displayed a rich tapestry. 墙上展示着丰富的织锦。 | tapis->地毯（法语，来自希腊tapets），tapestry->带有图案的厚重织锦（cf. tapis地毯，carpet地毯=来自同根） || 文化联想：苏州缂丝图案繁复如画最适合帮助记忆 tapestry，可以说 **a rich tapestry — “A museum may display a rich tapestry woven with intricate figures, landscapes, and decorative patterns.”**

quiz.question: ______ forestry
quiz.explanation: 林业, 森林林业. Forest forestry manages woodland resources. 森林林业管理林地资源。 | forest->森林（拉丁forestis->户外树林），forestry->森林管理的学问（cf. forest森林，deforest砍伐，afforest造林） || 文化联想：大兴安岭的森林经营和保护最适合帮助记忆 forestry，可以说 **sustainable forestry — “Sustainable forestry aims to manage woodland resources without exhausting them for future generations.”**

quiz.question: ____ sophistry
quiz.explanation: 诡辩; 诡辩术, 纯粹的诡辩. His argument was mere sophistry. 他的论点纯粹是诡辩。 | Sophist->诡辩家（希腊sophos->聪明），sophistry->聪明的外表下的诡辩（cf. sophisticated复杂/世故，philosophy哲学=爱智慧） || 文化联想：中文“强词夺理、听着聪明其实偷换概念”最适合帮助记忆 sophistry，可以说 **mere sophistry — “An argument that hides a weak point behind clever wording may be mere sophistry.”**

quiz.question: ________ artistry
quiz.explanation: 艺术技巧; 艺术性, 艺术技巧. The painting shows remarkable artistic artistry. 这幅画展示了非凡的艺术技巧。 | art->技艺（拉丁ars），artistry->艺术技巧（cf. art艺术，artist艺术家，artisan工匠，artifact人工制品） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠把一根丝线劈成极细丝后绣出层次最适合帮助记忆 artistry，可以说 **remarkable artistry — “The delicate shading in Suzhou embroidery can reveal remarkable artistry and technical control.”**

quiz.question: fury __ _____
quiz.explanation: 狂怒; 狂暴, 风暴的狂怒. The fury of storm destroyed homes. 风暴的狂怒摧毁了房屋。 | furi->狂怒（拉丁furia），fury->极度愤怒（cf. furious狂怒的，infuriate激怒，Furies复仇三女神，furor公众激愤） || 文化联想：中国沿海台风登陆时的猛烈风雨最适合帮助记忆 fury，可以说 **the fury of a storm — “Coastal towns may experience the full fury of a storm when violent wind and rain arrive together.”**

quiz.question: ____ augury
quiz.explanation: 预兆; 占卜, 好兆头. The clear skies were a good augury. 晴朗的天空是好兆头。 | augur->预兆/占卜师（拉丁augur->从鸟兆占卜），augury->鸟兆预测（cf. augur预示，inaugurate就职=举行鸟兆仪式，august威严） || 文化联想：古代占卜看见吉兆最适合帮助记忆 augury，可以说 **a good augury — “Clear skies before a major ceremony may be interpreted as a good augury in a traditional story.”**

quiz.question: ______ perjury
quiz.explanation: 伪证罪, 犯伪证罪. Its illegal to commit perjury in court. 在法庭上犯伪证罪是非法的。 | per->违背，jur->誓言（拉丁jurare），perjury->违背誓言=伪证罪（cf. jury陪审团，injure伤害，abjure放弃=远离誓言） || 文化联想：中文“宣誓之后仍故意作假证”最适合帮助记忆 perjury，可以说 **commit perjury — “A witness who knowingly lies under oath may commit perjury.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ penury
quiz.explanation: 贫困; 赤贫, 生活在贫困中. Many families live in penury. 许多家庭生活在贫困中。 | pen->几乎没有（拉丁paene->几乎），penury->几乎没有钱=赤贫（cf. peninsula半岛=几乎是岛，penultimate倒数第二，penumbra半影） || 文化联想：“家徒四壁”最适合帮助记忆 penury，可以说 **live in penury — “A family with almost no income or savings may live in penury for years.”**

quiz.question: ______ usury
quiz.explanation: 高利贷, 收取高利贷. Its illegal to charge usury rates. 收取高利贷利率是非法的。 | usura->使用/利息（拉丁uti->使用），usury->收取过高利息的行为（cf. use使用，usual通常，usurp篡夺=非法使用，usufruct使用权） || 文化联想：中文“利滚利的高利贷”最适合帮助记忆 usury，可以说 **charge usury — “A predatory lender may charge usury by demanding extremely high interest from desperate borrowers.”**

quiz.question: _______ dowry
quiz.explanation: 嫁妆, 婚礼嫁妆. The bride brought a wedding dowry. 新娘带来了婚礼嫁妆。 | dot->礼物（拉丁dotis->嫁妆），dowry->给予的礼物=嫁妆（cf. endow捐赠，dot捐赠，dote溺爱，anecdote轶事=私下给的） || 文化联想：中国传统婚俗里的嫁妆最适合帮助记忆 dowry，可以说 **a wedding dowry — “In some traditional families, a bride’s parents prepared a wedding dowry of household goods, jewelry, or money.”**

quiz.question: ______ ____ fantasy
quiz.explanation: 幻想; 空想, 逃入幻想. She would escape into fantasy through books. 她会通过书籍逃入幻想。 | phant->显示（希腊phainein），fantasy->心中显示的幻象（cf. phantom幽灵，fantastic奇幻，phenomenon现象，fancy奇思） || 文化联想：《西游记》天马行空的神魔世界最适合帮助记忆 fantasy，可以说 **escape into fantasy — “A reader may escape into fantasy through stories filled with magical journeys, monsters, and immortals.”**

quiz.question: _________ apostasy
quiz.explanation: 背教; 变节, 宗教背教. Religious apostasy was severely punished. 宗教背教受到严厉惩罚。 | apo->离开，stasy->站立（希腊），apostasy->离开原先站立的信仰（cf. ecstasy狂喜=站到外面，apostle使徒，apostate变节者） || 文化联想：apostasy 是“背弃原有宗教信仰”，可用中国学生学习世界宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **religious apostasy — “In religious history, abandoning a faith one once professed may be described as religious apostasy.”**

quiz.question: _________ heresy
quiz.explanation: 异端; 异教, 宗教异端. He was accused of religious heresy. 他被指控犯有宗教异端。 | heresy->选择（希腊hairesis->选择），heresy->自己选择信仰而非遵从=异端（cf. heretic异端者，heir继承人，hereditary遗传） || 文化联想：heresy 是宗教里的“异端”，可用中国学生学习欧洲宗教史时来记忆，可以说 **religious heresy — “A church may label a teaching religious heresy when it directly contradicts doctrines regarded as orthodox.”**

quiz.question: ________ whimsy
quiz.explanation: 奇想; 怪念头, 孩子气的奇想. The story is full of childish whimsy. 故事充满了孩子气的奇想。 | whim->突发奇想（古挪威hvima->眼神游移），whimsy->充满奇异想法的（cf. whim奇想，whimsical奇特的，caprice任性） || 文化联想：孩子把纸箱当宇宙飞船的奇思妙想最适合帮助记忆 whimsy，可以说 **childish whimsy — “Turning a cardboard box into a spaceship is exactly the kind of childish whimsy that fuels imaginative play.”**

quiz.question: rosy _______
quiz.explanation: 玫瑰色的; 乐观的, 乐观的前景. She maintains a rosy outlook on life. 她对生活保持乐观的前景。 | rose->玫瑰（拉丁rosa），rosy->玫瑰色的=乐观的（cf. rose玫瑰，rosary玫瑰念珠，rosacea玫瑰痤疮，rosé玫瑰红酒） || 文化联想：中文“把未来想得一片玫瑰色”最适合帮助记忆 rosy，可以说 **a rosy outlook — “An entrepreneur may maintain a rosy outlook even when the market remains uncertain.”**

quiz.question: brassy ____
quiz.explanation: 黄铜色的; 厚颜的, 刺耳的音调. The trumpet had a brassy tone. 小号有刺耳的音调。 | brass->黄铜（古英语bræs），brassy->像黄铜一样刺耳/厚颜的（cf. brass黄铜，brazen厚颜无耻=黄铜般，bold大胆） || 文化联想：唢呐或铜管乐器高亢刺耳的音色最适合帮助记忆 brassy，可以说 **a brassy tone — “A trumpet played very loudly can produce a brassy tone that cuts through the rest of the band.”**

quiz.question: prissy _______
quiz.explanation: 一本正经的; 拘谨的, 拘谨的举止. Her prissy manners annoyed everyone. 她拘谨的举止惹恼了所有人。 | prissy->过分拘谨（可能来自prim+sissy合并），prissy->过于讲究规矩的（cf. prim一本正经，sissy胆小，fastidious过分讲究） || 文化联想：中文“规矩多得过头、拘谨得让人不自在”最适合帮助记忆 prissy，可以说 **prissy manners — “Someone with prissy manners may fuss over tiny breaches of etiquette at an informal dinner.”**

quiz.question: glossy ________
quiz.explanation: 有光泽的; 精美的, 精美杂志. She read a glossy magazine. 她读了一本精美杂志。 | gloss->光泽（古挪威glossi->发光），glossy->有光泽的=精美的（cf. gloss光泽/注释，polyglot多语言，glossary词汇表） || 文化联想：美容院或候机室里纸张光滑精美的时尚杂志最适合帮助记忆 glossy，可以说 **a glossy magazine — “A glossy magazine often uses polished photographs, smooth paper, and stylish layouts.”**

quiz.question: _____ treaty
quiz.explanation: 条约, 和平条约. Nations signed a peace treaty. 各国签署了和平条约。 | treat->处理（拉丁tractare->拉），treaty->拉拢处理后的协议（cf. treat治疗，retreat撤退，entreat恳求，treatise论文） || 文化联想：中文“签订和平条约”最适合帮助记忆 treaty，可以说 **a peace treaty — “Two countries may sign a peace treaty to formally end a war.”**

quiz.question: _______ entreaty
quiz.explanation: 恳求; 哀求, 恳切的恳求. She made an earnest entreaty for help. 她恳切地恳求帮助。 | en->使，treat->拉/处置，entreaty->拉着手哀求的行为（cf. entreat恳求，treat处理，retreat撤退，treaty条约） || 文化联想：古装剧里跪地恳切求情最适合帮助记忆 entreaty，可以说 **an earnest entreaty — “A desperate petitioner may make an earnest entreaty for mercy before the ruler.”**

quiz.question: crotchety ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 脾气暴躁的; 古怪的, 脾气暴躁的老人. The crotchety old man complained constantly. 脾气暴躁的老人不断抱怨。 | crochet->钩针（法语，小钩），crotchety->像钩子一样挂着怪脾气的=古怪易怒（cf. crotchet四分音符/怪念头，quirky古怪） || 文化联想：中文“脾气古怪、见谁都爱抱怨的老头”最适合帮助记忆 crotchety，可以说 **a crotchety old man — “A crotchety old man may complain about noise, traffic, weather, and nearly everything else.”**

quiz.question: _______ gaiety
quiz.explanation: 欢乐; 快活, 节日欢乐. The holiday gaiety filled the streets. 节日欢乐充满街道。 | gay->快乐（古法语gai->轻松），gaiety->欢乐快活的状态（cf. gay快乐/同性恋，glee欢乐，merriment欢乐） || 文化联想：春节庙会锣鼓喧天、人人喜气洋洋最适合帮助记忆 gaiety，可以说 **holiday gaiety — “Lanterns, music, food stalls, and laughing crowds can fill the streets with holiday gaiety.”**

quiz.question: ________ sobriety
quiz.explanation: 清醒; 节制, 保持清醒. Drivers must maintain sobriety. 司机必须保持清醒。 | sobri->清醒（拉丁sobrius），sobriety->清醒节制的状态（cf. sober清醒，insobriety醉酒，soberingly发人深省地） || 文化联想：酒桌上始终保持清醒克制最适合帮助记忆 sobriety，可以说 **maintain sobriety — “A designated driver must maintain sobriety throughout the evening.”**

quiz.question: _______ propriety
quiz.explanation: 得体; 礼节, 遵守礼节. Always observe propriety in formal settings. 在正式场合总要遵守礼节。 | propri->适当（拉丁proprius->自己的），propriety->符合礼节的行为（cf. proper适当，property财产，appropriate挪用，impropriety失礼） || 文化联想：中文“守礼有分寸、举止得体”最适合帮助记忆 propriety，可以说 **observe propriety — “At a formal memorial ceremony, guests are expected to observe propriety in dress and behavior.”**

quiz.question: persnickety _______
quiz.explanation: 过分讲究的; 挑剔的, 挑剔的细节. She worried about persnickety details. 她担心挑剔的细节。 | persnickety->过分精细（来自pernickety/pernicious精细），persnickety->对细节吹毛求疵的（cf. fastidious讲究，finicky挑剔） || 文化联想：老会计对账连一分钱都要核对最适合帮助记忆 persnickety，可以说 **persnickety details — “A meticulous accountant may spend hours checking persnickety details that everyone else overlooks.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ entirety
quiz.explanation: 全部; 整体, 全部. Read the contract in its entirety. 完整地阅读合同。 | entire->整体（拉丁integer->完整的），entirety->完整的全体（cf. integer整数，integrate整合，disintegrate分解，entire整个） || 文化联想：中文“从头到尾完整看完”最适合帮助记忆 entirety，可以说 **in its entirety — “A buyer should read a contract in its entirety before signing it.”**

quiz.question: crafty ____
quiz.explanation: 狡猾的; 诡计多端的, 狡猾的计划. They devised a crafty plan. 他们设计了一个狡猾的计划。 | craft->技艺/狡猾（古英语cræft->力量/技能），crafty->用技艺算计的=狡猾（cf. craft工艺/诡计，craftsman工匠，witchcraft巫术） || 文化联想：《三国演义》里层层设局的巧计最适合帮助记忆 crafty，可以说 **a crafty plan — “A crafty plan may succeed because it anticipates what the other side expects and exploits that assumption.”**

quiz.question: thrifty _______
quiz.explanation: 节俭的; 节约的, 节俭的购物者. The thrifty shopper looks for bargains. 节俭的购物者寻找便宜货。 | thrift->节约（古挪威þrift->繁荣/积蓄），thrifty->注重积蓄的=节俭（cf. thrive繁荣，spendthrift挥霍者，thrift store旧货店） || 文化联想：老一辈“精打细算、能省则省”的持家方式最适合帮助记忆 thrifty，可以说 **a thrifty shopper — “A thrifty shopper compares prices, waits for discounts, and avoids buying things that are not needed.”**

quiz.question: lofty _____
quiz.explanation: 崇高的; 高尚的, 崇高的理想. He pursued a lofty ideal. 他追求崇高的理想。 | loft->高处（古挪威lopt->空气），lofty->高高在上的=崇高/傲慢（cf. aloft在高处，loft阁楼，loftiness崇高，haughty傲慢） || 文化联想：“为天地立心，为生民立命”这种高远抱负最适合帮助记忆 lofty，可以说 **a lofty ideal — “A young scholar may pursue a lofty ideal of using knowledge to improve society.”**

quiz.question: mighty ______
quiz.explanation: 强大的; 巨大的, 强大的帝国. Rome was a mighty empire. 罗马是一个强大的帝国。 | might->力量（古英语miht），mighty->充满力量的=强大的（cf. might力量，almighty全能，might-have-been本可是，mightily强大地） || 文化联想：汉唐盛世国力强盛的历史形象最适合帮助记忆 mighty，可以说 **a mighty empire — “At its height, a mighty empire may command vast territory, wealth, armies, and political influence.”**

quiz.question: haughty ______
quiz.explanation: 傲慢的; 高傲的, 傲慢的一瞥. She gave him a haughty glance. 她傲慢地瞥了他一眼。 | haut->高（法语，拉丁altus），haughty->高高在上的=傲慢（cf. haute haute cuisine高级法餐，altitude高度，exalt提升） || 文化联想：古装剧里权贵高高在上的眼神最适合帮助记忆 haughty，可以说 **a haughty glance — “A proud noble may give a haughty glance that makes everyone nearby feel looked down upon.”**

quiz.question: ___ laity
quiz.explanation: 俗人; 外行, 俗人. The laity attended the church service. 俗人参加了教堂礼拜。 | laos->人民（希腊），laity->普通人民=俗人/外行（cf. lay平放/世俗的，layman外行，laypeople普通人） || 文化联想：laity 指宗教中的普通信众而非神职人员，可用中国学生学习宗教制度时来记忆，可以说 **the laity — “In many religious traditions, the laity are ordinary believers who are not members of the clergy.”**

quiz.question: ________ probity
quiz.explanation: 正直; 诚实, 个人正直. His personal probity was never questioned. 他的个人正直从未受到质疑。 | prob->证明正直（拉丁probus->好的），probity->经过证明的正直（cf. probe探测，approve批准，reprove责备，disprove反驳） || 文化联想：包公“铁面无私”的形象最适合帮助记忆 probity，可以说 **personal probity — “A judge known for personal probity refuses gifts, favors, and pressure from powerful people.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ acerbity
quiz.explanation: 尖刻; 辛辣, 尖刻的语气. Her voice had a note of acerbity. 她的声音带有尖刻的语气。 | acer->尖锐（拉丁acer->锋利），acerbity->尖锐辛辣的性质（cf. acid酸，acrid辛辣，acrimony尖刻，exacerbate加剧=使更尖锐） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文里辛辣尖锐的语气最适合帮助记忆 acerbity，可以说 **a note of acerbity — “A satirical essay may contain a note of acerbity when exposing hypocrisy.”**

quiz.question: _____ mendacity
quiz.explanation: 虚假; 谎言, 明显的虚假. His testimony was plain mendacity. 他的证词是明显的虚假。 | mendac->谎言（拉丁mendax->说谎者），mendacity->说谎的行为（cf. mendacious撒谎的，emend修订=改正错误，cf. amend修改） || 文化联想：中文“睁眼说瞎话”最适合帮助记忆 mendacity，可以说 **plain mendacity — “Claiming that obvious evidence does not exist can amount to plain mendacity.”**

quiz.question: __________ tenacity
quiz.explanation: 坚韧; 顽强, 非凡的坚韧. She showed remarkable tenacity. 她表现出非凡的坚韧。 | tenac->持有（拉丁tenax->抓紧），tenacity->紧握不放的特质=坚韧（cf. tenacious顽强，tenant租户，retain保留，tenure任期） || 文化联想：愚公移山最适合帮助记忆 tenacity，可以说 **remarkable tenacity — “The Foolish Old Man shows remarkable tenacity by continuing an enormous task despite repeated obstacles.”**

quiz.question: ______ opacity
quiz.explanation: 不透明性, 屏幕不透明度. Adjust the screen opacity settings. 调整屏幕不透明度设置。 | opac->不透明（拉丁opacus->阴暗），opacity->不透明的性质（cf. opaque不透明，translucent半透明，transparent透明） || 文化联想：中国手机修图时调节图层透明度最适合帮助记忆 opacity，可以说 **screen opacity — “A designer may reduce screen opacity so the background remains partly visible through an overlay.”**

quiz.question: veracity __ ____
quiz.explanation: 真实性; 诚实, 数据的真实性. Question the veracity of data sources. 质疑数据来源的真实性。 | ver->真（拉丁verus），veracity->真实性（cf. verify核实，verdict裁决，veracious真实，aver断言，verisimilar逼真） || 文化联想：中文“数据到底靠不靠谱”最适合帮助记忆 veracity，可以说 **the veracity of data — “A researcher should verify the veracity of data before drawing conclusions from it.”**

quiz.question: _______ voracity
quiz.explanation: 贪食; 贪婪, 贪婪的贪食. He ate with wolfish voracity. 他贪婪地吃东西。 | vor->吞食（拉丁vorare），voracity->贪婪吞食的特性（cf. voracious贪婪，devour吞食，carnivore食肉动物，herbivore食草动物） || 文化联想：中文“狼吞虎咽”最适合帮助记忆 voracity，可以说 **wolfish voracity — “After a day of hard hiking, someone may attack dinner with wolfish voracity.”**

quiz.question: ______ infelicity
quiz.explanation: 不幸; 不当, 社交不当. His social infelicity caused embarrassment. 他的社交不当造成了尴尬。 | in->否定，felic->幸福（拉丁felix），infelicity->不幸/不当（cf. felicity幸福，felicitate祝贺，Felix幸运的人名） || 文化联想：中文“社交场合说错话、措辞不得体”最适合帮助记忆 infelicity，可以说 **a social infelicity — “Making a joke about someone’s private hardship at dinner would be a social infelicity.”**

quiz.question: _ multiplicity __
quiz.explanation: 多样性; 多重性, 多样性. There is a multiplicity of options. 有多种选择。 | multiplic->倍增（拉丁multiplicare），multiplicity->多重性/多样性（cf. multiply增加，multiple多重，complex复杂） || 文化联想：中国方言、菜系和地方习俗丰富多样，最适合帮助记忆 multiplicity，可以说 **a multiplicity of traditions — “China contains a multiplicity of regional traditions shaped by geography, history, and local communities.”**

quiz.question: ________ complicity
quiz.explanation: 共谋; 串通, 犯罪共谋. He was charged with criminal complicity. 他被指控犯罪共谋。 | com->共同，plic->折叠（拉丁），complicity->共同折叠参与=共谋（cf. complex复杂，complicate使复杂，implicit隐含，explicit明确） || 文化联想：中文“明知违法还一起参与”最适合帮助记忆 complicity，可以说 **criminal complicity — “Someone who knowingly helps conceal an illegal scheme may face accusations of criminal complicity.”**

quiz.question: _________ duplicity
quiz.explanation: 欺骗; 两面派, 政治欺骗. The scandal revealed political duplicity. 丑闻揭露了政治欺骗。 | duplic->双重（拉丁duplex），duplicity->双重性=两面派（cf. duplicate复制，duplex双层，double双重，diploma文凭=双折的） || 文化联想：中文“两面三刀、嘴上一套背后一套”最适合帮助记忆 duplicity，可以说 **political duplicity — “Promising one policy in public while secretly pursuing the opposite can look like political duplicity.”**

quiz.question: ______ authenticity
quiz.explanation: 真实性; 可靠性, 验证真实性. Experts verify authenticity of artwork. 专家验证艺术品的真实性。 | authent->权威/真实（希腊authentikos），authenticity->真实性（cf. authentic真实的，author作者，authority权威） || 文化联想：中国古玩鉴定最适合帮助记忆 authenticity，可以说 **verify authenticity — “Experts may examine materials, inscriptions, and provenance to verify authenticity before buying an antique.”**

quiz.question: _____ inelasticity
quiz.explanation: 无弹性, 价格无弹性. Price inelasticity means demand stays constant. 价格无弹性意味着需求保持不变。 | in->否定，elastic->弹性（希腊），inelasticity->缺乏弹性（cf. elastic弹性，elasticity弹性，plastic塑料/可塑） || 文化联想：中国经济课里食盐等生活必需品最适合帮助记忆 inelasticity，可以说 **price inelasticity — “The price inelasticity of a basic necessity means demand may change only slightly when its price rises.”**

quiz.question: ________ velocity
quiz.explanation: 速度, 终端速度. Objects reach terminal velocity in freefall. 物体在自由落体时达到终端速度。 | veloc->快速（拉丁velox），velocity->快速运动的量=速度（cf. velodromes自行车赛场，accelerate加速，rapid快速） || 文化联想：中国物理课学习跳伞者达到终端速度最适合帮助记忆 velocity，可以说 **terminal velocity — “A falling object approaches terminal velocity when air resistance balances the force pulling it downward.”**

quiz.question: ___ atrocity
quiz.explanation: 暴行; 残暴, 战争暴行. War atrocity shocked the world. 战争暴行震惊了世界。 | atroc->可怕（拉丁atrox->凶残），atrocity->残酷的暴行（cf. atrocious残暴的，atrocity crimes反人类罪） || 文化联想：抗战史中针对平民的严重暴行最适合帮助记忆 atrocity，可以说 **a war atrocity — “A deliberate massacre of civilians during armed conflict can be condemned as a war atrocity.”**

quiz.question: _____ scarcity
quiz.explanation: 稀缺; 不足, 水资源稀缺. Water scarcity affects millions. 水资源稀缺影响数百万人。 | scarce->稀少（古法语escars->吝啬/稀少），scarcity->稀少的状态（cf. scarce稀缺，rare罕见，shortage短缺） || 文化联想：中国北方一些地区长期缺水最适合帮助记忆 scarcity，可以说 **water scarcity — “Water scarcity can force a dry region to conserve reservoirs and limit waste.”**

quiz.question: _ paucity __ ____
quiz.explanation: 缺乏; 少量, 缺乏数据. There is a paucity of data on this topic. 关于这个话题缺乏数据。 | pauci->少（拉丁paucus->少），paucity->极少量（cf. few少，poverty贫困，impoverish使贫困，pauper穷人） || 文化联想：中文“数据少得根本下不了结论”最适合帮助记忆 paucity，可以说 **a paucity of data — “A paucity of data can make a scientific conclusion highly uncertain.”**

quiz.question: _________ frigidity
quiz.explanation: 寒冷; 冷淡, 情感冷淡. His emotional frigidity hurt relationships. 他的情感冷淡伤害了关系。 | frigid->寒冷（拉丁frigidus），frigidity->寒冷冷淡的状态（cf. frigid寒冷，refrigerator冰箱，Frigidaire冰箱品牌） || 文化联想：中文“冷若冰霜、情感上拒人千里”最适合帮助记忆 frigidity，可以说 **emotional frigidity — “A character who never shows warmth or affection may be described as displaying emotional frigidity.”**

quiz.question: timidity _______
quiz.explanation: 胆怯; 羞怯, 胆怯问题. Shyness is a timidity problem. 害羞是一个胆怯问题。 | timid->胆小（拉丁timidus），timidity->胆小怯懦的状态（cf. timid胆小，intimidate恐吓=使胆小，intrepid无畏） || 文化联想：中国学生第一次上台演讲时的怯场最适合帮助记忆 timidity，可以说 **a problem of timidity — “A capable student may struggle with a problem of timidity when speaking before a large audience.”**

quiz.question: ____ fecundity
quiz.explanation: 多产; 肥沃, 土壤肥沃. Soil fecundity determines crop yields. 土壤肥沃决定作物产量。 | fecund->多产（拉丁fecundus），fecundity->多产肥沃的特性（cf. fecund多产，infecund不育，fertile肥沃，fertility生育力） || 文化联想：东北黑土地肥沃、庄稼长势旺盛最适合帮助记忆 fecundity，可以说 **the fecundity of soil — “The fecundity of rich black soil can support abundant crops when water and climate are favorable.”**

quiz.question: ______ commodity
quiz.explanation: 商品, 全球商品. Oil is a valuable global commodity. 石油是有价值的全球商品。 | commod->方便/适宜（拉丁commodus），commodity->方便交换的物品=商品（cf. accommodate适应，commode梳妆台，commodious宽敞） || 文化联想：中国大量进口的大豆、铁矿石和原油都是典型全球商品，最适合帮助记忆 commodity，可以说 **a global commodity — “Crude oil is a global commodity whose price is shaped by supply, demand, and geopolitics.”**

quiz.question: ______ crudity
quiz.explanation: 粗鲁; 粗糙, 社交粗鲁. His social crudity offended guests. 他的社交粗鲁冒犯了客人。 | crud->粗糙（拉丁crudus->生/粗糙），crudity->粗糙未加工的状态（cf. crude原油/粗糙，cruel残忍，rude粗鲁） || 文化联想：中文“举止粗俗、缺少教养”最适合帮助记忆 crudity，可以说 **social crudity — “Shouting insults at a formal dinner may be remembered for its social crudity.”**

quiz.question: _______ spontaneity
quiz.explanation: 自发性; 自然, 真诚的自发性. Her genuine spontaneity was refreshing. 她真诚的自发性令人耳目一新。 | spont->自愿（拉丁sponte->出于意愿），spontaneity->无外力的自发（cf. spontaneous自发的，respond回应，despondent沮丧） || 文化联想：中国朋友聚会时临场自然说笑最适合帮助记忆 spontaneity，可以说 **genuine spontaneity — “An unscripted conversation among close friends often has a genuine spontaneity that staged dialogue lacks.”**

quiz.question: ________ homogeneity
quiz.explanation: 同质性; 均匀性, 文化同质性. Cultural homogeneity characterizes the region. 文化同质性是该地区的特点。 | homo->相同（希腊），genei->种类，homogeneity->相同种类的性质（cf. heterogeneous异质，gender性别，genesis起源） || 文化联想：中文“千城一面、大家越来越像”最适合帮助记忆 homogeneity，可以说 **cultural homogeneity — “When local customs, architecture, and language differences fade, a region may develop greater cultural homogeneity.”**

quiz.question: _____ superficiality
quiz.explanation: 肤浅; 浅薄, 纯粹的肤浅. The analysis showed sheer superficiality. 分析显示了纯粹的肤浅。 | super->表面（拉丁superficies->表面），superficiality->只停在表面的浅薄（cf. surface表面，superficial表面的，edifice建筑） || 文化联想：中文“走马观花、只看表面”最适合帮助记忆 superficiality，可以说 **sheer superficiality — “Judging a complex issue from one headline shows sheer superficiality.”**

quiz.question: ________ partiality
quiz.explanation: 偏心; 偏袒, 司法偏袒. Judicial partiality undermines justice. 司法偏袒破坏了公正。 | part->部分（拉丁pars），partiality->只偏向一部分=偏袒（cf. partial部分的/偏袒，impartial公正，partition分割） || 文化联想：中文“司法偏袒自己人”最适合帮助记忆 partiality，可以说 **judicial partiality — “Judicial partiality undermines trust when a judge favors one side for personal reasons.”**

quiz.question: ____ conviviality
quiz.explanation: 欢乐; 欢宴, 温暖的欢乐. Warm conviviality filled the celebration. 温暖的欢乐充满了庆祝活动。 | con->共同，vivi->活（拉丁vivere->生活），conviviality->共同生活/宴饮的欢乐（cf. vivid生动，vivacious活泼，survive存活） || 文化联想：中国人围着火锅边吃边聊的热闹气氛最适合帮助记忆 conviviality，可以说 **warm conviviality — “A long hotpot dinner with family and friends can create warm conviviality around the table.”**

quiz.question: ____ formality
quiz.explanation: 正式; 仪式, 纯粹的形式. The interview was a mere formality. 面试纯粹是形式。 | form->形式（拉丁forma），formality->严格遵循形式的行为（cf. formal正式，reform改革，conform顺从，uniform制服） || 文化联想：中文“纯粹走个过场”最适合帮助记忆 formality，可以说 **a mere formality — “If the decision has already been made, the final interview may be a mere formality.”**

quiz.question: originality ______
quiz.explanation: 创意; 独创性, 独创性闪耀. His originality shines through the work. 他的独创性在作品中闪耀。 | origin->起源（拉丁origo），originality->来自源头的独创（cf. origin起源，original原创，originate起源，orient东方） || 文化联想：齐白石画虾自成一格的创造力最适合帮助记忆 originality，可以说 **originality shines — “An artist’s originality shines when the work has a recognizable style that is not merely copied from others.”**

quiz.question: municipality ____
quiz.explanation: 市政当局, 市政当局规则. The municipality rule governs local affairs. 市政当局规则管理地方事务。 | munici->市民（拉丁municeps->承担义务的公民），municipality->市民自治体（cf. municipal市政，munificent慷慨=给市民礼物） || 文化联想：中国城市政府管理本地交通、规划和公共服务的概念最适合帮助记忆 municipality，可以说 **a local municipality — “A local municipality may manage roads, zoning, sanitation, parks, and other local services.”**

quiz.question: ________ liberality
quiz.explanation: 慷慨; 自由主义, 习惯性慷慨. His habitual liberality helped many. 他习惯性的慷慨帮助了许多人。 | liber->自由（拉丁），liberality->自由给予=慷慨（cf. liberty自由，liberal自由主义，liberate解放，deliberate审慎） || 文化联想：中文“常年乐善好施、出手大方”最适合帮助记忆 liberality，可以说 **habitual liberality — “A philanthropist known for habitual liberality may quietly support schools, hospitals, and disaster relief for decades.”**

quiz.question: _____ generality
quiz.explanation: 概括; 泛论, 广泛的概括. Avoid broad generality in arguments. 在论证中避免广泛的概括。 | general->普遍（拉丁generalis），generality->普遍性/笼统概括（cf. general将军/一般，generate产生，gender性别） || 文化联想：中文“大而化之、说得太泛”最适合帮助记忆 generality，可以说 **a broad generality — “Saying that every young person thinks alike is a broad generality that ignores important differences.”**

quiz.question: _____ mortality
quiz.explanation: 死亡率; 必死性, 人类必死性. Philosophy explores human mortality. 哲学探讨人类必死性。 | mort->死亡（拉丁mors），mortality->必死的性质/死亡率（cf. mortal死的，immortal不死，mortgage抵押，mortuary太平间） || 文化联想：“人生自古谁无死”最适合帮助记忆 mortality，可以说 **human mortality — “The line reminds readers that human mortality is universal even when individual lives are very different.”**

quiz.question: impermeability ____
quiz.explanation: 不渗透性, 不渗透性测试. The impermeability test checks waterproofing. 不渗透性测试检查防水性。 | im->否定，perme->渗透（拉丁permeare），impermeability->不能被渗透（cf. permeable可渗透，permeate渗透，impervious不透的） || 文化联想：中国新房验收时做卫生间防水测试最适合帮助记忆 impermeability，可以说 **an impermeability test — “An impermeability test can check whether a waterproof layer prevents water from passing through.”**

quiz.question: _____ liability
quiz.explanation: 责任; 债务, 法律责任. The company faces legal liability. 公司面临法律责任。 | liable->有义务（法语lier->绑定），liability->被绑定的义务=责任（cf. liable有责任，reliable可靠，ally结盟，liable to易于） || 文化联想：中文“出了事故依法要承担责任”最适合帮助记忆 liability，可以说 **legal liability — “A company may face legal liability if negligence causes a customer serious harm.”**

quiz.question: ________ viability
quiz.explanation: 生存能力; 可行性, 商业可行性. Assess business viability before investing. 投资前评估商业可行性。 | via->生命（拉丁vita），viable->能够存活的，viability->存活可行性（cf. vital重要/生命，vitamin维生素，vivid生动） || 文化联想：中国创业者做商业计划时反复论证项目能不能活下去，最适合帮助记忆 viability，可以说 **business viability — “Before investing, founders should test business viability by examining demand, costs, competition, and cash flow.”**

quiz.question: indispensability __ _____
quiz.explanation: 不可缺少, 水的不可缺少. The indispensability of water is obvious. 水的不可缺少是显而易见的。 | in->否定，dispens->分配（拉丁dispensare），indispensable->不能被分配去除的=不可缺少（cf. dispense分发，pension养老金，spend花费） || 文化联想：中文“水是生命不可缺少的东西”最适合帮助记忆 indispensability，可以说 **the indispensability of water — “The indispensability of water becomes obvious wherever drought threatens farms, cities, and public health.”**

quiz.question: ____ tractability
quiz.explanation: 易处理性; 温顺, 高度易处理性. The material has high tractability. 该材料具有高度易处理性。 | tract->拉/处理（拉丁trahere），tractability->容易被拉/处理的性质（cf. tractor拖拉机，attract吸引，distract分心，intractable难处理） || 文化联想：中文“好处理、容易配合”最适合帮助记忆 tractability，可以说 **high tractability — “A material with high tractability can be shaped and worked without excessive difficulty.”**

quiz.question: _________ excitability
quiz.explanation: 易激动性, 情绪易激动性. His emotional excitability caused problems. 他的情绪易激动性造成了问题。 | excit->唤起（拉丁excitare），excitability->容易被唤起的性质（cf. excite激动，cite引用，incite煽动，recite背诵） || 文化联想：中文“一点小事就情绪爆发”最适合帮助记忆 excitability，可以说 **emotional excitability — “High emotional excitability can make someone react intensely to relatively minor events.”**

quiz.question: ______ accountability
quiz.explanation: 责任; 问责制, 公共问责制. Public accountability is essential in government. 公共问责制在政府中至关重要。 | account->账户/解释（拉丁computare），accountability->需要解释账目的责任（cf. account账户，recount叙述，discount折扣） || 文化联想：中文“有权必有责、出了问题要能追责”最适合帮助记忆 accountability，可以说 **public accountability — “Public accountability requires officials to explain decisions and accept consequences for serious failures.”**

quiz.question: ______ notability
quiz.explanation: 显著; 著名, 公众知名度. His public notability grew quickly. 他的公众知名度迅速增长。 | not->标记（拉丁nota->标记），notability->值得标记/注意的性质（cf. note笔记，notable著名，notation记法，annotate注释） || 文化联想：中国运动员夺冠后迅速成为公众熟知人物最适合帮助记忆 notability，可以说 **public notability — “Winning an Olympic gold medal can quickly give a previously unknown athlete public notability.”**

quiz.question: ________ debility
quiz.explanation: 虚弱; 衰弱, 身体虚弱. Age brought physical debility. 年龄带来了身体虚弱。 | debil->虚弱（拉丁debilis->弱），debility->虚弱的状态（cf. debilitate使虚弱，ability能力，disability残疾，enable使能够） || 文化联想：中文“久病之后身体虚弱无力”最适合帮助记忆 debility，可以说 **physical debility — “A long illness can leave an older patient with physical debility that requires gradual rehabilitation.”**

quiz.question: incorrigibility ______
quiz.explanation: 不可救药, 不可救药的记录. His incorrigibility record was extensive. 他不可救药的记录很广泛。 | in->否定，corrig->纠正（拉丁corrigere），incorrigibility->无法被纠正的性质（cf. correct纠正，incorrigible不可救药，corrigendum勘误） || 文化联想：“屡教不改、怎么纠正都改不了”最适合帮助记忆 incorrigibility，可以说 **a record of incorrigibility — “Repeated misconduct despite many warnings can create a record of incorrigibility.”**

quiz.question: ___ intangibility __ ______
quiz.explanation: 无形性, 权利的无形性. The intangibility of rights makes enforcement difficult. 权利的无形性使执行变得困难。 | in->否定，tang->触摸（拉丁tangere），intangibility->不可触及的性质（cf. tangible可触，intangible无形，contingent依情而定） || 文化联想：中文“权利看不见摸不着，却真实存在”最适合帮助记忆 intangibility，可以说 **the intangibility of rights — “The intangibility of rights does not make them less important, but it can make enforcement more difficult.”**

quiz.question: _____ fallibility
quiz.explanation: 易犯错性; 易错性, 人类易错性. Human fallibility means we all make mistakes. 人类易错性意味着我们都会犯错。 | fall->欺骗/失败（拉丁fallere），fallibility->容易犯错的性质（cf. false假，infallible不会错，fallacy谬误，default违约） || 文化联想：“人非圣贤，孰能无过”最适合帮助记忆 fallibility，可以说 **human fallibility — “The saying reminds us that human fallibility is universal and that even capable people can make mistakes.”**

quiz.question: susceptibility __ _______
quiz.explanation: 易感性; 敏感性, 对疾病的易感性. Genetics affects susceptibility to disease. 遗传影响对疾病的易感性。 | sus->在下，cept->抓取（拉丁capere），susceptibility->容易被抓住的性质=易感性（cf. accept接受，except除外，intercept拦截） || 文化联想：中国医院常说有些人“更容易感染”，最适合帮助记忆 susceptibility，可以说 **susceptibility to disease — “Genetics, age, and health conditions can all affect a person’s susceptibility to disease.”**

quiz.question: ____ humility
quiz.explanation: 谦逊; 谦虚, 表现谦逊. Great leaders show humility. 伟大的领导者表现谦逊。 | humil->地面（拉丁humus->土），humility->贴近地面=谦逊（cf. humble谦逊，humiliate羞辱=踩到地上，exhume掘出，posthumous遗腹的） || 文化联想：“稻穗越饱满越低头”最适合帮助记忆 humility，可以说 **show humility — “A respected scholar may show humility by listening carefully and admitting what is still unknown.”**

quiz.question: _________ virility
quiz.explanation: 男子气概; 生殖力, 男性的男子气概. Sports celebrate masculine virility. 体育运动颂扬男性的男子气概。 | vir->男性（拉丁vir），virility->男性气质（cf. virtue美德=男性力量，virtual实际上，virile阳刚的，triumvirate三人执政） || 文化联想：传统戏曲里关羽那种阳刚勇武的形象可帮助记忆 virility，可以说 **masculine virility — “A traditional heroic character may be portrayed with masculine virility through strength, courage, and commanding presence.”**

quiz.question: ____ motility
quiz.explanation: 运动性; 活动力, 细胞运动性. Biologists study cell motility under microscopes. 生物学家在显微镜下研究细胞运动性。 | mot->运动（拉丁movere），motility->自主运动的能力（cf. motion运动，motive动机，motor马达，promote促进） || 文化联想：中国生物实验课观察精子或细胞运动最适合帮助记忆 motility，可以说 **cell motility — “Under a microscope, researchers can measure cell motility by tracking how quickly cells move.”**

quiz.question: _____ __ futility
quiz.explanation: 徒劳; 无用, 徒劳感. He felt a sense of futility about the project. 他对这个项目感到徒劳。 | futilis->漏水的（拉丁，fuere->倒出），futility->像漏水容器一样白费（cf. futile徒劳，refuse拒绝，confute驳倒） || 文化联想：“竹篮打水一场空”最适合帮助记忆 futility，可以说 **a sense of futility — “Repeatedly trying the same failed method can create a deep sense of futility.”**

quiz.question: _____ tranquility
quiz.explanation: 宁静; 平静, 乡村宁静. They enjoyed the rural tranquility. 他们享受乡村宁静。 | tranquil->平静（拉丁tranquillus），tranquility->平静宁和的状态（cf. tranquil平静，tranquilizer镇定剂，quiet安静） || 文化联想：陶渊明“采菊东篱下”的田园意境最适合帮助记忆 tranquility，可以说 **rural tranquility — “A quiet village surrounded by fields and distant hills can offer a sense of rural tranquility.”**

quiz.question: civility ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 礼貌; 谦恭, 礼貌和礼节. Treat everyone with civility and courtesy. 以礼貌和礼节对待每个人。 | civil->市民（拉丁civis），civility->市民间应有的礼貌（cf. civil民事/文明，civilization文明，civilian平民，civic市民的） || 文化联想：中文“礼多人不怪”最适合帮助记忆 civility，可以说 **civility and courtesy — “Even during disagreement, civility and courtesy can keep a conversation respectful.”**

quiz.question: _____ incredulity
quiz.explanation: 怀疑; 不轻信, 表达怀疑. She began to voice incredulity at the claims. 她开始对这些说法表达怀疑。 | in->否定，credul->相信（拉丁credere），incredulity->不肯相信的状态（cf. credible可信，incredible难以置信，credential证书） || 文化联想：听到离谱谣言时那种“这你也信？”的神情最适合帮助记忆 incredulity，可以说 **voice incredulity — “A listener may voice incredulity when a claim sounds impossible and has no supporting evidence.”**

quiz.question: ______ sedulity
quiz.explanation: 勤勉; 勤奋, 顽强的勤勉. His dogged sedulity led to success. 他顽强的勤勉导致了成功。 | sedulus->勤奋（拉丁，来自sedere->坐），sedulity->勤勤恳恳不离座=勤勉（cf. sedate镇静，sedentary久坐，sediment沉淀物） || 文化联想：“铁杵磨成针”最适合帮助记忆 sedulity，可以说 **dogged sedulity — “Years of patient practice can turn dogged sedulity into real mastery.”**

quiz.question: _______ garrulity
quiz.explanation: 多嘴; 唠叨, 无休止的唠叨. His endless garrulity bored everyone. 他无休止的唠叨让每个人都感到厌烦。 | garrulus->喋喋不休（拉丁garrire->聊天），garrulity->话多唠叨的特性（cf. garrulous多话的，gargle漱口，cf. jargon行话） || 文化联想：小区门口老人一聊就是一下午的絮叨最适合帮助记忆 garrulity，可以说 **endless garrulity — “A neighbor’s endless garrulity can turn a five-minute chat into an hour-long conversation.”**

quiz.question: _____________ amity
quiz.explanation: 友好; 和睦, 国际友好. Nations strive for international amity. 各国努力争取国际友好。 | amic->朋友（拉丁amicus），amity->朋友间的关系=友好（cf. amiable和蔼，amicable友好，enemy敌人=非朋友，amateur业余爱好者=爱好者） || 文化联想：中国外交里常说“睦邻友好”，最适合帮助记忆 amity，可以说 **international amity — “Stable diplomacy and mutual respect can help preserve international amity between neighboring countries.”**

quiz.question: _______ calamity
quiz.explanation: 灾难; 灾祸, 自然灾害. The earthquake was a natural calamity. 地震是一场自然灾害。 | calami->灾难（拉丁calamitas，可能来自calamus->秸秆），calamity->严重灾难（cf. calamitous灾难性的，disaster灾难=星运不佳） || 文化联想：汶川地震这类重大天灾最适合帮助记忆 calamity，可以说 **a natural calamity — “A devastating earthquake can become a natural calamity that affects millions of people.”**

quiz.question: ____ magnanimity
quiz.explanation: 宽宏大量, 表现宽宏大量. Winners should show magnanimity. 获胜者应该表现宽宏大量。 | magn->大，anim->心灵（拉丁anima），magnanimity->心胸宽大=宽宏大量（cf. animal动物=有灵魂的，animate赋予生命，pusillanimous胆小） || 文化联想：“将相和”里蔺相如以大局为重最适合帮助记忆 magnanimity，可以说 **show magnanimity — “By putting the larger good above a personal quarrel, a leader can show magnanimity.”**

quiz.question: ________ equanimity
quiz.explanation: 镇定; 沉着, 保持镇定. She managed to maintain equanimity under pressure. 她在压力下设法保持镇定。 | equ->平等，anim->心灵，equanimity->心灵保持平衡=镇定（cf. equalize均等，equinox春秋分，equator赤道，animate赋予生命） || 文化联想：苏轼“一蓑烟雨任平生”的旷达最适合帮助记忆 equanimity，可以说 **maintain equanimity — “A calm person can maintain equanimity even when plans suddenly go wrong.”**

quiz.question: ______ __ comity
quiz.explanation: 礼让; 友好, 友好精神. Diplomats work in a spirit of comity. 外交官以友好精神工作。 | comis->礼貌（拉丁），comity->礼貌友好的状态（cf. comedian喜剧演员，comic漫画，cf. comitas礼让） || 文化联想：中文“礼尚往来”最适合帮助记忆 comity，可以说 **a spirit of comity — “Diplomats who treat one another with respect can work in a spirit of comity.”**

quiz.question: ________ conformity
quiz.explanation: 一致; 遵从, 文化一致性. Social pressure enforces cultural conformity. 社会压力强制执行文化一致性。 | con->共同，form->形式，conformity->共同形式=遵从一致（cf. reform改革，transform转变，uniform制服，nonconformist不循规者） || 文化联想：“随乡入俗”最适合帮助记忆 conformity，可以说 **cultural conformity — “Strong social pressure can encourage cultural conformity even when individuals privately disagree.”**

quiz.question: ___ enormity __ ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 巨大; 严重性, 任务的巨大性. They realized the enormity of the task. 他们意识到任务的巨大性。 | e->超出，norm->标准（拉丁norma），enormity->超出标准的巨大/严重（cf. enormous巨大，norm标准，abnormal异常，normal正常） || 文化联想：都江堰这样规模浩大的工程最适合帮助记忆 enormity，可以说 **the enormity of the task — “Only after seeing the terrain may an engineer fully grasp the enormity of the task.”**

quiz.question: _______ anonymity
quiz.explanation: 匿名; 无名, 保护匿名. Journalists protect anonymity of sources. 记者保护消息来源的匿名。 | an->无，onym->名字（希腊onoma），anonymity->没有名字的状态（cf. synonym同义词，pseudonym笔名，anonymous匿名，antonym反义词） || 文化联想：中文网络世界里的“匿名发帖”最适合帮助记忆 anonymity，可以说 **protect anonymity — “A journalist may protect anonymity when revealing a source’s identity could put that person at risk.”**

quiz.question: sanity _____
quiz.explanation: 神智正常; 明智, 理智检查. Do a sanity check on your work. 对你的工作做理智检查。 | sanus->健康（拉丁），sanity->心智健康的状态（cf. sane清醒，insane疯狂，sanitize消毒，sanatorium疗养院） || 文化联想：程序员提交代码前做一次基本常识核查最适合帮助记忆 sanity，可以说 **a sanity check — “Before deploying a major change, an engineer may run a quick sanity check to catch obvious mistakes.”**

quiz.question: ________ insanity
quiz.explanation: 精神错乱; 疯狂, 刑事精神错乱. The defense claimed criminal insanity. 辩方声称刑事精神错乱。 | in->否定，sanity->神智正常，insanity->不正常的心智（cf. sane清醒，sanity理智，insane疯狂，asylum收容所） || 文化联想：insanity 是法律和医学中的精神失常概念，可用中国学生学习刑法时来记忆，可以说 **criminal insanity — “In legal study, criminal insanity concerns whether severe mental disorder affects responsibility for an offense.”**

quiz.question: _____ vanity
quiz.explanation: 虚荣; 自负, 纯粹的虚荣. His actions were driven by sheer vanity. 他的行为完全由虚荣驱动。 | vain->徒劳/虚荣（拉丁vanus->空），vanity->空洞虚荣的特性（cf. vain徒劳，vanish消失，evanescent消逝，vanity Fair名利场） || 文化联想：“打肿脸充胖子”最适合帮助记忆 vanity，可以说 **sheer vanity — “Buying luxury goods only to impress strangers can be an act of sheer vanity.”**

quiz.question: ______ amenity
quiz.explanation: 便利设施; 舒适设备, 现代便利设施. The hotel offers modern amenity. 酒店提供现代便利设施。 | amen->令人愉快的（拉丁amoenus），amenity->使生活愉快的设施（cf. amiable友善，amity友好，amateur爱好者） || 文化联想：现代小区里的健身房、泳池和会所最适合帮助记忆 amenity，可以说 **a modern amenity — “A gym or swimming pool can be a modern amenity that makes an apartment complex more convenient.”**

quiz.question: _____ dignity
quiz.explanation: 尊严; 庄严, 人的尊严. Human dignity must be respected. 人的尊严必须受到尊重。 | dignit->尊贵（拉丁dignitas），dignity->应受尊重的品格（cf. dignitary显要，condescend屈尊，indignation愤慨，disdain轻视） || 文化联想：“士可杀不可辱”最适合帮助记忆 dignity，可以说 **human dignity — “Respect for human dignity means treating every person as worthy of basic respect.”**

quiz.question: __ ___ vicinity
quiz.explanation: 附近; 邻近, 在附近. The store is in the vicinity. 商店就在附近。 | vicin->邻居（拉丁vicinus），vicinity->邻居的区域=附近（cf. village村庄，villain恶棍=乡村农民，vicinage附近） || 文化联想：中文“就在附近、步行几分钟”最适合帮助记忆 vicinity，可以说 **in the vicinity — “A family looking for dinner may search for restaurants in the vicinity of the hotel.”**

quiz.question: affinity ___
quiz.explanation: 亲和力; 喜好, 对...的喜好. She has an affinity for mathematics. 她对数学有喜好。 | affin->亲近（拉丁affinis->邻近），affinity->天然的亲近感（cf. finite有限，infinite无限，define定义，confine限制） || 文化联想：“物以类聚，人以群分”最适合帮助记忆 affinity，可以说 **an affinity for — “A child who naturally loves numbers may show an affinity for mathematics from an early age.”**

quiz.question: __ infinity ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 无限; 无穷, 直到无限以及更远. To infinity and beyond! 直到无限以及更远! | in->否定，finite->有限（拉丁finitus），infinity->没有边界=无限（cf. finite有限，define定义，final最终，finish完成） || 文化联想：中国学生学高数时最熟悉的“无穷”概念最适合帮助记忆 infinity，可以说 **to infinity and beyond — “In mathematics, a sequence can continue toward infinity without ever reaching a final number.”**

quiz.question: ____ indemnity
quiz.explanation: 赔偿; 保障, 寻求赔偿. Victims may seek indemnity for damages. 受害者可以为损害寻求赔偿。 | in->否定，damn->损害（拉丁damnum），indemnity->抵消损害的赔偿（cf. damage损害，condemn谴责，damn诅咒，indemnify赔偿） || 文化联想：中国保险理赔最适合帮助记忆 indemnity，可以说 **seek indemnity — “After a covered loss, a policyholder may seek indemnity from the insurer for eligible damages.”**

quiz.question: ______ solemnity
quiz.explanation: 庄严; 严肃, 仪式的庄严. The ritual solemnity impressed everyone. 仪式的庄严给每个人留下了深刻印象。 | solemnis->每年固定的（拉丁），solemnity->隆重庄严的气氛（cf. solemn庄严，solemize举行仪式，solemn oath庄严誓言） || 文化联想：清明祭祖仪式里的肃穆气氛最适合帮助记忆 solemnity，可以说 **ritual solemnity — “The quiet bows, flowers, and silence of a memorial ceremony can create deep ritual solemnity.”**

quiz.question: _______ fraternity
quiz.explanation: 兄弟会; 团体, 大学兄弟会. He joined a college fraternity. 他加入了大学兄弟会。 | frater->兄弟（拉丁），fraternity->兄弟的团体（cf. fraternal兄弟的，fraternize联谊，friar修士，fratricide兄弟相残） || 文化联想：fraternity 是西方大学兄弟会，可用中国学生了解美国校园文化时来记忆，可以说 **a college fraternity — “A Chinese student studying in the United States may encounter a college fraternity organized around social and alumni ties.”**

quiz.question: __________ immunity
quiz.explanation: 豁免; 免疫力, 外交豁免权. Ambassadors have diplomatic immunity. 大使享有外交豁免权。 | im->否定，mun->义务（拉丁munus），immunity->免除义务/病原的（cf. immunize免疫，community社区=共同义务，municipal市政） || 文化联想：驻华外交官享有的外交豁免最适合帮助记忆 immunity，可以说 **diplomatic immunity — “Foreign diplomats serving in Beijing may receive diplomatic immunity under international law.”**

quiz.question: ___ ____ impunity
quiz.explanation: 免罚; 不受惩罚, 不受惩罚地行事. Criminals cannot act with impunity. 罪犯不能不受惩罚地行事。 | im->否定，pun->惩罚（拉丁poena），impunity->无惩罚的状态（cf. punish惩罚，penalty惩罚，repent悔改，punitive惩罚性的） || 文化联想：中文“做坏事却逍遥法外”最适合帮助记忆 impunity，可以说 **act with impunity — “No official should be able to abuse power and act with impunity.”**

quiz.question: _____ serendipity
quiz.explanation: 意外发现; 机缘巧合, 幸运的机缘巧合. Their meeting was a happy serendipity. 他们的相遇是幸运的机缘巧合。 | Serendip->斯里兰卡的阿拉伯名，英国作家霍勒斯·沃波尔从波斯故事创造，serendipity->偶然发现珍贵事物 || 文化联想：在成都小巷随便拐进去却意外发现一家百年老店最适合帮助记忆 serendipity，可以说 **a happy serendipity — “Finding a wonderful old teahouse by accident during a walk can feel like a happy serendipity.”**

quiz.question: ______ solidarity
quiz.explanation: 团结; 一致, 工人团结. Worker solidarity strengthened the union. 工人团结加强了工会。 | solid->固体（拉丁solidus），solidarity->像固体一样坚实的团结（cf. solid固体，consolidate巩固，solidity坚固性） || 文化联想：“众人拾柴火焰高”最适合帮助记忆 solidarity，可以说 **worker solidarity — “Worker solidarity can grow when employees support one another during difficult negotiations.”**

quiz.question: charity __________
quiz.explanation: 慈善; 施舍, 慈善募捐活动. The charity fundraiser raised thousands. 慈善募捐活动筹集了数千美元。 | caritas->爱/慈爱（拉丁，cara->亲爱的），charity->对他人的爱=慈善（cf. care关心，caress爱抚，cherish珍视，dear亲爱的） || 文化联想：中国公益募捐活动最适合帮助记忆 charity，可以说 **a charity fundraiser — “A charity fundraiser may collect donations for children affected by a natural disaster.”**

quiz.question: _____ familiarity
quiz.explanation: 熟悉; 亲密, 密切的熟悉. Close familiarity breeds contempt. 密切的熟悉滋生轻蔑。 | famili->家庭（拉丁familia），familiarity->像家人一样的熟悉（cf. family家庭，familiar熟悉，famulus仆人，cf. familiar spirits精灵） || 文化联想：中文“熟得不能再熟”最适合帮助记忆 familiarity，可以说 **close familiarity — “Years of working together can create close familiarity with a colleague’s habits and style.”**

quiz.question: _____–_____ polarity
quiz.explanation: 极性; 两极分化, 南北极性. Magnets have north–south polarity. 磁铁有南北极性。 | pol->极（希腊polos->轴），polarity->两极的性质（cf. pole极点，polar极地，polarize使两极化，bipolar双极） || 文化联想：中国指南针的南北两极最适合帮助记忆 polarity，可以说 **north-south polarity — “A magnet has north-south polarity, with opposite magnetic poles at its two ends.”**

quiz.question: _____________ singularity
quiz.explanation: 奇点; 独特性, 技术奇点. Some predict a technological singularity. 有些人预测技术奇点。 | singul->单一（拉丁singulus），singularity->独特的奇点（cf. singular单数/独特，single单一，singular奇特，simple简单） || 文化联想：中国AI论坛里讨论“技术奇点”最适合帮助记忆 singularity，可以说 **a technological singularity — “Some futurists use the phrase technological singularity for a hypothetical point when technological change becomes extremely rapid.”**

quiz.question: ________ insularity
quiz.explanation: 孤立; 狭隘, 文化孤立. Cultural insularity limits perspectives. 文化孤立限制了视角。 | insul->岛（拉丁insula），insularity->像岛一样孤立的状态（cf. island岛，insulate绝缘，insulin胰岛素=来自胰岛细胞，peninsula半岛） || 文化联想：“闭关自守、像孤岛一样不与外界交流”最适合帮助记忆 insularity，可以说 **cultural insularity — “Cultural insularity can narrow perspectives when a community rarely engages with outside ideas.”**

quiz.question: _____ parity
quiz.explanation: 平价; 相等, 价格平价. Price parity ensures fair competition. 价格平价确保公平竞争。 | par->相等（拉丁par），parity->相等的状态（cf. pair一对，par高尔夫标准杆，disparity不平等，compare比较） || 文化联想：中文“双方价格差不多、达到平价”最适合帮助记忆 parity，可以说 **price parity — “Two competing products may reach price parity when they sell for roughly the same amount.”**

quiz.question: ______ disparity
quiz.explanation: 差异; 不平等, 收入差距. Income disparity is growing. 收入差距正在扩大。 | dis->否定，par->相等，disparity->不相等的差距（cf. parity平等，par标准，disparate完全不同，disparity差距） || 文化联想：“朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨”最适合帮助记忆 disparity，可以说 **income disparity — “A city can display severe income disparity when luxury districts stand beside communities struggling with basic needs.”**

quiz.question: _________ celebrity
quiz.explanation: 名人; 名声, 好莱坞名人. The Hollywood celebrity attended the premiere. 好莱坞名人参加了首映式。 | celebr->众人（拉丁celeber->著名），celebrity->著名人物（cf. celebrate庆祝，celebration庆典，celebrity名人） || 文化联想：中国娱乐圈家喻户晓的明星最适合帮助记忆 celebrity，可以说 **a famous celebrity — “A famous celebrity may be recognized instantly by crowds at an airport.”**

quiz.question: ____ alacrity
quiz.explanation: 敏捷; 乐意, 表现乐意. He accepted with alacrity. 他乐意地接受了。 | alacer->活跃（拉丁），alacrity->活跃乐意的状态（cf. alert警觉，alacrity敏捷，cf. alacrity to help乐于助人） || 文化联想：中文“一听就立刻答应、干得很爽快”最适合帮助记忆 alacrity，可以说 **show alacrity — “A volunteer may show alacrity by immediately stepping forward when help is needed.”**

quiz.question: ________ mediocrity
quiz.explanation: 平庸; 平凡, 文化平庸. Critics decry cultural mediocrity. 批评家谴责文化平庸。 | medius->中间（拉丁），ocris->山峰，mediocrity->在山的中部=不高不低=平庸（cf. medium中间，mediate调解，intermediate中间的） || 文化联想：中文“平平无奇、不上不下”最适合帮助记忆 mediocrity，可以说 **cultural mediocrity — “A critic may complain of cultural mediocrity when creative work becomes repetitive and risk-averse.”**

quiz.question: _______ insincerity
quiz.explanation: 不真诚; 虚伪, 明显的不真诚. His blatant insincerity was obvious. 他明显的不真诚是显而易见的。 | in->否定，sincer->纯粹（拉丁sincerus->无蜡），insincerity->不纯粹=不真诚（cf. sincere真诚，sincere原意=大理石不掺蜡） || 文化联想：“当面一套、背后一套”最适合帮助记忆 insincerity，可以说 **blatant insincerity — “Praise that is obviously given only to gain favor can sound like blatant insincerity.”**

quiz.question: __________ celerity
quiz.explanation: 迅速; 敏捷, 非凡的迅速. They moved with remarkable celerity. 他们以非凡的迅速行动。 | celer->快速（拉丁），celerity->快速敏捷的状态（cf. accelerate加速=使更快，celery芹菜=？，cf. alacrity敏捷之意相近） || 文化联想：古代“八百里加急”传递军情最适合帮助记忆 celerity，可以说 **remarkable celerity — “An urgent message carried with remarkable celerity can reach its destination far faster than normal.”**

quiz.question: ________ temerity
quiz.explanation: 鲁莽; 冒失, 鲁莽的冒失. His reckless temerity caused problems. 他鲁莽的冒失造成了问题。 | temer->黑暗/莽撞（拉丁temere->无理由地），temerity->莽撞无畏（cf. timid胆小=反义，rash鲁莽，audacity大胆，intrepid无畏） || 文化联想：中文“胆子大到有点鲁莽”最适合帮助记忆 temerity，可以说 **reckless temerity — “Ignoring every warning and entering a dangerous area alone can show reckless temerity.”**

quiz.question: ________ prosperity
quiz.explanation: 繁荣; 兴旺, 经济繁荣. Economic prosperity benefits all. 经济繁荣使所有人受益。 | prosper->顺利（拉丁prosperus->幸运），prosperity->顺利繁荣的状态（cf. prosper繁荣，prosperous兴旺，prospectus招股说明书） || 文化联想：“国泰民安、物阜民丰”最适合帮助记忆 prosperity，可以说 **economic prosperity — “Stable growth, productive businesses, and rising incomes can support broad economic prosperity.”**

quiz.question: _______ austerity
quiz.explanation: 紧缩; 朴素, 战后紧缩. Postwar austerity was difficult. 战后紧缩很困难。 | auster->干燥/严峻（希腊austeros->使干燥），austerity->严格朴素的状态（cf. austere朴素，Australia南方大陆=南风之地） || 文化联想：中文“勒紧裤腰带过日子”最适合帮助记忆 austerity，可以说 **austerity measures — “During a fiscal crisis, a government may adopt austerity measures to reduce spending.”**

quiz.question: ______ dexterity
quiz.explanation: 灵巧; 敏捷, 手工灵巧. Surgeons need manual dexterity. 外科医生需要手工灵巧。 | dexter->右手（拉丁），dexterity->右手的灵巧（cf. adroit灵巧=右手的，sinister左手/邪恶，ambidextrous双手灵巧，dexterous灵巧） || 文化联想：苏绣艺人一针一线的精细手上功夫最适合帮助记忆 dexterity，可以说 **manual dexterity — “Fine embroidery requires exceptional manual dexterity to control tiny stitches precisely.”**

quiz.question: _____ integrity
quiz.explanation: 正直; 诚实, 道德正直. Politicians should have moral integrity. 政客应该有道德正直。 | integr->完整（拉丁integer->完整的），integrity->完整无损的正直（cf. integer整数，integrate整合，disintegrate分解，integral积分） || 文化联想：“一诺千金”最适合帮助记忆 integrity，可以说 **moral integrity — “A person with moral integrity keeps a promise even when breaking it would be easier and more profitable.”**

quiz.question: ___ __ superiority
quiz.explanation: 优越; 优势, 优越感. He spoke with an air of superiority. 他带着优越感说话。 | super->超过（拉丁），superiority->高于他人的状态（cf. superior优越，supreme最高，supersede取代，supercilious傲慢=眉毛上扬） || 文化联想：古装剧里权贵高高在上的姿态最适合帮助记忆 superiority，可以说 **an air of superiority — “Speaking to everyone as if they are inferior creates an unpleasant air of superiority.”**

quiz.question: ___ priority
quiz.explanation: 优先; 优先权, 最优先. Safety is our top priority. 安全是我们的最优先事项。 | prior->之前（拉丁），priority->排在前面的权利（cf. prior之前，prioritize优先处理，posterior后面的，a priori先验的） || 文化联想：“民以食为天”最适合帮助记忆 priority，可以说 **top priority — “For a family facing hardship, food and housing naturally become the top priority.”**

quiz.question: _____ obscurity
quiz.explanation: 默默无闻; 晦涩, 完全默默无闻. The artist died in total obscurity. 艺术家在完全默默无闻中去世。 | obscurus->黑暗（拉丁），obscurity->黑暗/晦涩的状态（cf. obscure晦涩，obfuscate混淆，dark黑暗，occult隐藏） || 文化联想：“怀才不遇、默默无闻”最适合帮助记忆 obscurity，可以说 **total obscurity — “A gifted painter may work for decades in total obscurity before the public discovers the work.”**

quiz.question: _____ purity
quiz.explanation: 纯洁; 纯净, 道德纯洁. They valued moral purity. 他们重视道德纯洁。 | purus->纯（拉丁），purity->纯洁的状态（cf. pure纯，purify净化，purge清除，impure不纯，expurgate删除） || 文化联想：“出淤泥而不染”的莲花最适合帮助记忆 purity，可以说 **moral purity — “The lotus is often used as an image of moral purity because it rises clean from muddy water.”**

quiz.question: ____ maturity
quiz.explanation: 成熟; 到期, 贷款到期. The loan maturity date is next year. 贷款到期日是明年。 | matur->成熟（拉丁maturus），maturity->成熟的状态（cf. mature成熟，premature过早，immature不成熟，maternal母性） || 文化联想：中国买房贷款里最熟悉的“到期日”最适合帮助记忆 maturity，可以说 **loan maturity — “A mortgage reaches loan maturity when the final scheduled payment becomes due.”**

quiz.question: _______ propensity

quiz.question: ______ animosity

quiz.question: ____ pomposity

quiz.question: ___ __ generosity
quiz.explanation: 慷慨; 大方, 慷慨的行为. quiz.question: __________ virtuosity
quiz.explanation: 精湛技艺; 艺术鉴赏力, 非凡的精湛技艺. quiz.question: ______ acuity
quiz.explanation: 敏锐; 尖锐, 视觉敏锐度. quiz.question: ___________ ingenuity

quiz.question: _____ iniquity
quiz.explanation: 邪恶; 不公正, 严重的邪恶. quiz.question: _________ antiquity

quiz.question: _____ incongruity

quiz.question: hyperactivity ________

quiz.question: ____ __ fealty

quiz.question: ________ warranty

quiz.question: ________ sovereignty

quiz.question: dainty _______
quiz.explanation: 精致的; 娇小的, 纤细的手指. quiz.question: _____ certainty
quiz.explanation: 确定; 必然, 道德确信. quiz.question: flaunty _____

quiz.question: tasty _____
quiz.explanation: 美味的, 美味的小吃. This is a tasty snack. 这是美味的小吃。 | taste->品味（古法语taster->触摸/品尝），tasty->令味觉满意的=美味（cf. taste味道，distaste厌恶，tasteful有品位的，tasteless无味） || 文化联想：中国街头刚出锅的小笼包最适合帮助记忆 tasty，可以说 **a tasty snack — “Freshly steamed xiaolongbao can make a tasty snack on a cold morning.”**

quiz.question: _____ amnesty
quiz.explanation: 特赦; 大赦, 给予特赦. quiz.question: zesty _____

quiz.question: feisty ______

quiz.question: fusty _____
